WynVXMD98I.one_liner: Proves gradient descent on reverse Fisher divergence converges globally for fitting Gaussian mixtures, unlike forward Fisher score matching.
WynVXMD98I.problem: Minimizing the forward Fisher divergence can give initialization-dependent, undesirable convergence even in simple Gaussian mixture settings.
WynVXMD98I.method: They analyze gradient descent on the reverse Fisher divergence, where the expectation is taken over the student distribution. They prove global convergence from arbitrary initializations when the teacher is a single Gaussian and the student a Gaussian mixture with fixed weights and identity covariances, and under a global random initialization and a separation assumption when the teacher is also a mixture.
WynVXMD98I.key_idea: Take the Fisher divergence expectation under the student distribution (reverse direction), which makes gradient descent on Gaussian mixtures converge globally instead of depending on initialization.
WynVXMD98I.evidence: Theoretical proofs of global convergence for a single-Gaussian teacher from arbitrary initialization, and for a mixture teacher under random initialization with separated target means; experiments are not stated in the available abstract.

QbNnbiHvpL.one_liner: Learns a fixed-budget KV-cache eviction policy by supervising keep-or-drop decisions with future-attention signals
QbNnbiHvpL.problem: Existing KV eviction methods rely on static heuristics or proxy scores that poorly track future token utility, causing brittle eviction as relevance shifts.
QbNnbiHvpL.method: KVpop trains token-importance scorers that are directly supervised on the keep-or-drop decision, using either stateless lightweight MLPs or delayed memory-based recurrent scorers that see near-future context before eviction.
QbNnbiHvpL.key_idea: Train a scorer, supervised by future attention, to predict which KV entries to keep, and evict the lowest-scoring entries under a fixed budget.
QbNnbiHvpL.evidence: AIME and HMMT mathematical reasoning on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, compared with established eviction baselines.
QbNnbiHvpL.claimed_gains: Retains 98% of full-attention performance on Qwen3-4B at 75% KV cache compression and 97% at 88% compression.

5PWu6Ds1fO.one_liner: Multi-view clustering that infers each view's complementary information through anchor-excluded symmetric cross-view interactions.
5PWu6Ds1fO.problem: Existing deep multi-view clustering methods rely on shallow view-level coupling, which limits progressive cross-view reasoning.
5PWu6Ds1fO.method: VIR-SCI reformulates multi-view fusion as view-wise incremental reasoning with anchor-excluded symmetric cross-view interactions, adds feature-wise incremental reasoning to modulate cross-view information, and uses mutual-information-constrained semantic alignment with contrastive learning.
5PWu6Ds1fO.key_idea: Infer each view's complementary information from the other views excluding the anchor view, modulate it feature-wise, and preserve semantics with mutual-information-constrained alignment.
5PWu6Ds1fO.evidence: Extensive experiments against competing multi-view clustering methods; datasets and baselines are not stated.
5PWu6Ds1fO.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract only says it consistently outperforms prior methods.

oYxVTGVK6I.one_liner: VECA restricts ViT patch communication to a small set of learned core tokens, giving linear-complexity attention.
oYxVTGVK6I.problem: Vision Transformers assume direct all-to-all patch interaction is needed, at quadratic cost, and it is unclear whether such interaction is necessary for global recognition and dense prediction.
oYxVTGVK6I.method: VECA uses core-periphery attention in which patch tokens exchange global information only through a small set of learned cores, while all dense patches are kept and updated across layers. Nested training along the core axis lets one model trade computation for accuracy at inference without retraining.
oYxVTGVK6I.key_idea: Route all global patch communication through a fixed budget of learned core tokens without compressing the spatial token set, and train nested core counts for elastic inference.
oYxVTGVK6I.evidence: Image classification and dense prediction benchmarks compared with full-attention backbones and linear-complexity alternatives.
oYxVTGVK6I.claimed_gains: Attention cost falls from quadratic to linear in the number of patches; the abstract gives no accuracy numbers, only competitive results against full-attention backbones.

KdwekoQvgE.one_liner: ESOR-BFM selects policies from a behavior foundation model via ensemble sampling with optimistic recentering at refresh times.
KdwekoQvgE.problem: Online task inference with behavior foundation models must find a high-performing policy for a target reward while collecting reward-labeled data at low computational cost.
KdwekoQvgE.method: ESOR-BFM samples ensemble members for policy selection between refreshes. When the regularized Gram matrix of state features changes substantially, it refreshes the ensemble perturbations and recenters the ensemble around an optimistic task-embedding estimate, so optimistic search runs only at refresh times.
KdwekoQvgE.key_idea: Trigger ensemble refresh and optimistic recentering of task embeddings when the regularized Gram matrix of state features changes substantially, amortizing search cost.
KdwekoQvgE.evidence: A sublinear regret guarantee for an episodic variant with well-trained BFMs, and experiments on ExORL with stationary rewards, selective reward labeling and inaccurate successor feature estimates.
KdwekoQvgE.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract reports the highest mean returns on ExORL settings without numbers.

eBRf1mIk7U.one_liner: Cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive video editor for multi-shot videos, trained on automatically generated paired editing data, with a dedicated benchmark.
eBRf1mIk7U.problem: Long-form multi-shot video editing must keep an edit coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint and subject appearance while processing much longer context than single-shot editors, and it needs cross-shot supervision data at scale.
eBRf1mIk7U.method: MoviEdit builds 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation from synchronized multi-view footage, real multi-shot videos and generated content. A lightweight bidirectional stage first makes a globally coherent editing draft over a spatiotemporally compressed representation, which an autoregressive stage then propagates and refines over the full video.
eBRf1mIk7U.key_idea: Cascade a bidirectional draft stage on compressed video for global coherence with an autoregressive refinement stage over the full-length video.
eBRf1mIk7U.evidence: Text-guided and image-guided editing experiments on the new MoviEdit-Bench against open-source models and strong proprietary models.
eBRf1mIk7U.claimed_gains: Substantially outperforms existing open-source models and reaches performance comparable to strong proprietary models, with 87K automatically generated paired editing videos.

lkoLXuV8LT.one_liner: Wraps each tool in an LLM that resolves its schema, letting agents call and chain tools in natural language.
lkoLXuV8LT.problem: LLM tool use is brittle in multi-step, multi-turn settings where one tool's output must be mapped to the next tool's input schema, and it degrades as the tool catalogue grows.
lkoLXuV8LT.method: Tool Primitives replace schema-based invocation with a natural-language interface, and ToolFace hosts 25,519 functions of which only retrieved tools enter context. HEART decomposes a query into an invocation plan, grounds each step's arguments from the query and earlier results, validates every returned result, and feeds failures back as targeted revisions.
lkoLXuV8LT.key_idea: Give each tool an LLM wrapper that resolves its own schema from a natural-language request, so dependent calls pass results to one another in natural language.
lkoLXuV8LT.evidence: Experiments on five settings that the cut-off abstract does not name, using the ToolFace repository of 25,519 functions.

zEc0veD3LJ.one_liner: Trains a diffusion model on synthetic, single-bokeh, and paired real data in a unified format for controllable refocusing.
zEc0veD3LJ.problem: Single-image refocusing needs both sharp-content recovery and realistic bokeh, but current methods require all-in-focus inputs, depend on simulator-generated synthetic data, and offer limited aperture control.
zEc0veD3LJ.method: A training scheme completes missing signals so synthetic renderings, single real bokeh photographs, and paired real captures share one training format, allowing joint training across heterogeneous real-world sources. The model then gives precise control over focus and bokeh intensity.
zEc0veD3LJ.key_idea: Complete the missing signals in each data source so heterogeneous real and synthetic data can be trained jointly in one unified format.
zEc0veD3LJ.evidence: Experiments on defocus deblurring, bokeh synthesis, and refocusing benchmarks; specific datasets are not named in the abstract.
zEc0veD3LJ.claimed_gains: Claims the best perceptual performance on defocus deblurring, bokeh synthesis, and refocusing benchmarks; no numbers are stated.

iLWD9TsyMO.one_liner: Robot policy with a persistent Semantic State updated at semantic transitions, conditioning world-prediction and action queries on task progress.
iLWD9TsyMO.problem: Combining semantic reasoning with future-world prediction in robot policies does not guarantee that local predictions and actions stay aligned with task progress.
iLWD9TsyMO.method: Keeps a Semantic State storing completed task events and the active subtask, updated only when observations signal semantic transitions. Progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation, and inference drops the future-prediction branch.
iLWD9TsyMO.key_idea: An event-driven persistent Semantic State serves as shared task-progress context for progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries.
iLWD9TsyMO.evidence: Evaluated on RoboDojo and BiCoord, plus real-world closed-loop dual-arm manipulation, without additional robot-action pretraining.
iLWD9TsyMO.claimed_gains: Reaches 15.56/11.70% Score/SR on RoboDojo and best-reported performance on BiCoord; a real-world figure beginning 16.4x is cut off in the abstract.

YbGLlsjkfc.one_liner: Test-time latent optimization for unified multimodal LLMs that adapts where to refine, update scale, and which image to return.
YbGLlsjkfc.problem: Fixed refinement policies at test time waste updates on locally saturated positions, ignore differences in update reliability, and discard better intermediate images by returning the final iterate.
YbGLlsjkfc.method: TRILO has three controls: Reallocate shifts a fixed-size text-latent refinement window away from saturated positions using predictive entropy; Rescale applies more conservative scaling at less confident positions; Retain returns the highest-reward evaluated image if the stopping criterion is unmet after the budget is exhausted.
YbGLlsjkfc.key_idea: State-dependent control of a fixed test-time latent optimization budget: entropy-guided window shifting, confidence-aware update scaling, and best-reward iterate return.
YbGLlsjkfc.evidence: Local theoretical analysis and controlled diagnostics, plus experiments on GenEval, T2I-CompBench, and WISE with Janus-Pro-1B and a second model that is cut off in the abstract.
YbGLlsjkfc.claimed_gains: Reports consistent improvements in compositional and knowledge-intensive generation; no numbers are stated.

x8Lg6heIlT.one_liner: Self-evolving VLM framework with fine-grained questioner-solver alternation, a quality supervisor, and skill-aware dynamic balancing.
x8Lg6heIlT.problem: VLM self-evolution suffers from delayed questioner-solver interaction under coarse role alternation, progressively degrading question quality, and question types collapsing toward a narrow distribution.
x8Lg6heIlT.method: RISE shortens the questioner-solver feedback loop with fine-grained role alternation, adds a quality supervisor to improve question validity and pseudo-label reliability, and uses skill-aware dynamic balancing to keep broad skill coverage during evolution.
x8Lg6heIlT.key_idea: Interleave questioner and solver updates at fine granularity, filter questions and pseudo-labels with a supervisor, and rebalance question types by skill.
x8Lg6heIlT.evidence: The visible abstract is cut off before the experiments; no datasets or models are stated.

vBotEFNJy9.one_liner: MLLM detector for AI-generated videos using inspection planning, evidence verification, and evidence aggregation, with a new artifact benchmark.
vBotEFNJy9.problem: Artifact-based AI-video detectors may miss subtle artifacts or reach the right source decision without faithfully identifying the evidence behind it.
vBotEFNJy9.method: Verus-Insight formulates artifact detection as Inspection Planning, Evidence Verification, and Evidence Aggregation, trained with human-anchored full-process supervision and progressive capability training. Verus-Bench adds fine-grained human annotations of perceptible artifacts for evaluation.
vBotEFNJy9.key_idea: Decompose detection into plan-what-to-inspect, verify-artifact, and aggregate-evidence steps, each supervised with human-anchored annotations.
vBotEFNJy9.evidence: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks, including the new Verus-Bench (details truncated in the abstract).

jXlLqdMeNQ.one_liner: Agentic recovery for dense-temporal surgical video segmentation that detects tracking drift, re-anchors the target, and rolls back tracker memory.
jXlLqdMeNQ.problem: Existing VOS methods often fail to detect unreliable propagation and cannot recover once tracking drift contaminates memory in high-frame-rate surgical video.
jXlLqdMeNQ.method: SurgATR performs trajectory reflection to flag propagation failures, then an agent re-anchors the target with corrective prompts and rolls back and reconstructs tracker memory from a reliable state. Cycle validation filters identity-inconsistent recoveries and global Viterbi selection picks a coherent trajectory.
jXlLqdMeNQ.key_idea: Trigger an agent on detected propagation failure to correct both spatial prompts and temporal tracker memory, with cycle validation and Viterbi selection guarding against distractor recovery.
jXlLqdMeNQ.evidence: SurgDVOS, a new benchmark with 330,246 annotated frames and 869,922 pixel-level masks, plus three public natural-video benchmarks, for mask-guided and referring VOS.
jXlLqdMeNQ.claimed_gains: Consistent improvements on SurgDVOS and three public natural-video benchmarks (no numbers stated).

l9JKotBWh0.one_liner: Long-video camera reshooting that queries a dynamic memory of the source video across time, space, and semantics.
l9JKotBWh0.problem: Existing video reshooting methods handle short clips, but long sources need synchronization under large camera baselines and subject motion, plus long-term 3D and semantic consistency.
l9JKotBWh0.method: LongReplay's memory selection retrieves a synchronized source chunk, multi-time spatial patches covering the target view, and semantic anchors; dynamic-aware correspondence then identifies patches by time and space with a 4D projection embedding and matches tokens by semantics with TIPS descriptors. WorldReplay, an Unreal Engine 5 pipeline, renders paired long videos of dynamic scenes under different cameras for supervision.
l9JKotBWh0.key_idea: Read out a dynamic memory of the source video by time, space, and semantics, matching retrieved patches via a 4D projection embedding and TIPS semantic descriptors.
l9JKotBWh0.evidence: Trained with WorldReplay paired long videos rendered in Unreal Engine 5; evaluation details are cut off in the abstract.

ZCHk7HSwRd.one_liner: HEFR iteratively refines a latent perturbation-response hypothesis by retrieving evidence conditioned on the current hypothesis.
ZCHk7HSwRd.problem: Predicting responses to unseen perturbations requires generalizing from sparse experimental knowledge, and the most useful evidence depends on both the query and the current predicted response.
ZCHk7HSwRd.method: HEFR follows a Propose-Reason-Realize pipeline: it initializes a latent hypothesis, loops retrieving evidence with the current hypothesis to revise it until further reasoning is not expected to help, decodes an aggregate response, and realizes a heterogeneous population of perturbed cells.
ZCHk7HSwRd.key_idea: Feed the current latent hypothesis back to retrieve the evidence used to revise it, looping with an adaptive stopping rule, then sample a consistent cell population.
ZCHk7HSwRd.evidence: Chemical and genetic perturbation benchmarks, plus theoretical and biological interpretability analyses.
ZCHk7HSwRd.claimed_gains: Substantially outperforms existing methods on aggregate accuracy and distributional fidelity; no numbers are stated.

3lmBhMwdqM.one_liner: ChainPrint ranks candidate image-processing histories by estimating operations from before-and-after examples and composing them.
3lmBhMwdqM.problem: When operation names and configurations are unavailable, methods that recover named operation sequences or compare processing traces cannot determine an image's processing history.
3lmBhMwdqM.method: ChainPrint estimates reusable operation functions from paired examples within a declared model library and composes them to rank candidate histories without task-specific retraining; the authors derive sufficient conditions under which all example-compatible models in a parameter neighborhood prefer the same history.
3lmBhMwdqM.key_idea: Compose operation functions estimated from example pairs sequentially to score histories, and bound when the history decision is fixed before the operations are fully identified.
3lmBhMwdqM.evidence: Experiments across three image sources with eight examples per operation and sixteen candidates, ablations on shuffled example pairings and sequential versus additive composition, and a fully enumerated two-dimensional control (truncated).
3lmBhMwdqM.claimed_gains: Eight-step Top-1 reaches 100.0% for conventional histories and 77.8% for AI-containing histories; replacing sequential composition with additive operation changes lowers eight-step AI Top-1 accuracy by 41.4 percentage points.

FoWmPowLwj.one_liner: RAE-CoD is a compression-oriented diffusion in representation-autoencoder space with direct alignment of compressed and source representations at extremely low bitrates.
FoWmPowLwj.problem: Generative image codecs suffer semantic collapse, producing malformed or unrecognizable content when the bitrate falls below normal operating rates.
FoWmPowLwj.method: The authors find that reconstruction losses increasingly conflict with semantic objectives as bitrate drops and that pixel-space and reconstruction-oriented VAE diffusion models preserve semantics less efficiently. RAE-CoD builds compression-oriented diffusion in a representation autoencoder space with direct alignment between compressed and source representations.
FoWmPowLwj.key_idea: Run compression-oriented diffusion in a representation-autoencoder space and align compressed representations directly with source representations instead of relying on reconstruction losses.
FoWmPowLwj.evidence: MSCOCO-30K evaluation with five vision foundation models and a blinded vision-language-model protocol at 0.001-0.008 bpp.
FoWmPowLwj.claimed_gains: At 0.001-0.008 bpp on MSCOCO-30K, reduces relative VFM feature MSE and Frechet Distance ratio by at least 25.7% and 69.1% over the best competitors, and preserves recognizable content for a 256x256 image with as few as 16 bits.

qfMnE1b3a5.one_liner: Spectral-Aware Staining pairs a multi-frequency spectral consistency metric with a graph-spectral caching strategy for diffusion virtual staining.
qfMnE1b3a5.problem: Conventional virtual-staining evaluation and training objectives can overlook fine-grained biological structure, downstream evaluation needs annotations or expert assessment, and diffusion-based staining is costly because of iterative denoising.
qfMnE1b3a5.method: MSAC scores staining quality by comparing retained multi-frequency spectral subspaces, and SBCache estimates denoising redundancy in a learned graph-spectral space to reuse intermediate computations. Both share one trained neural spectral decomposer that predicts ordered graph-spectral bases.
qfMnE1b3a5.key_idea: Use one learned neural spectral decomposer's ordered graph-spectral bases both to compare multi-frequency subspaces for quality and to detect redundant denoising steps for caching.
qfMnE1b3a5.evidence: The abstract describes virtual staining quality assessment and diffusion acceleration; datasets and results are cut off.

iiIApd17t6.one_liner: Site-momentum keeps an exponential moving average of site functions to speed up variational learning at scale.
iiIApd17t6.problem: Momentum is well studied for deep learning but not for variational learning at scale, so the authors revisit current practices there.
iiIApd17t6.method: The authors propose site-momentum, an exponential moving average of the site functions derived from Bayesian principles, which generalizes existing non-Bayesian momentum methods such as SGDHess and MARS.
iiIApd17t6.key_idea: Maintain an exponential moving average of the site functions in variational learning, which generalizes momentum methods such as SGDHess and MARS.
iiIApd17t6.evidence: Training Llama 3 (1.3B) on 100B tokens from the FineWeb dataset, compared against a leading existing variational method.
iiIApd17t6.claimed_gains: On Llama 3 (1.3B) trained on 100B tokens of FineWeb, site-momentum is much faster than the leading method and yields perplexity reductions of up to 0.96 throughout training.

gxtzawi49a.one_liner: MemLife stores long egocentric video as entity-grounded text episodes read by a time-indexed agentic retriever, with RL-optimized memory writing (MemOpt).
gxtzawi49a.problem: Reprocessing hundreds of hours of egocentric video per query is too costly, and text memory systems either lose key evidence or fail to retrieve it because of retrieval competition in growing search spaces.
gxtzawi49a.method: MemLife builds entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them with a time-indexed agentic reader, without training or query-time video access. MemOpt then applies reinforcement learning to optimize the memory writer to produce faithful, informative, retrievable memories.
gxtzawi49a.key_idea: Compact video into entity-grounded first-person text episodes retrieved by a time-indexed agent, then train the memory writer with RL to make memories faithful, informative, and retrievable.
gxtzawi49a.evidence: Four long-horizon egocentric-video benchmarks (not named), with MemOpt tested across video and question distributions and across writer and reader backbones and memory systems.
gxtzawi49a.claimed_gains: MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6-12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks, and MemOpt adds 2.7-5.0% over MemLife.

FulIPokFm2.one_liner: GTA bridges autoencoder and denoiser through a shared global token representation that carries image-level semantics.
FulIPokFm2.problem: In latent generative models, global semantics formed during autoencoding may not be inherited by the denoiser, and during denoising the evolving global semantics may drift from the spatial latents.
FulIPokFm2.method: GTA encourages the autoencoder to internalize image-level semantics during latent formation and keeps global semantics consistent with spatial latents throughout denoising, using a shared global representation.
FulIPokFm2.key_idea: Use one shared global token representation to push image-level semantics into the tokenizer's latents and keep it consistent with spatial latents during denoising.
FulIPokFm2.evidence: ImageNet 256x256 experiments with SD-VAE and VA-VAE initialization, plus training new generative models from scratch on the frozen GTA-VAE under SiT, REPA, and REG.
FulIPokFm2.claimed_gains: gFID of 6.42 after 20 epochs with SD-VAE initialization versus 7.17 after 40 epochs for REPA-E, and gFID of 1.87 after 200 epochs with VA-VAE initialization.

ZuDltyeOOs.one_liner: P^3-WAM unifies 3D hand perception, action-conditioned video prediction, and goal-directed planning in one mixture-of-transformers video diffusion model.
ZuDltyeOOs.problem: Egocentric dexterous manipulation needs 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and planning, and the paper tests whether learning them in one model beats single-mode training.
ZuDltyeOOs.method: A compact structured 3D action representation is integrated into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions act as conditioning or prediction targets across the Perceive, Predict, and Plan modes.
ZuDltyeOOs.key_idea: Randomize which of video and 3D actions is conditioning versus target, so one mixture-of-transformers handles perception, prediction, and planning with shared weights.
ZuDltyeOOs.evidence: Experiments on four datasets for 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction, plus a vision-language-model evaluation of planning quality and goal-directed manipulation videos.
ZuDltyeOOs.claimed_gains: Unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training and beats specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets; no numbers are stated.

hWgJESYJ57.one_liner: VTIQL pairs a Transformer V-function that builds in-sample Bellman targets with an MLP Q-function for offline RL policy improvement.
hWgJESYJ57.problem: Transformer-based critics rely on specialized architectures or attention-entropy control to scale effectively.
hWgJESYJ57.method: State-Value Transformer Implicit Q-Learning combines a Transformer-based V-function that constructs in-sample Bellman targets with an MLP-based Q-function used for policy improvement, under in-sample learning.
hWgJESYJ57.key_idea: Train the Transformer critic on a state-value in-sample objective, so it scales without attention-entropy control, and use an MLP Q-function for policy improvement.
hWgJESYJ57.evidence: Experiments on OGBench, including robotic manipulation and maze navigation tasks with high-dimensional states, plus tests with compact Transformer V-functions across model sizes.
hWgJESYJ57.claimed_gains: Best performance on 7 out of 9 OGBench environments, strong results on both manipulation and maze navigation, and robustness across model sizes.

cgQptc28N7.one_liner: Three-stage framework that trains assistants with simulated latent user thoughts as privileged information through on-policy asymmetric self-distillation.
cgQptc28N7.problem: User utterances reveal only partial information about underlying intents, preferences, and concerns, so LLM assistants are limited by partial observability.
cgQptc28N7.method: OASIS first uses user simulators to expose latent user states for supervised cold-start training, then performs on-policy asymmetric self-distillation in which the same assistant learns from the gap between a privileged view with latent thoughts and an observable view with dialogue only. It does not need a stronger teacher model.
cgQptc28N7.key_idea: Distill the assistant's own privileged-view behavior, conditioned on latent user thoughts, into its dialogue-only view on-policy so latent user information is internalized.
cgQptc28N7.evidence: Open-ended general assistance (WildBench) and goal-oriented commercial customer service (DianJin-CSC), across model scales and evaluation settings.
cgQptc28N7.claimed_gains: On-policy self-distillation gives up to 52.4% and 22% further improvements over the SFT initialization on WildBench and DianJin-CSC, respectively.

RsUg88yEF9.one_liner: Hierarchical RL where a high-level policy sets latent goals and a world-model planner replaces the low-level policy.
RsUg88yEF9.problem: Conventional hierarchical RL realizes high-level goals with learned goal-conditioned low-level policies, and the goal interface between levels may not preserve task-relevant information.
RsUg88yEF9.method: VALP learns a compact value-aware latent space in which a high-level policy specifies temporally extended goals, while a model-predictive planner synthesizes primitive actions through a learned latent world model toward those goals.
RsUg88yEF9.key_idea: Replace the low-level policy with model-predictive planning in a value-aware latent space shared with the high-level goal policy.
RsUg88yEF9.evidence: Long-horizon control tasks compared with HRL methods; specific benchmarks are not stated in the visible abstract.

DbQoA0Gqjg.one_liner: Structured pruning of a reasoning driving VLA combining reasoning and trajectory Taylor importance ranks and step-averaged expert MLP importance.
DbQoA0Gqjg.problem: Reasoning driving VLAs are costly in memory and compute, and the reasoning and trajectory objectives assign different importance to the same VLM structures, complicating pruning.
DbQoA0Gqjg.method: The method combines importance ranks from both objectives to prune the VLM and aggregates stepwise importance across denoising steps to keep a fixed subset of action-expert MLP channels.
DbQoA0Gqjg.key_idea: Merge Taylor importance ranks from reasoning and trajectory objectives for the VLM, and select expert MLP channels by importance averaged over denoising steps.
DbQoA0Gqjg.evidence: Importance analysis and pruning experiments on Alpamayo-1.5-10B, measured by LingoQA score, closed-loop scene scores, and open-loop errors.
DbQoA0Gqjg.claimed_gains: At 24.0% total parameter reduction, VLM-only pruning retains 94.0% of the dense LingoQA score; removing 93.75% of expert MLP channels reaches 39.4% reduction with a 1.37x end-to-end speedup and 36.6% lower peak memory.

BmBzEKHmk7.one_liner: Video inpainting that compresses non-mask context into compact features via learnable queries with position-aware attention, speeding up denoising.
BmBzEKHmk7.problem: Efficient video inpainting methods either summarize non-mask content into spatially coarse global features or estimate dense spatial features, trading computational efficiency against fine-grained context preservation.
BmBzEKHmk7.method: PACE assigns sparse spatial anchors to a small set of learnable queries that, through attention using content and relative spatiotemporal position, aggregate non-mask information from across the video into compact context features. An adaptive attention fusion mechanism balances this context with mask-side information.
BmBzEKHmk7.key_idea: Since masked queries attend to few non-mask tokens near the mask, replace dense non-mask tokens with anchor-initialized learnable queries that attend by content and relative spatiotemporal position.
BmBzEKHmk7.evidence: An attention analysis of masked-to-non-mask attention in a dense baseline, plus experiments on DAVIS, YouTube-VOS, and AdErase, a new benchmark (abstract is truncated).
BmBzEKHmk7.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract is truncated before the results.

6Cs0HydF0T.one_liner: Benchmark where a developer agent must build a complete customer-service agent from business records, client requirements, and serving-cost limits.
6Cs0HydF0T.problem: Existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver a deployable agent under the conditions of a real client engagement.
6Cs0HydF0T.method: The developer agent receives the records a business keeps, a client holding requirements, a codebase to inherit, and limits on serving cost and models, and must deliver a customer-service agent. The delivered agent is scored by deploying it against held-out simulated users across 53 tasks in four domains.
6Cs0HydF0T.key_idea: Make agent construction itself the task, and score the built agent by deploying it against held-out simulated users.
6Cs0HydF0T.evidence: 53 tasks across four domains, with developer configurations such as Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code compared against a human-authored reference.
6Cs0HydF0T.claimed_gains: The strongest developer configuration, Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code, passes just 23.9% of evaluation simulations versus 82.2% for a human-authored reference ceiling.

V5FhodWjJH.one_liner: Learns behavior embeddings from unlabeled manipulation videos via next-frame prediction, endpoint reconstruction, and status scoring, then regularizes policy action features.
V5FhodWjJH.problem: Robot policies act better when they know how the scene is changing, where that change leads, and how far the step has progressed, but learning this normally needs action, language, subtask, or progress annotations.
V5FhodWjJH.method: A frozen encoder trained on unlabeled videos produces embeddings with a motion channel and a scene configuration channel, with subprocess segments discovered at several granularities. During policy training, these embeddings are predicted from the policy's action features as a regularizer with no added inference cost.
V5FhodWjJH.key_idea: Predict frozen behavior embeddings (ongoing motion plus reached configuration) from the policy's action features during training as an auxiliary regularizer.
V5FhodWjJH.evidence: Experiments across vision-language-action and world-action models, a real-robot study with unseen instruction combinations and appearance changes, and probes of what the embeddings encode.
V5FhodWjJH.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract reports consistent improvements in task success without giving numbers.

M6TKIKETQ7.one_liner: Generates LoRA basis vectors from a per-matrix latent vector with lightweight radial basis functions instead of storing them explicitly.
M6TKIKETQ7.problem: Standard LoRA raises capacity only by adding rows or columns (basis vectors), which grows parameters substantially even though these vectors are redundant.
M6TKIKETQ7.method: GenLoRA keeps a latent vector for each low-rank matrix and uses a set of lightweight radial basis functions (RBFs) to synthesize the basis vectors, with each RBF needing far fewer parameters than an explicit basis vector.
M6TKIKETQ7.key_idea: Represent LoRA basis vectors as outputs of radial basis functions over a latent vector, so rank grows through generated nonlinear bases rather than stored parameters.
M6TKIKETQ7.evidence: Fine-tuning experiments across multiple datasets and architectures; specific models and datasets are not named in the abstract.
M6TKIKETQ7.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract only claims higher effective LoRA ranks under smaller parameter budgets and superior fine-tuning performance.

b7minttOfL.one_liner: Trains vision foundation models for cross-view consistency using the frozen opposite-view descriptor of a calibrated pair as teacher.
b7minttOfL.problem: Image-based pretraining does not make two observations of the same surface share a descriptor, and existing fixes use costly reconstruction with a rendered teacher that pulls student features away from pretrained coordinates and lowers frozen semantic transfer.
b7minttOfL.method: BridgeView uses the frozen opposite-view descriptor as the teacher on a same-surface pair formed by calibrated geometry, so consistency is set inside the pretrained coordinate system. When an encoder cell mixes neighboring instances, a bounded residual refines the readout within a cone of the frozen vector, and updates are coordinated across pairs observing one instance relation.
b7minttOfL.key_idea: Distill each pixel's descriptor toward the frozen descriptor of its geometric correspondence in the other view, with a bounded residual keeping it near the frozen vector.
b7minttOfL.evidence: Indoor RGB-D benchmarks across DINOv3 backbones for cross-view correspondence, semantic segmentation, visual localization, and TSDF map rendering, plus a pair-corpus scaling study from 640K to 3M pairs.
b7minttOfL.claimed_gains: Raises cross-view correspondence, semantic segmentation, visual localization, and TSDF map rendering across DINOv3 backbones and trains over 10x faster than SnD; no per-task figures are visible.

GLcsDJkibh.one_liner: Unifies speech separation and target speaker extraction via input composition on a pretrained speech foundation model.
GLcsDJkibh.problem: Existing unified SS/TSE systems tie source attribution to acoustic evidence or need repeated single-stream inference for multi-speaker separation without cross-stream coordination.
GLcsDJkibh.method: A pretrained speech foundation model acts as the separator: replicating the mixture representation instantiates multiple jointly decoded streams for SS, while prefixing an enrollment representation anchors one output stream to the target speaker for TSE. A conditional flow-matching module then restores acoustic detail, conditioning on both the separated representation and the mixture.
GLcsDJkibh.key_idea: Specify the task purely through input composition: replicate the mixture for multi-stream separation or prefix an enrollment for target extraction, so an unmodified single-stream SFM serves both.
GLcsDJkibh.evidence: Experimental datasets and settings are not stated in the available abstract text.

gLOLx4Nluw.one_liner: Foundation model for irregular multivariate time series using temporal manifold attention and frequency-aware cross-variable message passing.
gLOLx4Nluw.problem: Time series foundation models are built on regularly sampled sequences and generalize poorly to irregular time intervals and asynchronous cross-variable dependencies.
gLOLx4Nluw.method: QiYao-I maps real timestamps into a learnable temporal manifold feature space and injects the resulting biases into attention, and adds a dynamic variable interaction mechanism with frequency awareness that selectively passes messages across variables under asynchronous observations.
gLOLx4Nluw.key_idea: Inject learned manifold embeddings of real timestamps as attention biases, and gate cross-variable message passing by frequency under asynchronous sampling.
gLOLx4Nluw.evidence: Real-world irregular multivariate forecasting benchmarks, compared with time series foundation models and end-to-end irregular forecasting models in zero-shot and few-shot settings.
gLOLx4Nluw.claimed_gains: not stated (the abstract reports superior performance without numbers).

MulI3ett54.one_liner: Benchmark that scores captions on Coverage and Precision separately and tests which better predicts understanding versus text-to-image generation.
MulI3ett54.problem: Caption evaluations use a single scalar that conflates how much visual information a caption covers with how reliably the image supports its claims.
MulI3ett54.method: CAPEval uses human-written ground-truth captions and human-verified atomic checklist items to define Coverage (share of ground-truth content covered) and Precision (factual correctness rate of all claims). It runs controlled end-to-end downstream experiments with 16 captioners across four model families, with the caption source as the only variable.
MulI3ett54.key_idea: Separate caption quality into checklist-based Coverage and Precision, then correlate each with downstream understanding and generation performance.
MulI3ett54.evidence: 16 captioners and four model families in controlled end-to-end experiments on multimodal understanding and text-to-image generation.
MulI3ett54.claimed_gains: not stated; the reported finding is that Coverage is the stronger correlate for understanding and Precision the dominant predictor for generation.

UHFA411YHy.one_liner: Structured sparsification over nonlinear polynomial degrees to compress secure Transformer inference, with approximation-aware low-degree Softmax and GeLU.
UHFA411YHy.problem: Secure Transformer inference has heavy cryptographic cost from nonlinear operations like Softmax and GeLU, and stacking separate approximation, token-pruning, and model-pruning methods accumulates error under aggressive compression.
UHFA411YHy.method: DegreeSpar formulates secure Transformer compression as structured sparsification over nonlinear polynomial degrees, where zero-degree structures make token-level and model-dimension computation removable in the same space. Approximation-aware training for low-degree Softmax and GeLU enables aggressive degree reduction.
UHFA411YHy.key_idea: Treat polynomial degree as the single compression variable, with zero-degree structures removing tokens and dimensions, and train low-degree Softmax and GeLU approximations to allow aggressive reduction.
UHFA411YHy.evidence: Vision and language Transformers across model scales, tasks, and sequence lengths, plus a motivating test stacking approximation, token-pruning, and model-pruning methods on ViT-S.
UHFA411YHy.claimed_gains: Speedups from 2.29x to 6.63x (comparison baseline cut off in the abstract); stacking existing methods at matched compression lowers ViT-S accuracy from 80.20% to 76.41%.

5LLu9seteI.one_liner: Training-free closed-form wrapper for chunked-action VLAs that compresses execution pace and applies an orthogonal spatial offset to handle moving targets.
5LLu9seteI.problem: VLA models trained on single-frame observations are blind to temporal dynamics and degrade in non-stationary scenes, and existing fixes need retraining or suffer latency and poor temporal consistency across action chunks.
5LLu9seteI.method: Under a local motion model, jointly minimizing one quadratic cost gives an interior closed-form solution with two orthogonal channels: a pace channel compressing execution along the planned direction and a path channel adding an orthogonal spatial offset. It wraps any chunked-action VLA at inference.
5LLu9seteI.key_idea: Minimize one quadratic cost under a local motion model, giving orthogonal pace (along the plan) and path (perpendicular offset) corrections that absorb perceived motion within the action chunk.
5LLu9seteI.evidence: Evaluated on MoveBench, a diagnostic benchmark isolating motion as the controlled variable, against training-free wrappers and dynamic-adaptive baselines in dynamic-only and static-dynamic mixed environments.
5LLu9seteI.claimed_gains: Raises success by up to 28.8% and 25.9% in absolute terms over foundational VLAs in dynamic-only and static-dynamic mixed environments, respectively.

VbEXDQDQQF.one_liner: Characterizes unbounded growth of agentic prompts like CLAUDE.md and shows prompt comments encoding latent reasoning halt it.
VbEXDQDQQF.problem: Agentic coding READMEs such as CLAUDE.md grow without bound because appending an instruction is cheap, but deleting one without risking a regression costs O(2^|D|) once its rationale is gone.
VbEXDQDQQF.method: Names the divergence catastrophic remembering and measures instruction lifetimes in real repositories. Inverts IFEval and WildIFEval to build verifiable worlds with known optimal prompts, then tests prompt comments that encode latent reasoning.
VbEXDQDQQF.key_idea: Prompt comments that encode an instruction's latent reasoning let redundant instructions be removed without correctness regressions, halting growth.
VbEXDQDQQF.evidence: Analysis of 247,694 instruction lifetimes in 1,867 repositories, plus experiments on inverted IFEval and WildIFEval.
VbEXDQDQQF.claimed_gains: Prompts grow +226% over their lifetime with +4.9 net instructions per commit; comments remove 99.3% of excess instructions (+211.3% to +1.4%) and improve real-world instruction following by up to 23.1%.

TLNNzKnqLk.one_liner: Interpretable heterogeneous instrumented PCA whose factor loadings are built by a structured graph convolutional network.
TLNNzKnqLk.problem: Standard instrumented PCA, which anchors factors to a set of instruments such as treatments, neither supports individual heterogeneity nor yields interpretable factors.
TLNNzKnqLk.method: HeterIPCA constructs factor loadings with rich heterogeneity through a structured graph convolutional network (SGCN), with a nonasymptotic bound for parameter estimation and asymptotic normality for inference.
TLNNzKnqLk.key_idea: Parameterize instrument-anchored factor loadings with a structured graph convolutional network to capture individual heterogeneity while keeping factors interpretable, with estimation and inference guarantees.
TLNNzKnqLk.evidence: Theory (a nonasymptotic parameter-estimation bound and asymptotic normality) plus experiments on various evaluation metrics; datasets are not stated.
TLNNzKnqLk.claimed_gains: Claims best performance on various evaluation metrics; no numbers stated.

syLuDUAVe1.one_liner: Budget-constrained routing that picks which nodes with missing modalities get expensive recovery, scoring each switch by predicted correction versus harm.
syLuDUAVe1.problem: Expensive modality-recovery methods are applied uniformly to nodes with missing modalities, but they can turn correct predictions into errors even when overall performance improves.
syLuDUAVe1.method: R-SMR formulates selection as budget-constrained routing between cheap and expensive recovery endpoints. Using only cheap-path information at inference, it estimates probabilities of four joint correctness states, scores each switch by predicted correction versus harm, and selects the highest-scoring positive-utility nodes within budget, leaving budget unused when switches look unfavorable.
syLuDUAVe1.key_idea: Estimate probabilities of four joint correctness states from cheap-path information and send to expensive recovery only nodes whose predicted correction outweighs predicted harm.
syLuDUAVe1.evidence: Six datasets and five recovery methods, in globally beneficial and harmful recovery regimes, at a 5% budget, with comparisons to random routing (truncated).
syLuDUAVe1.claimed_gains: Outperforms the stronger endpoint by up to 4.10%, with improvements persisting at a 5% budget.

kqCLUujaMh.one_liner: Diagnostic study of multi-teacher on-policy distillation, comparing gradients, optimizer updates, and learning curves for Qwen3-1.7B with four RL-trained domain teachers.
kqCLUujaMh.problem: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation aims to combine RL-trained teachers in one student, but how teacher signals translate into parameter changes is underexplored.
kqCLUujaMh.method: Studies Qwen3-1.7B with four domain teachers trained with RL from the student's initialization, comparing raw gradients, optimizer updates, and task learning curves, with additional SmolLM3-3B diagnostics.
kqCLUujaMh.key_idea: Trace how loss-averaging rules, Adam's first moment, and BF16 rounding reshape teacher gradients before they become weight updates, and how top-64 KL gradients compare with full-vocabulary ones.
kqCLUujaMh.evidence: Qwen3-1.7B with four RL-trained domain teachers plus SmolLM3-3B diagnostics, measuring gradient, update, and accuracy differences.
kqCLUujaMh.claimed_gains: Cosine similarity of 0.83 between teachers and 0.96 between averaging rules; about 97% of FP32 master weights differ from initialization versus 7-11% of BF16 weights; top-64 KL gradient gives mathematics accuracy 2.6 points higher than sampled-token PG under response averaging and 2.1 points lower under global token averaging.

iFhsS1bWlx.one_liner: Deep-RL neuron recycling that refills released neuron pairs with two copies of an objective-chosen unreleased neuron, given opposite outgoing weights.
iFhsS1bWlx.problem: Neuron recycling resets under-utilized neurons to fight plasticity loss, but reinitializing them with objective-independent rules that zero outgoing weights leaves recycled neurons with little learning signal, so they return to dormancy.
iFhsS1bWlx.method: OPAIR keeps ReDo's activation-based release rule, proven to cause only a small objective perturbation, and replaces each pair of released neurons with two copies of an unreleased neuron chosen by the objective and assigned opposite outgoing weights. The paired construction preserves the network function.
iFhsS1bWlx.key_idea: Refill released neurons with paired copies of a donor neuron given opposite outgoing weights, preserving the function, with the donor chosen to maximize objective-aligned learning signal along feature-rescaling directions.
iFhsS1bWlx.evidence: 27 Atari and MuJoCo tasks, mechanism analyses of the paired construction and objective-guided donor selection, and a proof that the release rule causes a small objective perturbation.
iFhsS1bWlx.claimed_gains: Highest mean final return on every one of 27 Atari and MuJoCo tasks.

HPhZLm78dO.one_liner: Benchmark showing visual inputs alter VLM moral decisions, built on Moral Foundation Theory with orthogonally manipulated visual and contextual variables.
HPhZLm78dO.problem: Moral evaluation benchmarks are text-only and lack systematic control over variables influencing moral decisions, so it is unclear whether text-based safety alignment generalizes to visual inputs.
HPhZLm78dO.method: Moral Dilemma Simulation (MDS), a multimodal benchmark grounded in Moral Foundation Theory, enables mechanistic analysis by orthogonally manipulating visual and contextual variables.
HPhZLm78dO.key_idea: Orthogonally vary visual and contextual factors in Moral Foundation Theory dilemmas to isolate the effect of the vision modality on moral decisions.
HPhZLm78dO.evidence: Evaluation of VLMs on the MDS benchmark compared with text-only contexts; specific models are not named in the abstract.
HPhZLm78dO.claimed_gains: Finding: vision induces more intuition-like decisions and weaker deliberative sensitivity than text-only contexts; no numbers stated.

6bbDTp42pG.one_liner: Benchmark, metric, and flow-matching baseline for text-to-speech that takes separate speaker and environment references to control background sound and reverberation.
6bbDTp42pG.problem: Zero-shot TTS reference speech also captures its recording environment, so speaker identity and acoustic environment cannot be controlled independently, and no benchmark or metric evaluates background and reverberation similarity separately.
6bbDTp42pG.method: EnvTTS-Bench has 3,000 evaluation instances with independently specified speaker and environment references from real recordings, and EnvSim separately measures background and reverberation similarity. Two baselines are a training-free cascaded approach and EnvTTS-DiT, a flow-matching TTS model conditioned on separate speaker and environment references.
6bbDTp42pG.key_idea: Condition TTS on separate speaker and environment references, and score environment fidelity with a metric that splits background-sound similarity from reverberation similarity.
6bbDTp42pG.evidence: Objective and human evaluations on EnvTTS-Bench's 3,000 instances, showing EnvSim aligns strongly with human judgments (abstract truncated afterward).

A9wPaTiqh0.one_liner: Property-agnostic mixture model that predicts from separate composition-weighted component, pairwise interaction, and residual whole-mixture terms.
A9wPaTiqh0.problem: Interaction-learning methods fuse all signals into one embedding before prediction, hiding component-level versus mixed-level contributions, while physically motivated decompositions depend on property-specific equations that limit transfer.
A9wPaTiqh0.method: MIRA (Mixture Interaction and Residual Aggregation) performs prediction-level multi-scale decomposition, giving explicit predictive roles to composition-weighted constituents, molecular interactions, and residual whole-mixture effects within one common architecture across properties.
A9wPaTiqh0.key_idea: Decompose the prediction itself, not the embedding, into composition-weighted constituent, pairwise interaction, and residual whole-mixture contributions under a shared architecture.
A9wPaTiqh0.evidence: 11 CheMixHub tasks, plus external mixture-property datasets for surface tension and electrolyte properties.
A9wPaTiqh0.claimed_gains: Lowest or tied-lowest mean test MAE across 11 CheMixHub tasks at the reported precision, reducing five-fold MAE by up to 61.0%.

McYjA5cHt6.one_liner: Full-support discrete diffusion over high-dimensional dimension-wise quantized visual representations for efficient parallel generation.
McYjA5cHt6.problem: Dimension-wise quantization yields an enormous, redundant product code space where direct joint modeling is intractable, and parallel factorization creates a mismatch between the product of coordinate-wise marginals and the joint distribution that worsens as sampling steps decrease.
McYjA5cHt6.method: CUDiT (Cubic Uniform Diffusion Transformer) is a full-support discrete diffusion framework for parallel generation of high-dimensional representation cubes, denoising through continuous-time dynamics (description truncated in the abstract).
McYjA5cHt6.key_idea: Replace absorbing diffusion with a full-support discrete diffusion over representation cubes, targeting the marginal-versus-joint mismatch that grows as parallel updates get larger.
McYjA5cHt6.evidence: The visible abstract includes an analysis of the mismatch between the product of coordinate-wise marginals and the joint distribution; benchmarks and results are truncated.

7E9jt5PQ7S.one_liner: Privileged facts answer unasked questions in training; a frozen diagnostic scorer converts them into relative question credit for RL.
7E9jt5PQ7S.problem: Outcome-based RL with final diagnostic correctness does not separate the contributions of individual questions and gives no feedback on questions the agent did not ask.
7E9jt5PQ7S.method: At the same dialogue state, PCQC uses privileged patient facts to construct answers to alternative questions, and a frozen diagnostic scorer rates each question-answer pair by how strongly it supports the correct diagnosis. The comparisons become relative question credit that supervises executed and unexecuted questions alongside outcome-based RL, without full rollouts for the alternatives.
7E9jt5PQ7S.key_idea: Construct answers to alternative questions from privileged patient facts at the same dialogue state, then rank them by a frozen scorer's support for the correct diagnosis.
7E9jt5PQ7S.evidence: Experiments across four medical benchmarks (abstract truncated).
7E9jt5PQ7S.claimed_gains: Achieves 63.10% mean (metric cut off in the abstract) across four medical benchmarks; the TL;DR also claims lower inquiry cost.

2QfHzj4IXp.one_liner: Incomplete multi-view clustering that recovers missing views by a structure-guided drift from observed-view anchors toward the target-view distribution.
2QfHzj4IXp.problem: Existing incomplete multi-view clustering recovers missing information by feature estimation, cross-view averaging, or neighborhood transfer, which can overlook the target-view distribution and weaken sample correspondence, and rarely accounts for the reliability of recovered representations.
2QfHzj4IXp.method: ATDA takes shared semantics from observed views as a cross-view reference and learns a structure-guided drift toward the target-view distribution. Pseudo-missing self-supervision estimates recovery reliability to reduce the influence of inaccurate completions during fusion, and structural alignment with prototype-driven clustering gives feedback.
2QfHzj4IXp.key_idea: Learn a structure-guided drift from observed-view anchors to the target view, and estimate completion reliability through pseudo-missing self-supervision before fusing.
2QfHzj4IXp.evidence: Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets under multiple missing rates (results truncated).

A4hvw8DWqp.one_liner: One-step diffusion for panoramic super-resolution: full-context forward pass with a selectively constructed training-memory autograd graph.
A4hvw8DWqp.problem: Blind panoramic super-resolution needs scene-wide coherence from full panoramic context, which is costly: processing isolated regions fragments context, and even a one-step diffusion baseline needs over 80 GB of GPU memory for full-panorama fine-tuning.
A4hvw8DWqp.method: PanoForcing selectively constructs the training-memory-related autograd graph while keeping full-context forward computation, under configurable training and inference memory budgets, and adds lightweight observation guidance within a single network pass to constrain generated details.
A4hvw8DWqp.key_idea: Run the forward pass over the full panorama but construct only part of the autograd graph under a configurable memory budget, with lightweight observation guidance in the same pass.
A4hvw8DWqp.evidence: Experiments across a range of controllable memory budgets, compared with other methods on WS-PSNR, LPIPS, and FID.
A4hvw8DWqp.claimed_gains: Best WS-PSNR, LPIPS, and FID among the compared methods; no values stated, and the baseline needs over 80 GB for full-panorama fine-tuning.

VKevrwBnq4.one_liner: Counterfactual support field gates lesion-focused restoration in undersampled MR and sparse-view CT reconstruction.
VKevrwBnq4.problem: Whole-image fidelity objectives ignore that equal-magnitude reconstruction errors have different diagnostic consequences by location, leaving lesions degraded under aggressive undersampling.
VKevrwBnq4.method: CSF-Recon trains a teacher on fully sampled images with counterfactual alignment so its lesion-restricted class responses supervise a student field predicted from a physics-driven coarse reconstruction. The student field gates microstructure restoration, local refinement, and local diagnostic pooling while keeping global context; the teacher and lesion annotations are needed only in training.
VKevrwBnq4.key_idea: A student-predicted counterfactual support field, supervised by a teacher's lesion-restricted class responses, gates restoration and diagnostic pooling toward decision-relevant regions.
VKevrwBnq4.evidence: Experiments on fastMRI+ and LIDC-IDRI at 16-fold acceleration (radial MR undersampling, sparse-view CT), plus an analysis bounding diagnostic-margin degradation by error weighted by spatial decision sensitivity; the abstract is truncated.
VKevrwBnq4.claimed_gains: Highest mean accuracy and AUC among evaluated methods at 16-fold acceleration on fastMRI+ and LIDC-IDRI; the rest of the sentence is truncated and no other numbers are visible.

CewABh0Frn.one_liner: Paired sim-and-real visuo-tactile manipulation benchmark, plus OpenVTLA tactile augmentation for pretrained VLA policies.
CewABh0Frn.problem: Despite progress in vision-tactile-language-action policies, no unified benchmark evaluates tactile-enabled manipulation across simulation and the real world.
CewABh0Frn.method: OpenViTac organizes contact-rich manipulation into four tactile-relevant capability dimensions with paired simulation and real-world settings for VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies. The authors compare tactile representations and integration strategies on pretrained VLAs, combine the best ones into OpenVTLA, and study sim-real co-training.
CewABh0Frn.key_idea: Pair simulation and real-world tasks under four capability dimensions so tactile representations, integration strategies, and sim-real co-training can be compared under consistent evaluation.
CewABh0Frn.evidence: Benchmark evaluation of VLA, WAM, and VTLA policies in paired simulated and real settings, with studies of tactile representations, integration strategies, and sim-real co-training; no datasets, robots, or metrics are named in the abstract.

wGImJC6uqi.one_liner: Injects the point-cloud render into flow matching's initial noise, using the source video as the only visual condition.
wGImJC6uqi.problem: In video re-shooting, the point-cloud render and the source video are both given as conditions, and their conflicting cues (a trust dilemma) persist through denoising, which can hurt trajectory control, 3D consistency, or visual quality.
wGImJC6uqi.method: Manifold4D lifts the source video to a 4D point cloud, renders it along the target trajectory, and uses the render once to build a geometry-bearing initial noise distribution (the point cloud rendered manifold) for flow matching. The source video remains the only visual condition, so the network never has to learn to read the render.
wGImJC6uqi.key_idea: Because the render is pixel-aligned with the target view, encode it once in the initial noise instead of conditioning on it at every denoising step.
wGImJC6uqi.evidence: The abstract (truncated) argues for the design; the TL;DR says it attains the best camera control, but benchmarks and baselines are not visible.
wGImJC6uqi.claimed_gains: TL;DR claims the best camera control; no numbers are stated.

07845oTvhG.one_liner: Equivariant Gaussian-shell electron density model with exact electron-number conservation for property prediction and SCF initialization.
07845oTvhG.problem: Electron-density predictors must feed property evaluation and SCF solvers and transfer across molecular sizes, functionals, and basis sets.
07845oTvhG.method: GEM-Field represents density as equivariant Gaussian shells with learnable radial parameters, nonlinear angular distributions, and exact electron-number conservation. The Gaussian expansion gives efficient analytical and numerical Coulomb integrals for target atomic-orbital bases, linking predicted densities to property evaluation and SCF solvers.
07845oTvhG.key_idea: Expand the density in charge-conserving equivariant Gaussian shells so Coulomb integrals are cheap and the density plugs directly into AO-basis SCF solvers.
07845oTvhG.evidence: QM9-PBE, OE62 (larger molecules, extrapolation), and SCFBench out-of-distribution molecules with up to 60 atoms, compared with Hamiltonian predictors, machine-learned interatomic potentials, and property models; transfer across AO bases and exchange-correlation functionals.
07845oTvhG.claimed_gains: Normalized MAE as low as 0.037% on QM9-PBE level-3 grids; on SCFBench OOD molecules, 100% convergence, up to 43.2% fewer SCF iterations, and up to 21.15% lower end-to-end runtime relative to MINAO.

LRwge72KWz.one_liner: Reallocates routed-expert counts across layers of pretrained MoE LLMs via closed-form sensitivity analysis, without retraining.
LRwge72KWz.problem: Sparse MoE Transformers fix the same number of routed experts in every layer, ignoring heterogeneous layer-wise redundancy.
LRwge72KWz.method: MAPLE probes each layer's sensitivity to expert count and derives a closed-form budget assignment that gives more experts to sensitive layers and fewer to redundant ones, refined by a sensitivity-constrained genetic search. It also adds a top-1 routing GPU kernel integrated into SGLang and vLLM; no expert weights are modified, removed, or retrained.
LRwge72KWz.key_idea: Measure per-layer sensitivity to expert count and allocate the routed-expert budget non-uniformly, using sensitivity as a prior to guide genetic search.
LRwge72KWz.evidence: Four MoE models of different scales and architectures, including DeepSeek-MoE-16B, under a 75% total expert-activation budget against uniform and pruning-based baselines; the abstract is truncated.
LRwge72KWz.claimed_gains: Outperforms uniform and pruning-based baselines under a 75% total expert-activation budget on four MoE models; the DeepSeek-MoE-16B result is cut off in the abstract.

8LWwm8E4gm.one_liner: Multimodal reasoning harness combining heterogeneous tool interfaces with persistent multimodal memory and a code interface for MLLMs.
8LWwm8E4gm.problem: Many visual tasks need evidence (grounded perception, external knowledge, numerical measurements) that internal reasoning cannot supply, and a pilot study on 12 benchmarks found that more inference budget gives only modest gains.
8LWwm8E4gm.method: A capability layer provides task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering that converts tool outputs into model-readable observations, while persistent multimodal memory keeps images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts. A coding interface runs generated programs over stored data to combine results from multiple tools.
8LWwm8E4gm.key_idea: Store tool outputs as addressable multimodal artifacts and let generated code compose them, so evidence is acquired, inspected, and combined across reasoning steps.
8LWwm8E4gm.evidence: Evaluated on 23 benchmarks across perception, spatial reasoning, visual search, and multimodal question answering against strong MLLM baselines; the abstract is truncated.
8LWwm8E4gm.claimed_gains: Consistently surpasses strong MLLM baselines across 23 benchmarks; the sentence is truncated and no numeric gains are visible.

bBqqgUNRaV.one_liner: Open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders at seven compressions for interactive video world models.
bBqqgUNRaV.problem: World models usually reuse autoencoders built for offline text-to-video generation, which ignore action latency and cannot be retrained at other compressions without their data and code.
bBqqgUNRaV.method: CADRE members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. The same world model is trained on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each.
bBqqgUNRaV.key_idea: Vary only a small bottleneck on frozen features while sharing a few-step self-distilled diffusion decoder, isolating how compression affects world-model quality and latency.
bBqqgUNRaV.evidence: One world model trained per autoencoder in manipulation and navigation (two environments each), measuring the latency-quality frontier; four findings are listed but the abstract is truncated.
bBqqgUNRaV.claimed_gains: CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera; no numeric values are stated.

7AbJW0nqDE.one_liner: Neural operator assigning dedicated latent basis groups to distinct intra- and inter-solid interactions in multi-solid contact simulation.
7AbJW0nqDE.problem: Transformer neural operators compress physical fields into one shared latent space that entangles intra- and inter-solid couplings, limiting interaction-specific expressiveness, especially with scarce data.
7AbJW0nqDE.method: SolidX organizes latent physical bases around heterogeneous interaction patterns, giving each pattern a dedicated basis group, inspired by structured decomposition in classical computational mechanics. It retains linear complexity.
7AbJW0nqDE.key_idea: Partition the latent physical bases into groups dedicated to specific interaction patterns instead of using one shared set of latent tokens.
7AbJW0nqDE.evidence: Five multi-solid benchmarks compared against strong baselines on prediction accuracy, convergence efficiency, and a sample-related metric (abstract truncated).
7AbJW0nqDE.claimed_gains: Consistently outperforms strong baselines in prediction accuracy and convergence efficiency across five multi-solid benchmarks; the sample-related claim is cut off and no numbers are stated.

ZLmhPBvkr1.one_liner: Replaces depth-based point-cloud lifting with a fine-tuned LVSM-style transformer that renders egocentric conditioning for video diffusion.
ZLmhPBvkr1.problem: Exocentric-to-egocentric video generation has little view overlap, and depth errors in point-cloud lifting project pixels to wrong locations in the conditioning render.
ZLmhPBvkr1.method: A fine-tuned LVSM-style transformer renders the egocentric view directly, learning cross-view correspondence through the rendering loss without depth estimation, point-cloud construction, or reprojection. Its probabilistic mapping averages candidate source locations, which keeps structure but blurs fine texture, and a video diffusion model then recovers the details.
ZLmhPBvkr1.key_idea: Condition the diffusion model on a learned, spatially aligned but blurry render, because spatial alignment matters more than sharpness for conditioning.
ZLmhPBvkr1.evidence: The abstract is truncated before the experiments; datasets, baselines, and metrics are not visible.

mtzTwrmFEu.one_liner: Jointly trains a pair encoder and diffusion editor so a short continuous edit code captures a reusable visual transformation.
mtzTwrmFEu.problem: An image pair shows a change precisely but binds it to the original image's identity, layout, and texture, and existing systems need matched demonstration-query training or pretrained feature spaces such as CLIP or SigLIP.
mtzTwrmFEu.method: A pair encoder compresses an original and edited image into a few continuous tokens (the edit code), and a diffusion editor reconstructs the edited image from the original plus that code. Training uses no text and applies each code only to its own pair; at inference the code applies the change to new images.
mtzTwrmFEu.key_idea: Force reconstruction of the edited image through a short continuous bottleneck so the code keeps the transformation and drops image-specific details.
mtzTwrmFEu.evidence: The abstract reports analyses of code length (reconstruction fidelity versus transfer and grouping by transformation), averaging over demonstrations, and combining two codes; datasets and metrics are not stated.

XHPC3j2yB3.one_liner: Unified world action model combining a video expert, action expert, frozen VLM guidance, and 4D distillation in a directed Mixture-of-Transformers.
XHPC3j2yB3.problem: World Action Models must integrate complementary pretrained priors (visual dynamics, scene semantics, geometry and motion) into one framework for generalist robot manipulation.
XHPC3j2yB3.method: A World-Action MoT pairs a pretrained video expert with an action expert under semantic guidance from a frozen VLM, while a pretrained 4D foundation model injects geometric and motion priors through training-only distillation. Causal Imprint learns future-relevant scene changes from training-only future supervision, giving the action expert predictive representations without future-video rollout at inference.
XHPC3j2yB3.key_idea: Distill future-relevant scene changes into action-expert representations during training only (Causal Imprint), avoiding future-video rollout at inference.
XHPC3j2yB3.evidence: Joint training on a heterogeneous corpus including robot demonstrations, UMI data, and egocentric human demonstrations; the abstract is truncated before results.

HXbGmZdln4.one_liner: Fine-tunes video diffusion transformers on 2D gear trains and shows they learn BFS-like or divide-and-conquer kinematic reasoning.
HXbGmZdln4.problem: Off-the-shelf video diffusion transformers fail to generate physically plausible gear motion even with two gears, since each gear's rotation direction requires traversing the kinematic chain to compute parity.
HXbGmZdln4.method: Uses 2D involute gear trains as a testbed to fine-tune and analyze off-the-shelf video DiTs. With short kinematic heights the model uses transformer layers as parallel BFS steps to determine parity; with large heights it first resolves parity within local neighborhoods and then continues with a step that is cut off in the abstract.
HXbGmZdln4.key_idea: Probe how fine-tuned video DiTs compute gear rotational parity: layers act as parallel BFS steps for short chains and as divide-and-conquer for tall ones.
HXbGmZdln4.evidence: Fine-tuning and interpretability analysis of off-the-shelf video DiTs on a 2D involute gear-train testbed with varying kinematic heights.

k8gK45MTbv.one_liner: Reuses in-flight KV caches across pipelined GPUs and adds sparse clean anchor latents to speed autoregressive video diffusion.
k8gK45MTbv.problem: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion rebuilds clean or less-noisy KV caches with extra forwards that do not advance an output latent, which is costly.
k8gK45MTbv.method: FlashForward reuses the KV already computed in each denoising forward, so a chunk's stage-specific cache is ready for the next chunk after one stage and one GPU per stage lets chunks occupy different stages concurrently. Sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents, produced before their region is generated, give two-sided conditioning that offsets drift from the noisy stage-matched history.
k8gK45MTbv.key_idea: Reuse stage-matched in-flight KV for pipelined chunk generation, and stabilize the noisy history with sparse clean-anchor KV for long-range two-sided guidance.
k8gK45MTbv.evidence: The abstract describes the method with up to four GPUs but is truncated before the experiments, so models and benchmarks are not visible.

53STjMynES.one_liner: Plug-in module that completes latent geometry tokens of unobserved views in one flow-matching step for frozen feed-forward 3DGS.
53STjMynES.problem: Feed-forward 3DGS degrades sharply with few input images because its internal tokens carry no evidence for unobserved regions, causing holes, floaters, and blur, and generating extra views as pixels is costly and not 3D-consistent.
53STjMynES.method: DensiTok compresses the pretrained model's geometry tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens for the frozen reconstruction heads. It needs no image synthesis or extra encoder passes.
53STjMynES.key_idea: Densify internal geometry tokens in a compact latent space via camera-conditioned flow matching, rather than synthesizing extra view pixels.
53STjMynES.evidence: Designed to attach to different pretrained feed-forward 3DGS predictors with frozen backbones; the abstract is truncated before the results.

Ot1sGn9Wbp.one_liner: Extracts reusable visual design skills from open-web sites into a multi-parent DAG library to guide LLM website generation.
Ot1sGn9Wbp.problem: Non-expert users struggle to express sophisticated visual and interaction designs in natural language, while mature web implementations already embody that design knowledge.
Ot1sGn9Wbp.method: WebViSE abstracts website implementations into Visual Skills in a structured library organized as a multi-parent DAG, and jointly evolves Skill descriptions and DAG structure using Skill-conditioned Potential Queries. Skills can be injected as plug-and-play guidance or used in a data-synthesis pipeline to train open-source models.
Ot1sGn9Wbp.key_idea: Evolve skill descriptions and DAG structure together using skill-conditioned potential queries so user instructions match relevant skills efficiently.
Ot1sGn9Wbp.evidence: Retrieval comparison against non-hierarchical LLM retrieval baselines with Qwen3.8-Max; the abstract is truncated before the remaining experiments.
Ot1sGn9Wbp.claimed_gains: The auto-evolved structure outperforms non-hierarchical LLM retrieval baselines at only 39.09% of the estimated retrieval cost with Qwen3.8-Max.

mRALfLTZ76.one_liner: Margin-aware latent diffusion with reward-guided adaptation using non-differentiable contact and clearance rewards for dental crown generation.
mRALfLTZ76.problem: Crown synthesis needs both anatomical morphology and precise functional relations to neighboring and opposing teeth, which reconstruction-driven generative objectives alone capture poorly.
mRALfLTZ76.method: CrownGen takes raw intraoral scans through margin-aware latent diffusion and ambiguity-preserving morphology refinement to produce anatomically coherent crowns, then adapts with non-differentiable physical rewards from proximal contact and occlusal clearance to improve functional validity.
mRALfLTZ76.key_idea: Adapt a crown generator with non-differentiable physical rewards (proximal contact, occlusal clearance) after a morphology-generation stage.
mRALfLTZ76.evidence: Experiments and professional user studies against learning-based baselines; datasets and sample sizes are not stated.
mRALfLTZ76.claimed_gains: Claims superior geometric fidelity, anatomical realism, functional validity, and clinical acceptability over learning-based baselines; no numbers are stated.

p5qjVW50th.one_liner: Instruction-conditioned encoder recursively rewrites its query from retrieved results and aggregates evidence scores over the retrieval tree.
p5qjVW50th.problem: Single-hop and multi-hop retrieval need the same per-step decisions (what to search next, how to organize evidence), yet encoder training and inference remain scenario-specific.
p5qjVW50th.method: RDR trains an instruction-conditioned encoder to map a retrieval goal and observed artifacts into a dense next-step query; repeated encoding and index lookups build a retrieval tree, and rankings come from aggregating evidence scores across its nodes. The RDR-8B encoder is trained on Recursive Retrieval Worlds, a 4.75 million-sample dataset built from existing retrieval data, contextual transformations, constructed worlds, and recovery supervision.
p5qjVW50th.key_idea: Embed the instruction in the state so one encoder emits next-step queries, building a retrieval tree whose node scores are aggregated into rankings.
p5qjVW50th.evidence: RDR-8B evaluated on a wide range of single- and multi-hop benchmarks; the abstract is truncated before specifics.
p5qjVW50th.claimed_gains: TL;DR says it outperforms multi-hop specialists and improves single-hop retrieval across tasks; no numbers are visible.

1hA3HMyD74.one_liner: Trains vision-language models to verify and revise answers using GRPO plus on-policy distillation from a correctness-conditioned teacher.
1hA3HMyD74.problem: Models need to verify and correct their own predictions in multi-turn video reasoning without access to privileged feedback.
1hA3HMyD74.method: Multi-Agent Dataset Filtering builds supervision from multi-agent reasoning trajectories with agent-based evaluation and human verification. Reflective Multi-Turn Training retains mixed-outcome samples and jointly optimizes with GRPO and CCOPD, where the teacher is conditioned on correctness as privileged information and gives token-level supervision along the student's on-policy trajectory.
1hA3HMyD74.key_idea: Condition the teacher on answer correctness as privileged information and distill token-level supervision along the student's own on-policy trajectory.
1hA3HMyD74.evidence: Evaluated on 13 benchmarks across short-video understanding, long-video understanding, video reasoning, and temporal grounding.
1hA3HMyD74.claimed_gains: Reports broadly competitive performance across all 13 benchmarks; no numbers are stated.

X4BJt2ZDtF.one_liner: Feature upsampler using signed-weight differential kernels instead of softmax-normalized positive weights to sharpen boundaries.
X4BJt2ZDtF.problem: Content-aware feature upsamplers preserve detail but give ambiguous boundaries because softmax kernel normalization yields positive-only weights that suppress boundary sharpness.
X4BJt2ZDtF.method: DiffUp introduces signed weights and differential kernels, inspired by zero-mean filters, to amplify differences. The paper establishes conditional guarantees for when and where the kernels enhance detail versus perform local averaging, depending on the spatial distribution of the weights.
X4BJt2ZDtF.key_idea: Replace positive-only softmax kernel weights with signed differential kernels whose spatial distribution decides detail amplification versus local averaging.
X4BJt2ZDtF.evidence: Controlled experiments and four dense prediction tasks, compared with dynamic upsamplers and bilinear interpolation, including boundary IoU on COCONut.
X4BJt2ZDtF.claimed_gains: Outperforms or matches existing dynamic upsamplers, and improves boundary IoU on COCONut by up to 4.95% over bilinear interpolation.

Tp6EgV7NEH.one_liner: Jointly predicts supervoxels and pairwise affinities so neuron segmentation reduces to simple affinity-driven agglomeration.
Tp6EgV7NEH.problem: Neuron segmentation methods rely on complex post-processing pipelines needing careful hyperparameter tuning, and inconsistent dataset splits and evaluation settings hinder comparison.
