Tp6EgV7NEH.method: SNAP jointly predicts supervoxels and their mutual affinities so inference is a simple affinity-driven agglomeration. The authors also revisit evaluation protocols and clarify inconsistencies in dataset splits and settings.
Tp6EgV7NEH.key_idea: Predict supervoxels and their pairwise affinities in one network so agglomeration needs no complex post-processing.
Tp6EgV7NEH.evidence: AC3/AC4 and FIB-25 benchmarks, with inference time compared against conventional affinity-based approaches and robustness checked across imaging modalities and dataset scales.
Tp6EgV7NEH.claimed_gains: Claims leading results on AC3/AC4 and FIB-25 with inference time comparable to conventional affinity-based approaches; no numbers are stated.

tK0TjHCr48.one_liner: Driving world-action model with asymmetric attention between video and action experts, needing only action prediction at inference.
tK0TjHCr48.problem: World-action models usually need explicit future observation generation during action inference, adding overhead, and model futures in semantic or 2D visual spaces with weak spatial grounding.
tK0TjHCr48.method: Metis couples video generation and action experts through asymmetric attention, so future video representations attend to action representations but not the reverse, keeping future-modeling supervision without stochastic video generation at inference. Training-only spatial registers add depth and occupancy supervision.
tK0TjHCr48.key_idea: Mask the video-to-action dependency with asymmetric attention and add training-only spatial registers so inference needs only action prediction.
tK0TjHCr48.evidence: Experiments on NAVSIM-v2 and CityWalker, action-inference latency compared with full world-action generation, and zero-shot real-world deployment; the abstract is truncated.
tK0TjHCr48.claimed_gains: Strong performance on NAVSIM-v2 and CityWalker with substantially reduced action-inference latency versus full world-action generation; no numbers are stated.

n2MF6Stw8V.one_liner: Agents self-improve by distilling an EMA teacher's higher-budget, feedback-informed decisions into the zero-lookahead student on-policy.
n2MF6Stw8V.problem: Complex open-ended tasks lack verifiable outcomes or reliable external supervision, so agents cannot depend on task rewards, expert trajectories, or stronger teachers to improve.
n2MF6Stw8V.method: At selected student-visited states, the student explores alternative actions under a larger interaction budget, and an EMA teacher uses the resulting environment feedback to make a better-informed decision that is distilled into the student. Supervision is per decision step, with no task rewards, value estimates, or full-trajectory outcomes.
n2MF6Stw8V.key_idea: Distill step-level decisions made by an EMA teacher with extra lookahead interaction budget into the student at states the student visits.
n2MF6Stw8V.evidence: ALFWorld experiments without task rewards or expert supervision during training; the abstract is truncated afterward.
n2MF6Stw8V.claimed_gains: On ALFWorld the student's task success rate rises from 28.4% to 90.3%, and the higher-budget teacher's from 76.9% to 96.3%.

Crp06t8RPb.one_liner: CertID certifies causal-identifiability benchmark labels with the ID algorithm and verifies formulas against exact causal effects in SCMs.
Crp06t8RPb.problem: Measuring whether reasoning models answer non-identifiable causal queries unsoundly needs provably non-identifiable queries and grading that accepts equivalent formulas, and prior evaluations lack both.
Crp06t8RPb.method: CertID uses the sound and complete ID algorithm to certify identifiability from a graph and query, and checks each returned formula by comparing its value with the true causal effect computed exactly in structural causal models with explicit latent variables. It adds theory to mitigate structural leakage, repair non-identifiable queries, and establish grading guarantees.
Crp06t8RPb.key_idea: Label queries by theorem (ID-algorithm certification) and grade formulas by numeric equality with the exact causal effect rather than string matching.
Crp06t8RPb.evidence: Three frontier reasoning models (Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, GPT-5.5) evaluated on 1,200 certified instances with 4 to 50 vertices.
Crp06t8RPb.claimed_gains: On identical instances the false-claim rate on non-identifiable queries varies seventeen-fold across models, and models decide identifiability with 97-100% accuracy on a setting that is cut off in the abstract.

YyKTjdAuw5.one_liner: Proves equally weighted cumulative superposition preserves the full reasoning history in a smaller latent width than frontier-only superposition.
YyKTjdAuw5.problem: There is no clear principle for what a continuous latent reasoning state should preserve and how alternatives should be weighted as reasoning proceeds.
YyKTjdAuw5.method: Theory for a Transformer that carries one thought between steps: an equally weighted cumulative state can select the correct answer at smaller width than a frontier-only state, and equal weights minimize worst-case width over queries of bounded concentration. Experiments test the predicted width advantage.
YyKTjdAuw5.key_idea: Keep an equally weighted cumulative superposition of all reached results rather than only the current frontier, since contributions reinforce each other at readout.
YyKTjdAuw5.evidence: Minimax-optimality proofs plus experiments on graph search and financial program dependencies with models from two-layer Transformers to 14B-parameter pretrained routers, and on science proofs.

d8rnvJ77pH.one_liner: Self-evolving multi-agent subtitle translator with series-level memory, graph routing, and a judge-refiner loop that updates agent prompts.
d8rnvJ77pH.problem: Long-form subtitle translation needs long-range discourse and cultural context plus consistent terminology and style across episodes, which sentence-level single-LLM methods and static multi-agent workflows do not provide.
d8rnvJ77pH.method: In test-time training, SMART builds a persistent series-level memory and translates a subset of sentences through a dynamic graph router and a Mixture-of-Agents layer with tool modules for terminology verification, subtitle constraint validation, and contextual retrieval. A judge-refiner loop scores candidates and back-propagates textual critiques to refine agent prompts and the routing policy without retraining the underlying LLMs.
d8rnvJ77pH.key_idea: Refine agent prompts and routing policy from judge-generated textual critiques during test-time training, backed by persistent series-level memory.
d8rnvJ77pH.evidence: Evaluated with the proposed Subtitle Arena and AutoMQM across 15 translation directions, per the TL;DR.
d8rnvJ77pH.claimed_gains: 6.9% lower average MQM penalty across 15 translation directions.

DVmlxs4CST.one_liner: Tracks pending tasks with a Progressive Task-State Graph so LLMs execute when information suffices and flag missing information otherwise.
DVmlxs4CST.problem: Dialogue LLMs that cannot proactively recall information act with fabricated values when information is insufficient, or stay inactive although the history already contains enough.
DVmlxs4CST.method: ARDSE (Active Recall through Dynamic State Evolution) dynamically monitors pending task states through a Progressive Task-State Graph and uses evidence-conditioned activation to pick which task to recall in multi-task conversations. PTE-Bench supplies 2,268 long conversations and 10,639 evaluation instances over four conversation scenarios.
DVmlxs4CST.key_idea: Maintain an evolving task-state graph and activate recall of a pending task only when conversation evidence supports it.
DVmlxs4CST.evidence: Experiments on PTE-Bench with four LLM backbones and five representative baselines.
DVmlxs4CST.claimed_gains: ARDSE achieves the best performance across four LLM backbones and five baselines; no numeric gains are stated.

yW1ozHEaaK.one_liner: Backward search finds four-channel fixed subsets of frozen DINOv3 features that nearly match full-representation segmentation.
yW1ozHEaaK.problem: Frozen vision foundation model features are used in full for segmentation, and random-subset analyses leave open whether rare native supports can sustain strong performance at extreme sparsity.
yW1ozHEaaK.method: Defines a support as a fixed dataset-level subset of the original feature channels, physically removes the other channels, discards the discovery model, and trains a fresh decoder from scratch. A coarse-to-fine backward search with fresh-decoder acceptance identifies candidate supports.
yW1ozHEaaK.key_idea: Search for dataset-level channel subsets of the native feature basis, accepting a candidate only if a freshly trained decoder retains accuracy.
yW1ozHEaaK.evidence: ACDC with frozen DINOv3 features, 512 uniformly sampled four-channel baselines, an unseen-patient test, ten additional discovery runs, and an exclusion search; the abstract is truncated.
yW1ozHEaaK.claimed_gains: Four of 384 channels reach development Dice 0.787 versus 0.807 for the full representation and retain 95.2% of full-decoder Dice on unseen patients, while none of 512 random four-channel supports reaches 0.787.

CUUoqxUY1o.one_liner: Limits Muon fine-tuning updates along principal output singular directions using a plasticity-weighted anisotropic norm constraint.
CUUoqxUY1o.problem: Fine-tuning an Adam-pretrained checkpoint with Muon can underperform fine-tuning with Adam (optimizer mismatch), which limits Muon in post-training.
CUUoqxUY1o.method: SMS performs steepest descent under a plasticity-weighted anisotropic norm constraint that limits movement along principal output directions encoding foundational structure. It follows an analysis showing that pretrained weights read from input directions tied to spectral outliers beyond the Marchenko-Pastur edges and write mainly into the principal left singular subspace.
CUUoqxUY1o.key_idea: Constrain Muon steepest descent with an anisotropic norm that restricts motion along the principal left-singular output directions of pretrained weights.
CUUoqxUY1o.evidence: Experiments across Adam-pretrained model families comparing pretrained-capability preservation and downstream adaptation with matched Adam and standard Muon fine-tuning; specifics are not visible.
CUUoqxUY1o.claimed_gains: Consistently improves pretrained capability preservation while matching or exceeding downstream adaptation of matched Adam or standard Muon fine-tuning; no numbers are stated.

mSTc6wNtcr.one_liner: Video world model carrying a dense Eulerian grid and Lagrangian carriers as evolving memory, gated between transported and new content.
mSTc6wNtcr.problem: Video world models lack an explicit mechanism for inertial state evolution, so repeated reconstruction during autoregressive rollouts accumulates errors and destabilizes the predicted dynamics.
mSTc6wNtcr.method: Inertial Memory holds a dense Eulerian grid of scene-aligned evidence and persistent Lagrangian carriers bound to learned canonical coordinates. Each step transports carrier content with action-conditioned motion, predicts the next video state from carriers and grid, and uses a learned gate to merge transported and newly predicted content into the next memory.
mSTc6wNtcr.key_idea: Carry existing scene content forward by action-conditioned transport and gate it against new predictions, instead of reconstructing everything at each step.
mSTc6wNtcr.evidence: Experiments across robot manipulation, 3D game simulation, and open-world navigation; the abstract is truncated before results.

iMOmWcPKsM.one_liner: Identifies domain-specialized experts in multimodal MoEs by decoding router weights into vocabulary tokens, then fine-tunes only those experts.
iMOmWcPKsM.problem: It is unclear whether MoE sparsity gives rise to intrinsic organization in multimodal MoEs that could be used for efficient adaptation.
iMOmWcPKsM.method: ExpertLens is data-free: it decodes router weights into semantically meaningful vocabulary tokens to find domain-relevant experts from pretrained weights, then selectively fine-tunes those experts for the target domain.
iMOmWcPKsM.key_idea: Read expert specialization directly from router weights by projecting them to vocabulary tokens, then update only the matching experts.
iMOmWcPKsM.evidence: Math, medical, and remote sensing tasks, compared with full fine-tuning and LoRA.
iMOmWcPKsM.claimed_gains: Matches or surpasses full fine-tuning while updating 21.7-47.0% of parameters with a 4.0x average training speedup, and outperforms LoRA in adaptation performance and training efficiency.

Y50NtC74B8.one_liner: Separates an asynchronous thinking layer from a real-time full-duplex omni model that listens, sees, and speaks in 480 ms slices.
Y50NtC74B8.problem: Omni models struggle to combine seamless real-time interaction with complex reasoning and tool use.
Y50NtC74B8.method: An interaction layer, the end-to-end DuplexOmni model, processes streaming audio and video while generating text and speech in real time; a pluggable thinking layer provides reasoning and tool use asynchronously in parallel. A Writer-Director pipeline builds continuous-interaction training data.
Y50NtC74B8.key_idea: Run reasoning and tool use in a pluggable asynchronous layer parallel to a real-time streaming interaction model.
Y50NtC74B8.evidence: Experiments on public full-duplex interaction benchmarks (not named) with response latency measured.
Y50NtC74B8.claimed_gains: Claims strong full-duplex interaction performance on public benchmarks with low response latency; the only number given is the 480 ms slice length.

dE8Aq8I8Ff.one_liner: Unified data pipeline and autoregressive world model for camera control, character actions, and environmental events in video.
dE8Aq8I8Ff.problem: Interactive video world models handle navigation but struggle to extend control to diverse character actions and events because supervision is fragmented across heterogeneous video sources.
dE8Aq8I8Ff.method: A pipeline converts real-world, gameplay, edited, and synthetic videos into a temporally aligned dataset for camera control, character actions, and environmental events. An autoregressive world model initialized from a pretrained bidirectional video generator is trained on it.
dE8Aq8I8Ff.key_idea: Unify heterogeneous video sources into one temporally aligned action-and-event dataset to train an autoregressive world model from a bidirectional video generator.
dE8Aq8I8Ff.evidence: A dataset of 180,162 clips covering 91 action types across 14 visual domains, with experiments on instruction following, zero-shot compositional generalization, camera-actor disentanglement, and the roles of different data sources.
dE8Aq8I8Ff.claimed_gains: Dataset of 180,162 clips with 91 action types across 14 visual domains; model results are described qualitatively, with no metrics stated.

Ef8d8ka6qk.one_liner: Selects reliable point-cloud neighbors by geometric compatibility and cross-view agreement, then anchors known classes via a category memory.
Ef8d8ka6qk.problem: In 3D generalized category discovery, pretrained feature neighborhoods mix categories and change across augmented views, and known objects can dominate clustering, leaving novel categories without distinct groups.
Ef8d8ka6qk.method: Geo3D uses geometric compatibility and agreement across views to identify reliable neighbors, combines their relational evidence with a memory of category structure to construct discovery targets, and anchors confidently known objects to their predicted classes to reduce competition with novel groups.
Ef8d8ka6qk.key_idea: Build discovery targets from geometry-verified neighbors plus a category memory, anchoring confident known-class objects so novel clusters can form.
Ef8d8ka6qk.evidence: Experiments on synthetic shapes and real-world scans; datasets and baselines are not named.

109JTjfS0G.one_liner: Certifies pairwise LLM leaderboard advantages with benchmark-weighted, block-factorized empirical-Bernstein e-processes and e-Holm FWER control.
109JTjfS0G.problem: Leaderboards rank by mean performance, so run-to-run variability can produce unsupported claims of model superiority, a risk compounded by leaderboard updates.
109JTjfS0G.method: BB-EDGE represents a leaderboard as a directed graph whose edges certify pairwise mean-performance advantages. For each direction it builds an empirical-Bernstein e-process factorized over protocol-defined blocks with stakes proportional to block weights, then applies e-Holm across the e-processes for anytime-valid FWER control.
109JTjfS0G.key_idea: Factorize evidence into weighted blocks per model pair and combine the e-processes with e-Holm so directional advantages are certified under continued evaluation.
109JTjfS0G.evidence: Proofs of anytime FWER control under arbitrary within-block and cross-pair dependence, plus experiments on synthetic data and six real-world benchmarks.
109JTjfS0G.claimed_gains: Maintains anytime FWER control with high efficiency on synthetic data and six real-world benchmarks; no numbers are stated.

07yzzNm8j7.one_liner: Benchmark of air-ground collaborative goal-oriented navigation, with a reference framework using collaborative spatiotemporal memory and aerial-guided planning.
07yzzNm8j7.problem: Goal-oriented air-ground collaborative VLN lacks large-scale benchmarks, and aerial-ground view differences and asymmetric observability make consistent context and reliable single-platform planning difficult.
07yzzNm8j7.method: AirGroundVLN provides 10,281 episodes and 955 target instances across 19 Unreal Engine environments with seen/unseen splits and an aerial-visibility protocol. The AG-CoNAV reference framework adds Spatiotemporally Anchored Collaborative Memory (SACM) for spatially consistent historical context and Aerial-Guided Regional-to-Local Planning (AGRLP).
07yzzNm8j7.key_idea: Anchor memory spatiotemporally across aerial and ground platforms and plan from aerial regional guidance down to local ground actions.
07yzzNm8j7.evidence: Benchmark with seen/unseen splits across 19 Unreal Engine environments; the abstract is truncated before experimental results.
07yzzNm8j7.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract gives benchmark size only (10,281 episodes, 955 target instances, 19 environments).

3orA8cWU7W.one_liner: Benchmark for active cognition in embodied instruction following, with a post-training pipeline combining SFT, on-policy distillation, and multi-turn RL.
3orA8cWU7W.problem: Embodied agents must determine what remains unresolved, seek information beyond the current view, distinguish the target from similar instances, and revise ineffective behavior while preserving the instructed goal.
3orA8cWU7W.method: ActiveBrain-Bench has 1,035 tasks across six tracks with a common policy interface, including an Adapt track that separates local progress from instruction completion. The post-training pipeline uses 11.5K replay-verified continuations from generated start states and rollout failure states, combining supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and multi-turn RL with environment-derived rewards.
3orA8cWU7W.key_idea: Train on simulator-verified continuations from start and failure states, using environment-derived rewards in multi-turn RL, to learn active cognition.
3orA8cWU7W.evidence: Zero-shot evaluation of 18 open-weight models and GPT-5.5 on the benchmark, plus post-trained ActiveBrain-4B (from Qwen3.5-4B) and ActiveBrain-2B models.
3orA8cWU7W.claimed_gains: ActiveBrain-4B raises Qwen3.5-4B's unweighted six-track mean success rate from 8.1% to 44.0%, and ActiveBrain-2B reaches 35.0%.

tygkf8doMR.one_liner: Optimizes each task independently, then merges task-adapted solutions in parameter space via a curvature-weighted centroid with periodic re-anchoring.
tygkf8doMR.problem: Gradient-based multi-task methods force one shared update direction, which becomes unstable and degrades performance under strong task conflict.
tygkf8doMR.method: LOGIC lets each task evolve along its own loss landscape, then geometrically aligns the task-adapted solutions through a curvature-weighted centroid, periodically re-anchoring the task trajectories, so cross-task coordination is decoupled from task-specific optimization.
tygkf8doMR.key_idea: Coordinate tasks in parameter space via a curvature-weighted centroid of independently trained task solutions, instead of reconciling gradients at every step.
tygkf8doMR.evidence: Five benchmarks, three backbones, and both vision and language tasks, compared against 31 gradient-based baselines.
tygkf8doMR.claimed_gains: Consistently outperforms 31 gradient-based baselines and frequently surpasses single-task learning; no accuracy numbers are stated.

Qm9lrLBdxp.one_liner: Critic-free credit assignment for EHR agents using deterministic action checks and forked-replay comparisons of alternative decisions.
Qm9lrLBdxp.problem: GRPO gives every action in a rollout the same advantage, so it cannot tell which retrieval, memory, or stopping action helped, and per-action scores and alternatives are not readily available for EHR agents.
Qm9lrLBdxp.method: VAPA scores retrieval, memory, and stopping actions with deterministic checks against the patient record, completed rollout, and task specification. Forked replay rewinds to the state before a chosen action and samples alternative continuations, with weaker fallback groups where no fork reaches, and a two-level advantage assigns local credit while preserving final-answer credit for every original action.
Qm9lrLBdxp.key_idea: Combine deterministic per-action verifier checks with forked-replay comparisons of alternatives in a two-level advantage, with neither needed at test time.
Qm9lrLBdxp.evidence: MIMIC-IV calculation and retrieval tasks and the held-out MedAgentBench; the abstract is truncated before results.

bWpGJYlVhB.one_liner: Represents 3D shapes as sparse octree occupancy tokens and adds trainable 3D branches to a frozen vision-language LLM.
bWpGJYlVhB.problem: Existing 3D LLMs use latent codebook indices or coordinate text that remove spatial structure, and they fine-tune the backbone, which degrades general language ability.
bWpGJYlVhB.method: OctLLM shortens full octree sequences into a Sparse Octree (S-Octree) by randomly emptying penultimate-level nodes and omitting descendants while preserving shape. Mesh tokens go through independent trainable branches in a subset of blocks while text and image tokens keep the frozen pathway, and the streams interact through shared self-attention.
bWpGJYlVhB.key_idea: Represent geometry as coordinate- and depth-anchored octree tokens and route them through separate trainable branches beside a frozen language pathway.
bWpGJYlVhB.evidence: Compared with unified multimodal LLMs, including ShapeLLM-Omni, on image-to-3D generation and 3D captioning, with MMLU and HellaSwag used to check language retention.
bWpGJYlVhB.claimed_gains: Lowers image-to-3D FID by 17.4% and raises render-grounded captioning by 28.7 points over ShapeLLM-Omni, while matching the backbone on MMLU and HellaSwag.

YmLA7r8Hne.one_liner: Builds a quantile-aligned tree coupling between Gaussian prior and data to give non-crossing flow-matching paths cheaply.
YmLA7r8Hne.problem: Independent coupling in flow matching causes path crossings and local velocity ambiguity, while OT-based couplings are expensive to construct.
YmLA7r8Hne.method: QAT-FM builds a hierarchical coupling between a Gaussian prior and the target data through a quantile-aligned tree in O(N d log N) time, with O(d) per-pair source sampling, and extends to conditional generation. The authors prove marginal consistency, non-crossing linear interpolation paths, and better intermediate-time path separation than independent coupling.
YmLA7r8Hne.key_idea: Pair Gaussian samples and data through a quantile-aligned binary tree so that linear interpolation paths do not cross.
YmLA7r8Hne.evidence: Theoretical proofs plus experiments on diverse benchmark datasets (not named).
YmLA7r8Hne.claimed_gains: Competitive generative performance with substantially reduced coupling construction cost; no numbers are stated.

vDiLg9KY8Q.one_liner: Updates base weights with the full-gradient component orthogonal to LoRA's tangent space, keeping AdamW on the LoRA factors.
vDiLg9KY8Q.problem: A performance gap can remain between LoRA and full fine-tuning because each step's first-order weight-space direction is confined to the current low-rank parameterization.
vDiLg9KY8Q.method: The paper characterizes the LoRA-accessible gradient space as the tangent space of the current parameterization, which gives an orthogonal split of the full weight gradient. GDLoRA reconstructs the full gradient from forward activations and backward signals, extracts the normal component, and applies it directly to the base weights, with no extra optimizer-state memory beyond standard LoRA under matched configurations.
vDiLg9KY8Q.key_idea: Split the full weight gradient into LoRA-tangent and normal parts, and apply the normal part directly to the base weights.
vDiLg9KY8Q.evidence: Experiments on natural language understanding, mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and image classification; the abstract is truncated.
vDiLg9KY8Q.claimed_gains: Reports consistent improvements, but the abstract is truncated before any numbers or named baselines.

XCTUKWfcP5.one_liner: Factorized Vector Quantization encodes complementary fixed-dimensional views of a visual feature with parallel codebooks, raising effective bit budget for understanding.
XCTUKWfcP5.problem: Quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss in discrete visual tokens, making continuous representations an upper bound, yet existing quantizers saturate as added codebooks convey less semantic information.
XCTUKWfcP5.method: The authors use multimodal understanding as a proxy and find that the effective bit budget of discrete indices, not quantization error, tracks downstream performance. They introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary fixed-dimensional views of the same visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks, and train on industrial-scale multimodal data.
XCTUKWfcP5.key_idea: Quantize several complementary fixed-dimensional views of one visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks so semantic information keeps growing with bit budget instead of saturating.
XCTUKWfcP5.evidence: Multimodal understanding comparisons of discrete and continuous visual representations at varying bit budgets, trained on industrial-scale multimodal data.

Ck56NN9C9K.one_liner: LLM scene-program generation followed by execution-grounded verification, local projection, and conflict-graph repair for industrial layout feasibility.
Ck56NN9C9K.problem: LLM-generated industrial scene programs may execute successfully yet violate coupled boundary, collision, clearance, aisle, or structural constraints in the final state, and fixing one device can break constraints elsewhere.
Ck56NN9C9K.method: VIGOR combines supervised fine-tuning for complete program generation, local projection that resolves independently correctable violations, and joint conflict-graph repair that coordinates residual multi-object conflicts while preserving structural relations. The authors also build a dataset of 1,749 constructible scenarios with executable programs and 94 final-state geometric checks each.
Ck56NN9C9K.key_idea: Verify executed final states against geometric checks, fix independent violations by local projection, then jointly repair remaining coupled conflicts on a conflict graph.
Ck56NN9C9K.evidence: Evaluation on the authors' dataset of 1,749 scenarios with 94 geometric checks per scenario against baselines.
Ck56NN9C9K.claimed_gains: 96.86% Complete Feasibility and an Overall score of 91.20, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 10.42 points in Overall.

eTAI0lF0Mc.one_liner: GRR rewrites trained models with exact symmetries to test whether gradient-based rankings and decisions change, and proposes invariant alternatives.
eTAI0lF0Mc.problem: Gradients used to rank attention heads, allocate adapter ranks and clip per-example updates are computed in parameter coordinates that need not be determined by the learned function.
eTAI0lF0Mc.method: Gradient Reliability under Reparameterization (GRR) rewrites a trained model with an exact symmetry, verifies forward preservation, and compares the resulting measurements and decisions. The paper proves that reciprocal rescalings can realize every strict raw component ranking, and introduces function-space pruning and a quotient-space score with explicit invariance guarantees.
eTAI0lF0Mc.key_idea: Apply function-preserving reciprocal rescalings and rotations to a trained model and compare gradient-derived scores before and after, then replace raw scores with invariant ones.
eTAI0lF0Mc.evidence: Audits on GLUE classifiers, a ViT on CIFAR-10, decoder-only language models up to 7B parameters and six trained LoRA adapters, including 66 GLUE attention audits and 14 global-pruning audits.
eTAI0lF0Mc.claimed_gains: Across 66 GLUE attention audits the median top-3 overlap of raw head-gradient rankings is only 1/3; in the largest of 14 global-pruning audits two coordinates select masks differing in four of 22 pruned heads, reaching 50.92% and 94.84% ELECTRA SST-2 accuracy, while function-space pruning retains 94.95% accuracy with an identical mask.

Bdzl3EGFSH.one_liner: FinRiskAtlas is an expert-reviewed Chinese benchmark of eleven financial risk review operations plus an Ask-or-Proceed evidence-seeking test.
Bdzl3EGFSH.problem: Broad financial capability scores hide whether a model can produce supported outputs from available evidence and decide when to seek additional information in professional risk review.
Bdzl3EGFSH.method: A static component of 9,742 instances across 42 knowledge families and eleven review operations, each specified beforehand by visible evidence, decision object, required output and scoring rule. FinRisk-Ask evaluates offline 680 pre-action states reconstructed from 104 professional review trajectories, where models choose Ask or Proceed and write one focused evidence request.
Bdzl3EGFSH.key_idea: Specify each review operation by evidence, decision object, output and scoring rule before building instances, and evaluate Ask/Proceed choices on reconstructed pre-action states with later observations hidden.
Bdzl3EGFSH.evidence: 33 model configurations evaluated on the static operations and on FinRisk-Ask, separating agreement with recorded reviewer actions from request alignment with expert-verified evidence needs.
Bdzl3EGFSH.claimed_gains: The knowledge leader attains the highest score on only one of the eleven review operations, and selecting it for information extraction leaves an 18.01-point gap to the operation leader.

LcOmt6VQSK.one_liner: Shows cooperative MARL should aggregate neighbor rewards in the advantage and keep likelihood ratios per-agent, via a canonical gradient analysis.
LcOmt6VQSK.problem: Cooperative multi-agent policy optimization must decide whether to combine neighboring information in the advantage (reward sums) or in the importance weight (likelihood-ratio products).
LcOmt6VQSK.method: The two choices are formalized as support patterns and a canonical gradient representation is derived through their matrix product, giving local redundancy within a small support-wise trust region and a worst-case variance ordering favoring advantage aggregation. Tested on four synthetic cooperative games and a 196-intersection traffic-control task with controlled gradient diagnostics.
LcOmt6VQSK.key_idea: Compare advantage aggregation (additive reward sums) with ratio aggregation (multiplicative ratio products) through a canonical gradient form, showing the additive one has no greater worst-case variance.
LcOmt6VQSK.evidence: Theory plus experiments on four synthetic cooperative games and a 196-intersection traffic-control task, with controlled gradient diagnostics.

V6rV2jKTgy.one_liner: Places autoregression, diffusion, and in-between schedules on one corruption lattice and defines schedule cost as the dependence parallel steps discard.
V6rV2jKTgy.problem: Diffusion and AR hybrids each fix their decoding schedule by design, and it is unclear whether schedule performance can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps.
V6rV2jKTgy.method: It describes diffusion, AR, and intermediate models as paths on a corruption lattice and defines a schedule's cost as the dependence its parallel steps discard. For data that are Markov on a graph, the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule equal the graph's treedepth; below that, a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights predicts schedule rankings.
V6rV2jKTgy.key_idea: Score each decoding schedule by the pairwise dependence its parallel steps ignore, with the zero-cost step count set by the data graph's treedepth.
V6rV2jKTgy.evidence: Verification of most predicted schedule rankings across text, image, and video generation under different metrics and benchmarks.

4lifCr6HGQ.one_liner: Speculative decoding for VLMs that drafts from OCR-recovered image text indexed in a suffix automaton, training-free.
4lifCr6HGQ.problem: Retrieval drafters for HTML or Markdown generation from images miss content visible in the image, since only 2.3% of the target's next three-token spans recur earlier in the same output.
4lifCr6HGQ.method: VTD runs OCR once, indexes the recognized text in a suffix automaton, and fuses its draft tree with a tree from a dynamic automaton over the prompt and accepted output; it needs no drafter training, external corpus, or target weight changes.
4lifCr6HGQ.key_idea: OCR-recovered visible text serves as an additional retrieval source, and its suffix-automaton draft tree is fused with the dynamic automaton tree built over prompt and accepted output.
4lifCr6HGQ.evidence: Five benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and InternVL2.5-8B, compared with training-free retrieval baselines and the trained ViSpec drafter.
4lifCr6HGQ.claimed_gains: Mean end-to-end speedups of 1.84x on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, 1.97x on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and 1.62x on InternVL2.5-8B, and 36.8% higher average speedup than the trained ViSpec drafter on Qwen2.5-VL-7B.

k7IYyrekLp.one_liner: Extracts personality steering vectors from a model's own reasoning spans and sets injection strength with a context-adaptive dose network.
k7IYyrekLp.problem: Existing personality control for LLMs (prompting, fine-tuning, activation steering) perturbs unrelated dimensions or fails to hold the preset level across contexts, undermining social-simulation validity.
k7IYyrekLp.method: DeliSpan seeds from psychometric scale items, has the target model synthesize and reason through decision scenarios, and extracts direction vectors only from reasoning segments where it weighs trade-offs. CtxDose trains a dose network, supervised by the deviation between post-injection and preset scale scores, to predict injection strength from context.
k7IYyrekLp.key_idea: Extract directions only from deliberation spans where the model weighs trade-offs, and predict per-context injection strength with a dose network supervised by psychometric scale deviation.
k7IYyrekLp.evidence: Evaluated on the IPIP-300 inventory within the psychometric framework of Serapio-Garcia et al. (2025); the abstract is cut off before the results.

kOcKhJV8yX.one_liner: Root-cause attribution for multivariate time series as the minimal sparse edit restoring an anomalous window, via gradient-guided reverse diffusion.
kOcKhJV8yX.problem: Existing attribution methods use marginal feature perturbations or finite nearest-neighbor retrieval, producing out-of-distribution counterfactuals that violate conditional dependencies in monitoring systems.
kOcKhJV8yX.method: SPARCE trains a conditional score-based diffusion model only on normal behaviour and injects gradient guidance into the reverse process that jointly optimizes a denoising-consistency regularizer and an l1 sparsity penalty. The attribution map is the pointwise difference between the anomalous input and the restored output.
kOcKhJV8yX.key_idea: Guide reverse diffusion with a denoising-consistency term and an l1 sparsity penalty to find the minimal edit that returns the window to the normal manifold.
kOcKhJV8yX.evidence: Evaluated on four benchmarks according to the TL;DR; the visible abstract is cut off before the experiments.

djznyPY9n1.one_liner: Single-image 3D indoor scene generation where geometry proposes candidates and agents mainly accept or reject them.
djznyPY9n1.problem: Holistic agentic scene-generation pipelines ask agents to resolve multiple entangled factors at once, limiting performance in complex real-world environments.
djznyPY9n1.method: Three stages: scene initialization (an inspector agent segments and describes objects, a reviewer agent decides which proposed mask merges and deletions to apply), environment construction (metric scale and a room fitted to observed walls), and scene refinement (the reviewer screens geometry-proposed corrections and a group editor agent rearranges only wrong groups). A geometry-aware layout predictor poses all objects jointly in one floor-aligned frame.
djznyPY9n1.key_idea: Compute what can be measured geometrically and leave agents only ambiguous accept-or-reject decisions on geometry-proposed candidates.
djznyPY9n1.evidence: The abstract is cut off before the experiments, so datasets and baselines are not visible.

UeCojsal9m.one_liner: Constrained policy optimization that bounds the VaR cost constraint with Cantelli's inequality using the first two moments of cost return.
UeCojsal9m.problem: Tail-based estimators for rare-event VaR constraints in safe RL are too noisy to enforce strict safety thresholds.
UeCojsal9m.method: Canary derives a tractable, conservative, smooth bound on the VaR constraint from the first two moments of the cost return via Cantelli's inequality, and extends the CPO trust-region framework with worst-case bounds on policy improvement and constraint violation.
UeCojsal9m.key_idea: Replaces tail-quantile estimation with a two-moment Cantelli bound on cost return so every sample informs the VaR constraint estimate.
UeCojsal9m.evidence: Empirical training runs across environments (not named in the abstract) plus worst-case bounds extending CPO.
UeCojsal9m.claimed_gains: not stated; the abstract says Canary is the only method that reliably satisfies the VaR constraint in every environment tested, without numbers.

Ssje1e5Aqu.one_liner: Training-free DPP predicts a moving target's interaction position and builds a counterfactual observation so world-action models reuse static-trained skills.
Ssje1e5Aqu.problem: World-action models trained on static demonstrations fail on moving targets because of target-response collapse: the policy keeps its learned continuation and becomes less responsive to target relocation.
Ssje1e5Aqu.method: DPP uses the model's predictive rollout to estimate when interaction will occur, combines this with observed target motion to predict the future interaction position, and constructs a counterfactual observation placing that position in a familiar robot context. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution.
Ssje1e5Aqu.key_idea: Decouple the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution by constructing a counterfactual canonical observation at the predicted target position.
Ssje1e5Aqu.evidence: Experiments in simulation and on a real robot (abstract cut off before details); runs in real time on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data.

2Vpg5dG7Tb.one_liner: Jointly generates edited images and ordered RGBA layers in one token sequence, with edit-prior distillation preserving editing fidelity.
2Vpg5dG7Tb.problem: Editing models output flattened images that limit local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing.
2Vpg5dG7Tb.method: LayerEditor uses In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling to represent the edited canvas and an ordered sequence of RGB-Alpha layers within a single token sequence. Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation transfers the pretrained model's editing prior to both the edited canvas and the image composed from the predicted layers.
2Vpg5dG7Tb.key_idea: Model the canvas and ordered RGBA layers as one token sequence, and distill the pretrained editing prior onto both the edited canvas and the re-composed layers.
2Vpg5dG7Tb.evidence: Experiments on the new LayerEditor-100K paired editing dataset with ordered RGBA layer annotations and on dedicated layered-editing benchmarks.

W9oCWVmO1l.one_liner: Post-trains frozen time-series forecasters by having a lightweight policy select semantic edit actions rewarded by full-horizon MSE and structure.
W9oCWVmO1l.problem: Trained forecasters can mistime peaks or damp oscillations, and correcting these is not a local shape-matching task because an edit succeeds only if its complete forecast improves.
W9oCWVmO1l.method: EditCast is a one-step, full-information contextual RL problem: a lightweight policy picks a semantic action from the history and reference forecast, scored on training futures by full-horizon MSE and structural rewards. The finite action bank makes expected reward exactly computable, and backbone parameters are not updated.
W9oCWVmO1l.key_idea: A finite bank of semantic edit actions makes expected reward exactly computable, so a lightweight policy is trained on full-horizon MSE plus structural rewards.
W9oCWVmO1l.evidence: 308 checkpoint-level evaluations over eight datasets, four architectures and four horizons.
W9oCWVmO1l.claimed_gains: Validation-selected EditCast reduces aggregate MSE by 1.1% and MAE by 0.8%, and a fixed structural-reward weight raises joint accuracy-structure wins from 31 to 59, with validation selection reaching 64.

aAQRHy34qw.one_liner: Models semantic relations as affine operators on embeddings, treating consistent analogies as flat discrete connections with commuting operators.
aAQRHy34qw.problem: Analogy consistency, where two relations applied in either order give the same result, lacks a formal account, and learned relation operators can be path dependent.
aAQRHy34qw.method: Tokens are graph vertices with edges labeled by relation types that act as affine operators; an analogy square is a closed walk whose holonomy is the commutator of two operators. For contextual representations, operators depend on context through softmax mixtures of Lie-algebra generators with curvature bounded by their brackets, and curvature regularization is applied.
aAQRHy34qw.key_idea: Analogy consistency is flatness of a discrete connection, measured by the commutator holonomy of relation operators, and curvature regularization drives it toward zero.
aAQRHy34qw.evidence: Theory plus an evaluation of 1,154 mined morphological analogy squares in GPT-2.
aAQRHy34qw.claimed_gains: Affine operators beat vector offsets by ten points on two-hop analogies but show path dependence in 11-25% of held-out compositions; curvature regularization cuts it to 3-6%, and static operators lose 8-15 points under syntactic frame shifts.

OHjf6xDsmY.one_liner: Plants a dormant action payload in a VLA checkpoint that wakes after benign finetuning, bound to the action representation.
OHjf6xDsmY.problem: Practitioners finetune released VLAs on their own robots and assume it is safe because the data is theirs, an assumption the attack breaks.
OHjf6xDsmY.method: A provider distributes weights that stay near a clean model's task success and pass screening, yet express the planted behavior after benign victim finetuning, with no poisoned example or inference-time trigger in the unconditional setting; the same mechanism also removes a hierarchical policy's safety guardrail and plants gated backdoors.
OHjf6xDsmY.key_idea: Bury the payload as an action whose motor realization is bound to the action representation, so clean finetuning on a robot sharing that representation awakens it.
OHjf6xDsmY.evidence: Four VLAs and two checkpoint types, with activation measured over rollouts on robot arms with different action spaces.
OHjf6xDsmY.claimed_gains: The attack activates on 74.0% to 86.5% of rollouts on the discrete-token models but 0.0% (abstract truncated).

uzKM6hiPQp.one_liner: Closed-loop curriculum for VLM on-policy distillation where the evolving student activates, suspends, or reactivates supervision per example.
uzKM6hiPQp.problem: OPD pipelines build the curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming selected examples keep positive supervision value throughout optimization.
uzKM6hiPQp.method: SCC uses a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum as the candidate supervision space, and the evolving student dynamically picks the active subset based on supervision trustworthiness and necessity.
uzKM6hiPQp.key_idea: Couple the curriculum to the student's current competence so supervision is activated or suspended dynamically, concentrating teacher compute on present deficits.
uzKM6hiPQp.evidence: Three temporal video grounding benchmarks, compared with Video-OPD on its original curriculum, with ablations.
uzKM6hiPQp.claimed_gains: 5.1% relative improvement in mean recall over Video-OPD, using 60.0% fewer training examples and reducing training time by 50.4%.

UYgLPi87Qz.one_liner: Persistent-perturbation ensemble sampling for RL, with regret guarantees in linear MDPs.
UYgLPi87Qz.problem: Regret guarantees for ensemble sampling in RL are hard to establish when persistent perturbations influence subsequent data collection.
UYgLPi87Qz.method: Two variants maintain persistently perturbed datasets, uniformly select one ensemble member per episode, and run its greedy policy, retaining historical perturbations and fitting only the selected member to avoid noise resampling and iterative posterior sampling.
UYgLPi87Qz.key_idea: Keep perturbations persistent across episodes and fit only the uniformly selected ensemble member, with an analysis that handles dependence between perturbations and adaptively collected data.
UYgLPi87Qz.evidence: Regret analysis in linear MDPs, plus competitive empirical performance per the TLDR.
UYgLPi87Qz.claimed_gains: Signed variant: leading regret term O~(d^2 H^2 sqrt(T)) with O~(dH) members; absolute variant: O~(d^2 H^(3/2) sqrt(T)) with O~(d) members.

y0bA9L8q9m.one_liner: Video generation using 4D voxels as both control primitives and memory carriers storing time-dependent geometry, visibility, identity, and appearance.
y0bA9L8q9m.problem: Long video generation suffers from weak controllability, spatial drift, and memory loss when objects leave and re-enter the view.
y0bA9L8q9m.method: Each voxel stores time-dependent geometry, visibility, segmentation identity, and local appearance; memory combines local appearance propagated with voxel motion and global history frames retrieved by future voxel coverage. A bidirectional model is distilled into a causal generator, with 4D video-voxel training data built from synthetic scenes and real videos.
y0bA9L8q9m.key_idea: Use 4D voxels as shared control and memory: propagate appearance with voxel motion and retrieve history frames by future voxel coverage.
y0bA9L8q9m.evidence: The abstract describes training-data construction but states no experiments or benchmarks.

MGHZ3iiw6x.one_liner: Training-free steering of frozen flow-matching VLAs away from scene risks using VLM-generated counterfactual prompts and clipped velocity residuals.
MGHZ3iiw6x.problem: VLA policies lack inference-time mechanisms to avoid hazards such as fragile objects, bystanders, and obstacles, and existing safety methods need retraining, known geometry and dynamics, or only language constraints.
MGHZ3iiw6x.method: Grounded Risk Verbalization uses a frozen VLM to identify risks and express each as a counterfactual action prompt in the VLA's instruction format; Trajectory-Anchored Flow Repulsion steers the flow-matching ODE by accumulating clipped velocity residuals in a correction state decoupled from the nominal trajectory.
MGHZ3iiw6x.key_idea: Accumulate clipped velocity residuals from counterfactual risk prompts in a separate correction state so guidance does not compound across ODE integration steps.
MGHZ3iiw6x.evidence: Evaluations across three safety-critical simulation settings (abstract truncated).

TyEJZHqDWu.one_liner: Trains a preference extractor with RL using semantic F1 against ground-truth preferences instead of QA-based rewards.
TyEJZHqDWu.problem: QA rewards in RL bias extractors toward QA-specific patterns at the expense of preference fidelity; on PersonaMem-V2 the QA-reward model does worse with its own extracted preferences than without them.
TyEJZHqDWu.method: QUIET is a reward design that trains an extractor directly from ground-truth preferences without QA supervision, evaluated on FairPersonaMem-V2, a bias-aware reconstruction of the benchmark.
TyEJZHqDWu.key_idea: Reward the extractor with semantic F1 between extracted and ground-truth preferences, removing the QA supervision that induces QA-specific bias.
TyEJZHqDWu.evidence: FairPersonaMem-V2 with a Qwen3-4B-Instruct extractor, compared with a QA-reward-trained baseline.
TyEJZHqDWu.claimed_gains: 23% relative MCQ accuracy gain and 10x higher semantic F1, with 21x fewer training context tokens than the QA-reward-trained baseline.

sgCAk8mxzX.one_liner: Two-stage object insertion for detection augmentation: scene-aware joint layout planning, then layout-aligned flow-matching generation.
sgCAk8mxzX.problem: Existing insertion methods struggle with precise category-count requests, visual consistency, coordination across categories and instances, and localizing multiple objects of a given category and count.
sgCAk8mxzX.method: ScenePlan allocates one class-labeled query per instance, predicts scene-compatible object centers, and estimates box sizes conditioned on those centers. SceneAlign-Fill uses geometry- and appearance-aware conditioning, box-class-guided regional attention, and an annotation-region-weighted flow-matching objective.
sgCAk8mxzX.key_idea: Plan instance centers and box sizes jointly from the scene first, then generate objects aligned to the explicit layout with region-weighted flow matching to limit changes to source content.
sgCAk8mxzX.evidence: Three benchmarks, UAVDT, VisDrone, and BDD100K, against general-purpose editors and object-insertion methods.
sgCAk8mxzX.claimed_gains: Outperforms representative general-purpose editors and object-insertion methods (abstract truncated); no numbers stated.

hPdzz302eJ.one_liner: Evaluates adversarial patches on VLAs under camera-projection geometry instead of pixel-space compositing, and re-optimizes attacks under those constraints.
hPdzz302eJ.problem: Reports that adversarial patches drive VLA task success near zero may not hold once a patch is fixed to a physical surface and seen through camera projection.
hPdzz302eJ.method: A 2x2 study crosses pixel-space and geometry-consistent patch generation with evaluation on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and pi0, re-optimizes patches under geometric constraints, tests printed patches on a physical robot, and examines adversarial training under the same constraints.
hPdzz302eJ.key_idea: Separate patch generation from evaluation and treat the patch as a fixed texture whose appearances arise only through camera projection and placement constraints.
hPdzz302eJ.evidence: OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and pi0; LIBERO-Spatial with UADA attack; a physical robot task with printed patches; adversarial training.
hPdzz302eJ.claimed_gains: Geometry-consistent evaluation raises task success in all 24 combinations by 3.0-69.2 percentage points; re-optimization recovers attack strength in 23 of them; OpenVLA on LIBERO-Spatial under UADA goes from 0.2% to 52.0% on evaluation change and to 17.4% after re-optimization.

WpGJMGCVjZ.one_liner: Proximal stochastic gradients jointly handle spectrum and parameter regularization in spectral risk minimization.
WpGJMGCVjZ.problem: Spectral risk methods rarely handle distribution-shift and nondifferentiable parameter regularization together because stochastic-gradient bias and variance are difficult to control.
WpGJMGCVjZ.method: PSG-SRM uses a proximal stochastic gradient method for doubly regularized spectral risk minimization. A Lyapunov contraction jointly controls iterate error, objective gap, and two memory errors to establish convergence.
WpGJMGCVjZ.key_idea: Use proximal stochastic updates with joint control of iterate, objective, and memory errors to suppress conditional gradient bias and centered variance.
WpGJMGCVjZ.evidence: Under stated regularity conditions, theory gives linear convergence and geometric bias and variance decay, while regression and classification experiments assess performance and stability to randomness.

SORR42klNg.one_liner: Soft assignments to discrete memory addresses connect KV quantization with recurrent aggregation and enable pretrained Transformer migration.
SORR42klNg.problem: KV-cache quantization retains every entry, while fixed-state linear attention aggregates history with possible interference, leaving their mechanisms disconnected.
SORR42klNg.method: RAM-Net uses soft assignments over discrete addresses to update continuous recurrent slot states. A restricted construction links quantized matching to separable read-write overlap, enabling Transformer weight migration through a soft-quantized intermediate.
SORR42klNg.key_idea: Softly assign keys and queries to discrete addresses whose continuous slots recurrently aggregate history through separable read-write overlap.
SORR42klNg.evidence: Theory analyzes a restricted RAM-Net construction, and migration experiments cover nine pretrained Transformers from 0.3B to 7B parameters across six commonsense and knowledge tasks.
SORR42klNg.claimed_gains: RAM-Net recovers an average of 87.1% of teachers' accuracy gains over random guessing using a 500M-token budget per model.

BffPdtjPYg.one_liner: Comparing reference-conditioned and null-reference passes confines robotic video edits to masked manipulators or objects.
BffPdtjPYg.problem: Self-derived pseudo-paired training references differ from novel inference references, causing leakage, boundary artifacts, and original-identity ghosting in robotic video edits.
BffPdtjPYg.method: RoboEdit constructs pseudo-paired supervision from masks and reference images extracted from source videos. Its mask-aware consistency objective compares conditioned and null-reference passes and suppresses reference-induced changes in outside-mask token relations.
BffPdtjPYg.key_idea: Suppress reference-induced changes to outside-mask token relations by comparing reference-conditioned and null-reference forward passes.
BffPdtjPYg.evidence: The paper introduces a robotic local-editing benchmark and an RMC metric for local stability, trajectory preservation, and edited-region semantic consistency; experimental findings are truncated.

FHJ183cTnJ.one_liner: Segment agents compress video observations into shared latent tokens for a coordinator to reason under fixed perception budgets.
FHJ183cTnJ.problem: Bounded perception contexts limit long-video understanding, while agentic preprocessing can lose information and incur high costs through textual intermediates.
FHJ183cTnJ.method: MACF-Video assigns video segments to locally budgeted agents that encode observations as compact task-sufficient tokens in a shared embedding space. A coordinator combines these tokens, supported by curriculum training for semantic alignment, evidence summarization, and coordination.
FHJ183cTnJ.key_idea: Let locally budgeted video agents communicate compact task-sufficient latent tokens to a central coordinator in a shared embedding space.
FHJ183cTnJ.evidence: Experiments on unspecified video-understanding benchmarks compare MACF-Video with MLLMs and multi-agent systems under identical budget constraints.

CFPwHvGkwj.one_liner: An agent director enforces configurable gameplay state transitions and prompts a separate video model to render them.
CFPwHvGkwj.problem: Pixel-supervised game world models cannot reliably enforce precise mechanics, while hard-coded game engines restrict player-driven creation.
CFPwHvGkwj.method: GameDirector interprets visual observations and player configurations to update states, control NPCs, and enforce rules. It translates those decisions into text prompts for a video world model to render gameplay.
CFPwHvGkwj.key_idea: Separate rule-governed gameplay updates from rendering, using an agent director's decisions as prompts to a video world model.

o2X36iDXsH.one_liner: A shared policy alternates task reasoning and skill curation, rewarding curated skills through the reasoner's successes.
o2X36iDXsH.problem: Manually authored skills do not scale, and static skill libraries can become misaligned with an agent's changing capabilities.
o2X36iDXsH.method: AlphaSkill trains one policy as both a Reasoner that solves tasks and a Skill Curator that creates or refines a skill library. The curator receives optimization signals based on its skills' contribution to the reasoner's successes.
o2X36iDXsH.key_idea: Train a shared policy to solve tasks and curate reusable skills, tying curator rewards to the task-solving value of its skills.
o2X36iDXsH.evidence: Experiments span unspecified agentic environments and reasoning tasks, with additional evaluation of self-curated skills as test-time prompt hints.

94ymnh9CVL.one_liner: Scaling external parametric memory independently of language models separates long-term knowledge capacity from the decoder's parameters.
94ymnh9CVL.problem: Decoder-only language models entangle memory and reasoning, preventing independent scaling of memory capacity.
94ymnh9CVL.method: Memory Decoder at Scale pretrains an external parametric memory and studies model size, data size, and memory–LM parameter allocation. Distributed FAISS indexing and retrieval plus sparse kNN distribution storage address retrieval and storage costs.
94ymnh9CVL.key_idea: Pair a language model with independently scaled pretrained parametric memory, using distributed retrieval and sparse kNN distribution storage.
94ymnh9CVL.evidence: Experiments pretrain 6.9B memory parameters on 300B tokens and assess general knowledge across 17 benchmarks and domain-specific memory against CPT, LoRA, and RAG.
94ymnh9CVL.claimed_gains: A 6.9B memory lets Pythia-410M surpass Pythia-12B on average across 17 benchmarks with 39% fewer total parameters, while domain memory beats the strongest reported CPT, LoRA, or RAG baseline by 4.05–8.53 points on average.

AClVG8IfPa.one_liner: Ψ-0.6 uses a shared token interface to interleave visual geometry, images, and text, learning representation choices from task feedback.
AClVG8IfPa.problem: Physical-world reasoning requires models to select and combine different world representations as tasks unfold.
AClVG8IfPa.method: Ψ-0.6 unifies generation and interpretation of images, text, camera pose, depth, flow, and point tracks through a shared token interface. Reinforcement learning from task feedback trains adaptive sequences of intermediate representations.
AClVG8IfPa.key_idea: Use a shared token interface to compose geometric, visual, and textual reasoning steps and learn which representations to invoke.
AClVG8IfPa.evidence: Evaluations cover zero-shot MindCube spatial reasoning, FlowBench-Real counterfactual imagination against Qwen, and reinforcement-learning improvements in visual question answering.

YaOQpYFX92.one_liner: Spherical Editing constrains target hidden states to their original norm while optimizing directional changes for knowledge updates.
YaOQpYFX92.problem: Unnecessary target-state norm growth during knowledge editing increases interference with non-target knowledge in normalized LLMs.
YaOQpYFX92.method: Spherical Editing optimizes each target hidden state on a sphere whose radius equals the original state's norm. It retains directional updates for new knowledge while preventing radial growth.
YaOQpYFX92.key_idea: Constrain target hidden-state optimization to a fixed-radius sphere so edits change direction without increasing magnitude.
YaOQpYFX92.evidence: The paper analyzes target-state optimization in LLMs with LayerNorm or RMSNorm, linking norm growth to degraded editing locality.

rUvKKxQjZ5.one_liner: TRACE reconstructs images with an untrained network and stochastic proximal constraints coupling adjacent reconstruction states.
rUvKKxQjZ5.problem: Diffusion-based inverse solvers often need domain-matched training data and can accumulate errors across reverse-sampling steps.
rUvKKxQjZ5.method: TRACE fits an untrained overparameterized network directly to measurements and organizes reconstruction into intermediate states. Each estimate follows a perturbed predecessor under measurement consistency and is proximally constrained to its corresponding unperturbed state.
rUvKKxQjZ5.key_idea: Couple consecutive reconstruction states through stochastic perturbations, measurement consistency, and proximal constraints using an untrained network.
rUvKKxQjZ5.evidence: Stability bounds and local Jacobian analysis accompany natural-image restoration and CT reconstruction experiments against untrained and pretrained neural priors.

B1xdleK8Df.one_liner: PRISM decodes frozen time-series representations into a piecewise-linear trend, gated Fourier components, and a residual forecast.
B1xdleK8Df.problem: Time-series foundation-model forecasts do not explicitly reveal trend and periodic contributions.
B1xdleK8Df.method: PRISM maps a frozen TSFM's context representation into an additive forecast without fitting the target series. It predicts a piecewise-linear trend, gates a Fourier dictionary constrained by sampling and horizon, and adds a residual.
B1xdleK8Df.key_idea: Decode context representations into trend, admissible Fourier components, and residual terms without target-series fitting.
B1xdleK8Df.evidence: TimesFM 2.5 experiments examine three domains, agreement with classical decompositions, exchange-rate behavior, and stability under input noise.
B1xdleK8Df.claimed_gains: PRISM has a dataset-averaged normalized mean absolute error 3.1% above that of the frozen backbone.

MZTcRlNBjE.one_liner: Scene-SAM3D selects complementary views, fuses latent velocities, and refines rigid-object layouts for training-free 3D scene generation.
MZTcRlNBjE.problem: Single-image 3D generators struggle with scene occlusions, redundant views, and cross-view inconsistencies.
MZTcRlNBjE.method: Scene-SAM3D selects complementary calibrated views and performs conflict-aware latent velocity fusion in canonical space. Lightweight rigid-object Gaussian optimization then refines layout while preserving generated object geometry.
MZTcRlNBjE.key_idea: Combine complementary view selection with latent velocity fusion that suppresses cross-view conflicts before rigid-object layout refinement.
MZTcRlNBjE.evidence: Replica and ScanNet++ experiments evaluate instance- and scene-level reconstruction alongside flow-model sampling cost and latency.
MZTcRlNBjE.claimed_gains: Scene-level CD falls by 43.8% on Replica and 30.9% on ScanNet++, while sampling FLOPs and wall-time latency fall by nearly 20%.

1GmrN1BNkD.one_liner: A counterfactual formulation separates influence-estimator specification disagreements from approximation errors within a fixed attribution target.
1GmrN1BNkD.problem: Incompatible influence rankings can arise from different counterfactual specifications rather than approximation error alone.
1GmrN1BNkD.method: The paper defines influence by the attributed behavior, training-example intervention, and counterfactual training process. It organizes estimators by these specifications and derives a local decomposition of behavior signals, training signals, and parameter responses.
1GmrN1BNkD.key_idea: Specify behavior, intervention, and counterfactual training before comparing influence estimators or attributing their differences to approximation.
1GmrN1BNkD.evidence: Controlled experiments compare exact estimands and linearization errors, while noisy-label detection and LLM attribution tests show surrogate-dependent reversals in estimator comparisons.

cj609w4OnS.one_liner: A model-call proxy and isolated Kubernetes rollouts connect stateful agent runtimes to standard reinforcement-learning training infrastructure.
cj609w4OnS.problem: Standard supervised and reinforcement-learning stacks cannot natively represent stateful, multi-process agent execution.
cj609w4OnS.method: OpenForge-RL proxies an agent runtime's model calls and records them as training data for standard reinforcement-learning codebases such as veRL. A Kubernetes orchestrator runs each rollout in a separate remote container to support varied runtimes and environments.
cj609w4OnS.key_idea: Proxying model calls separates agent execution from training, while remote rollout containers support stateful multi-process environments.
cj609w4OnS.evidence: Evaluation covers tool-based and multimodal GUI agents on ClawEval, QwenClawBench, OSWorld-Verified, Online-Mind2Web, and WebVoyager using hundreds to a few thousand tasks.
cj609w4OnS.claimed_gains: OpenForge-Claw scores 31.7 (pass^3) and 55.9 (pass@3) on ClawEval and 33.7 on QwenClawBench, while OpenForge-GUI scores 37.7 on OSWorld-Verified, 63.0 on Online-Mind2Web, and 72.3 on WebVoyager.

zkKLwKPjoC.one_liner: Variable-size rectangular tokens allocate diffusion computation by anticipated spatial detail while preserving full-resolution flow prediction.
zkKLwKPjoC.problem: Uniform spatial computation wastes diffusion-model capacity where a requested scene needs less detail.
zkKLwKPjoC.method: LoT Diffusion creates multiresolution layouts with fine tokens in detailed regions and coarser tokens elsewhere. Patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and multiresolution embeddings adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to reduced token sequences with full-resolution flow outputs.
zkKLwKPjoC.key_idea: A multiresolution token layout combines variable rectangular patches with asymmetric flow parametrization to retain full-resolution predictions from fewer tokens.
zkKLwKPjoC.evidence: Image and video demonstrations use layouts derived from semantic masks, boxes, texture variance, depth-of-field cues, and agentic plans.

uK4eUwmkBz.one_liner: A recurrent graph state jointly adapts temporal retention and structural propagation through learned decay kernels.
uK4eUwmkBz.problem: Fixed decay schedules and propagation depths limit dynamic-graph generalization across interaction frequencies and graph structures.
uK4eUwmkBz.method: DSRD maintains one recurrent representation containing temporal memory and structural context. Adaptive decay kernels with learnable time sensitivity balance short-term responses against long-term retention according to interaction patterns.
uK4eUwmkBz.key_idea: A single recurrent state couples temporal memory with structural propagation through learnable, time-sensitive decay kernels.
uK4eUwmkBz.evidence: Theory expands recurrent updates into temporal-walk aggregations with boundedness guarantees, and experiments cover link prediction and node classification on 14 real-world benchmarks.

Ni6rhdwPLi.one_liner: Expert-similarity corrections and error-weighted dynamic programming allocate diffusion experts across timesteps and layers under a fixed budget.
Ni6rhdwPLi.problem: Uniform expert activation wastes computation, while language-model skipping methods neglect error accumulation across diffusion denoising steps.
Ni6rhdwPLi.method: ESEA adjusts routing weights using expert similarity and calibrates local-error tensors with timestep-dependent global-error weights. Offline dynamic programming allocates experts across layers and timesteps to minimize weighted error under a total expert budget.
Ni6rhdwPLi.key_idea: Similarity-adjusted routing and weighted local-error estimates drive dynamic programming over timestep-layer expert allocations.
Ni6rhdwPLi.evidence: Error analyses motivate the allocation scheme, and experiments use HunyuanImage-3.0-Instruct, its distilled variant, and LingBot-Video.

aahyqE80FX.one_liner: Physical evidence guides candidate-trajectory scoring while auxiliary training makes world-model latents sensitive to motion-specific scene interactions.
aahyqE80FX.problem: Latent-only world-model planning lacks explicit physical evidence for assessing candidate motions and their safety consequences.
aahyqE80FX.method: PhyDrive's Physical-Evidence-Guided Scorer uses planning-oriented physical evidence to guide interactions between candidate-specific latents and global scene context. A training-only auxiliary network teaches the world model to encode planning-relevant differences among motions.
aahyqE80FX.key_idea: Explicit physical evidence conditions candidate-to-scene interactions for trajectory scoring, while auxiliary training distinguishes motion-specific physical effects.
aahyqE80FX.evidence: Evaluation uses the NAVSIM v1 and v2 autonomous-driving planning benchmarks.
aahyqE80FX.claimed_gains: PhyDrive reports PDMS 95.3 on NAVSIM v1 and EPDMS 93.0 on NAVSIM v2.

zI7jcDF5p7.one_liner: Skill compilation produces extended finite state machines with explicit transitions and trace-validated updates.
zI7jcDF5p7.problem: Agents can omit or misapply required skill steps when task reasoning and control decisions remain coupled in document interpretation.
zI7jcDF5p7.method: HEXIS compiles skill clauses and tool interfaces into states, prompts, result variables, and transition conditions. It aligns development traces to add missing operations or dependencies and accepts updates only after static checks and replay of all accepted traces.
zI7jcDF5p7.key_idea: State prompts hold skill knowledge, while explicit transitions control execution and trace-validated compiler updates repair missing operations and dependencies.
zI7jcDF5p7.evidence: Experiments cover four benchmarks and four execution models using machines compiled once from one model's traces and comparing with ReAct execution of identical skills.
zI7jcDF5p7.claimed_gains: Compiled machines improve success over ReAct execution of the same skills by 16.2% on average.

AR5UcvKrv0.one_liner: Learned routing selects propagation axes and receptive supports for class- and location-dependent volumetric medical segmentation.
AR5UcvKrv0.problem: Volumetric segmentation needs contextual evidence that adapts to anatomical direction, spatial location, and semantic class.
AR5UcvKrv0.method: VERSA's V-BAR RWKV mixes bidirectional recurrent responses across orthogonal axes with anisotropic multi-support context. DiVERS routes point, axial, planar-union, volumetric, boundary, and pooled-context experts by class and location, using normalized disagreement to bound corrections to a point-supported anchor.
AR5UcvKrv0.key_idea: Spatially varying axis mixtures and class-conditioned support routing select context, while expert disagreement bounds correction strength around a point-supported prediction.
AR5UcvKrv0.evidence: Evaluation spans 12 public CT, MRI, and OCT benchmarks, with controlled ablations comparing learned routing against uniform aggregation over identical axes and experts.
AR5UcvKrv0.claimed_gains: With 3.67M parameters, VERSA outperforms 21 existing methods on all 12 public benchmarks.

Vgh5i9wCMD.one_liner: Semantic-span compression and jointly trained masked diffusion decoding co-adapt continuous latents with discrete language generation.
Vgh5i9wCMD.problem: Hierarchical language generation needs latent compression and discrete generation to balance semantic reconstruction with autonomous text production.
Vgh5i9wCMD.method: Cola2 dynamically segments text, controls compression through negative feedback, and jointly trains a block-causal masked diffusion decoder under clean, noisy, and dropped latents with classifier-free guidance. Token gradients update the encoder while stop-gradient separates flow-prior learning, and inference re-encodes generated text under a fixed span layout.
Vgh5i9wCMD.key_idea: Token-prediction gradients co-adapt semantic compression and discrete decoding, while stop-gradient separates prior learning and re-encoding synchronizes latent history with generated text.
Vgh5i9wCMD.evidence: The abstract reports component analyses and evaluation on five downstream tasks with about 210B training tokens.

WLZwxAcNxE.one_liner: Paper reconstruction compares agent-written manuscripts with source papers using section-level coverage and resource-checked hallucination analysis.
WLZwxAcNxE.problem: Overall review scores reveal acceptance-worthiness but provide limited detail about agents' scientific writing behavior and errors.
WLZwxAcNxE.method: PaperRecon asks agents to reconstruct papers from structured overviews and supporting resources, then compares their outputs with originals. It scores section-specific content coverage and unsupported contradictory claims and diagnoses runtime, backbone, input, citation, and verbosity effects.
WLZwxAcNxE.key_idea: Reconstructing a known paper from supplied resources permits direct section-level coverage scoring and verification of contradictory unsupported claims.
WLZwxAcNxE.evidence: PaperWrite-Bench contains 72 papers from 2025 and 2026, and the framework includes diagnostic analyses of runtime and model choice, input information, citations, and verbosity.

hTr9huE4P9.one_liner: Spline-based trajectories and motion-dependent temporal support adapt robot action resolution within a fixed prediction budget.
hTr9huE4P9.problem: Fixed-rate action chunks waste capacity on correlated actions and force a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and contact precision.
hTr9huE4P9.method: Vela represents future robot behavior as compact continuous spline trajectories with motion-dependent temporal support. A shared action interface supports heterogeneous embodiments during large-scale robot pretraining.
hTr9huE4P9.key_idea: Compact spline parameters and motion-dependent temporal support vary action resolution and horizon within a fixed output budget.
hTr9huE4P9.evidence: Evaluation covers LIBERO-X, EBench, and real-world egg-cake cooking and potato-shredding tasks after multi-embodiment pretraining.

aIxsc3WqeT.one_liner: Cooperative agents execute negotiated contracts only after probabilistic model checking certifies risk below a specified threshold.
aIxsc3WqeT.problem: Average agent competence does not rule out rare unsafe actions in stochastic cooperative environments.
aIxsc3WqeT.method: The certify-then-act protocol has independent agents negotiate a joint contract and use a sound probabilistic model checker to assess its unsafe-state probability. Agents execute only below the specified risk threshold and repeat certification when disturbances invalidate it.
aIxsc3WqeT.key_idea: Execution depends on a probabilistic safety certificate for the joint contract, with renewed certification after disturbances invalidate the guarantee.
aIxsc3WqeT.evidence: A full factorial study varies certification, communication, and base model across six scenarios in windy Gridworld and collapsing Blocksworld.
aIxsc3WqeT.claimed_gains: Given communication, enforcing verification reduces unsafe terminations from 17.3% to 0.0%.

tGeW9GiK2Q.one_liner: Active simulator queries target current world-model errors, while counterfactual action comparisons train action-effect dynamics.
tGeW9GiK2Q.problem: Static data miss evolving model weaknesses, and observational losses can encourage spurious correlations rather than action-effect causality.
tGeW9GiK2Q.method: OnlineWM adaptively queries a simulator for interaction sequences targeting current predictive weaknesses. Counterfactual fine-tuning contrasts different actions from identical states to link resulting transitions to action choices.
tGeW9GiK2Q.key_idea: Error-targeted simulator acquisition combines with same-state, different-action comparisons to train causally sensitive world dynamics.

FJOIGaczdE.one_liner: Representative-node replay reconstructs typed neighborhood context to preserve heterogeneous graph knowledge during continual learning.
FJOIGaczdE.problem: Replaying target nodes alone can lose relation-dependent context and distort historical representations and gradients in heterogeneous graph networks.
FJOIGaczdE.method: HERO analyzes replay error as target-selection and context-reconstruction components. Its DiSCo procedure selects representative target nodes with semantic consistency and rebuilds compact heterogeneous contexts through relation-aware multi-type neighbor expansion.
FJOIGaczdE.key_idea: Replay pairs representative target nodes with reconstructed typed neighborhoods to retain the structural context needed for historical gradients.
FJOIGaczdE.evidence: Replay-gradient analysis decomposes approximation error and explains why removing typed neighborhood context changes representations and historical gradients.

0HwdIddQeM.one_liner: List-relative membership estimates and set calibration recover non-contiguous skill combinations beyond ranked-prefix retrieval.
0HwdIddQeM.problem: Relevant skills interleaved with distractors prevent ranked prefixes from recovering correct skill sets even when all targets are retrieved.
0HwdIddQeM.method: SkillCraft treats post-retrieval selection as set resolution, using contextualized list-relative evidence to estimate non-monotonic membership probabilities. Candidate-level learning combines with set-level calibration to admit variable-size combinations while skipping high-ranked distractors.
0HwdIddQeM.key_idea: Non-monotonic membership probabilities and set-level calibration select variable-size, non-contiguous skill sets from ranked candidates.
0HwdIddQeM.evidence: Experiments on the 6600-skill SkillRet benchmark compare set recovery and set F1 with SkillRouter, SkillReason, and R3-Skill and analyze rank-prefix inseparability.

h2AYyJY7cs.one_liner: Persistent spatial tokens separately update known scene regions and admit new content before decoding streaming 3D Gaussians.
h2AYyJY7cs.problem: Online reconstruction must maintain a renderable scene state while incorporating both revisited regions and newly observed content.
h2AYyJY7cs.method: S2Tok uses a spatially informed transformer to integrate uncalibrated image streams into persistent scene tokens and a learned admission module to expand them selectively. A hierarchical decoder and Gaussian head render the evolving state without caching previous frames.
h2AYyJY7cs.key_idea: Separate token updates and learned admission maintain a size-adaptive persistent scene that decodes into non-pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians.
h2AYyJY7cs.evidence: Experiments across four benchmarks assess streaming rendering quality and compact Gaussian representations.

yU8XMH30g4.one_liner: Controlled repetition videos and final-layer linear probes separate encoded action counts from video-language models' reported answers.
yU8XMH30g4.problem: Video-language models can describe repeated actions yet fail to report how many complete cycles occur.
yU8XMH30g4.method: RepProbe controls repetition count, clip position, temporal coverage, and duration in real and synthetic videos. It compares generated counts with linear probes of the final-layer representations used for those outputs to locate counting failures.
