yU8XMH30g4.key_idea: Comparing output counts with linear decoding of final-layer states isolates whether repetition failures arise in representation or answer generation.
yU8XMH30g4.evidence: Evaluation uses 42K real and synthetic clips with 1 to 20 complete repetitions, controlling frame sampling, duration, position, and scene content.

zXZjuRa5wN.one_liner: Screening judgments steer evidence retrieval, exclusion reassessment, recovery, and stopping in a medical research agent.
zXZjuRa5wN.problem: Medical research agents can produce supported reports while missing eligible evidence because screening rarely guides subsequent searches.
zXZjuRa5wN.method: MedResearch reassesses exclusions using additional source text and stores eligibility judgments alongside search progress. A controller uses this memory to retrieve more evidence, trigger one-shot recovery, or stop before report synthesis, with model weights frozen.
zXZjuRa5wN.key_idea: Feed reassessed screening judgments and search progress into the controller that chooses further retrieval, recovery, or stopping.
zXZjuRa5wN.evidence: Experiments on MetaSyn and CLEF compare evidence-selection recall, F1, and report conclusion alignment against RAG and deep research baselines.

q8krpzdnwO.one_liner: Adversarially learned, whitened features supplement static Fréchet losses during generator post-training.
q8krpzdnwO.problem: Optimizing Fréchet distance in fixed feature spaces can improve target metrics while visual quality and alignment elsewhere deteriorate.
q8krpzdnwO.method: AdvFD adds a representation that maximizes real-versus-generated Fréchet discrepancy while the generator minimizes it. Whitening real features controls scale and covariance to prevent feature amplification from trivially increasing the objective.
q8krpzdnwO.key_idea: Jointly train an adversarial feature representation and generator under a Fréchet objective, using real-feature whitening to constrain the representation.
q8krpzdnwO.evidence: The abstract mentions experiments but does not specify their datasets, models, or complete results.

C68dkCRT6J.one_liner: A learned spatial codec compresses video history into landmark-indexed entries retrieved by camera pose.
C68dkCRT6J.problem: Video world models need compact long-term memory to recover earlier visual information when revisiting locations.
C68dkCRT6J.method: The codec compresses each video chunk into learned entries paired with landmarks summarizing content and observation location and time. A hierarchical, pose-indexed reader retrieves entries relevant to the generated view.
C68dkCRT6J.key_idea: Compress video chunks into learned entries and retrieve them through landmarks that encode content, location, and observation time.

s7QiebRlxy.one_liner: Action-driven camera displacement sets rotary world coordinates, while region-dependent noise schedules distinguish observed and newly exposed content.
s7QiebRlxy.problem: Feature-conditioned action control leaves planar-camera world models to learn motion geometry from data.
s7QiebRlxy.method: ActionRoPE converts camera displacement into parameter-free world-coordinate rotary positions so identical world locations retain positional addresses over time. Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling stabilizes observed regions earlier and generates newly exposed content with reference to them.
s7QiebRlxy.key_idea: Map action-induced camera motion to rotary world positions and assign denoising schedules according to whether coordinates were previously observed.
s7QiebRlxy.evidence: The abstract states a comparison with four action-conditioning mechanisms but does not provide the comparison results.

mBjfVGFp8m.one_liner: Schur-complement optimization alternates quantization-grid refitting and integer-code updates while accounting for correction by remaining continuous weights.
mBjfVGFp8m.problem: Low-bit quantization ignores corrections available from remaining continuous weights and often fixes the affine grid during discrete refinement.
mBjfVGFp8m.method: SchurOpt analytically eliminates the suffix response and alternates row-wise scale/zero-point refitting with integer-code coordinate descent. SchurQuant adds reference-weight anchoring, residual-add targets, and forward-only output-Fisher token weighting.
mBjfVGFp8m.key_idea: Eliminate the continuous suffix analytically to obtain a Schur-complement group objective, then alternate affine-grid refitting with discrete code optimization.
mBjfVGFp8m.evidence: Evaluations cover eight Llama and Qwen models, seven backpropagation-free methods, a fixed-GPTQ-objective comparison, and a gradient-enabled variant.
mBjfVGFp8m.claimed_gains: SchurOpt improves mean zero-shot accuracy on 2-bit Qwen3-4B by 10.59 percentage points; SchurQuant averages 53.41% versus CDQuant's 51.62% at 1.5x GPTQ quantization time, reaching 58.91% with gradients.

EPjGdDzsvf.one_liner: Learned key-query routing reuses or expands LoRA adapters as new audio-visual forgery types arrive.
EPjGdDzsvf.problem: Static DeepFake detectors struggle with emerging manipulation techniques and need incremental updates without full retraining or catastrophic forgetting.
EPjGdDzsvf.method: DEFEND freezes an audio-visual backbone and learns domain-specific LoRA adapters. A key-query router reuses adapters for similar manipulations and expands capacity for new ones.
EPjGdDzsvf.key_idea: Route incoming manipulation domains to reusable LoRA adapters and dynamically add adapters when existing ones are unsuitable.
EPjGdDzsvf.evidence: Evaluation uses a chronological stream of 23 manipulation domains and the KoDF, DeepSpeak, and MAVOS-DD benchmarks with BRAVEn and CLIP+CLAP backbones.
EPjGdDzsvf.claimed_gains: On BRAVEn, DEFEND reaches 89.7% average AUC, 8.5 points above the strongest continual learning baseline, using 11 adapters for 23 domains.

zcryqUXEAu.one_liner: Matched-state rollout returns choose the distillation teacher between skill-conditioned and skill-free agents and update skill memory.
zcryqUXEAu.problem: Retrieved textual skills can mislead agents, making a permanently privileged skill-conditioned teacher unreliable.
zcryqUXEAu.method: UCOB compares return-to-go from skill-conditioned and no-skill rollouts sharing a task and anchor state, then distills from the higher-return view. The credit signal also updates dual-granularity skill memory, retrieval, and reflection self-training.
zcryqUXEAu.key_idea: Choose the local distillation direction using return differences between skill-conditioned and no-skill rollouts from the same anchor state.
zcryqUXEAu.evidence: Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA compare skill-free RL, skill-augmented methods, and self-distillation baselines across model scales, with ablations.
zcryqUXEAu.claimed_gains: UCOB reports up to 23.5 and 18.0 absolute success-rate gains on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively, over the cited baselines.

T24nDY9okD.one_liner: Energy-distance tests compare hierarchical category groupings against random regroupings directly on data distributions.
T24nDY9okD.problem: Methods assume coarse-to-fine data organization without testing whether category distributions actually follow that hierarchy.
T24nDY9okD.method: The study formulates a recursive hierarchical data hypothesis and tests each parent-child relation without fitting a model. Energy distances between child distributions measure whether parent categories group children better than size-matched random regroupings.
T24nDY9okD.key_idea: Compare energy-distance organization of child distributions under observed parents against random parent assignments with identical group sizes.
T24nDY9okD.evidence: Tests support 18 of 22 relation-representation pairs across images, text, speech, and wrist accelerometry, with counterexamples and analyses of classifier errors and hierarchical self-supervision.

uXQjEWeopE.one_liner: A latent world model predicts action consequences that directly condition a pretrained vision-language-action policy's action expert.
uXQjEWeopE.problem: VLA policies lack explicit consequence modeling, while world action models often require costly video generation or pretraining.
uXQjEWeopE.method: WAVE-0 adds a 257M world model that converts latent action plans into predicted future representations used by the action expert. Training uses ground-truth robot actions and counterfactual ranking without pixel reconstruction or large-scale video pretraining.
uXQjEWeopE.key_idea: Condition the action expert on latent futures predicted from action plans by a world model trained with counterfactual ranking.
uXQjEWeopE.evidence: Evaluation reports robotic manipulation success on RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para.
uXQjEWeopE.claimed_gains: WAVE-0 reports 91.47% success on RoboTwin 2.0, 98.7% on LIBERO, and 88.0%, 61.4%, and 75.0% on LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and LIBERO-Para, respectively.

AsTEDuo5hR.one_liner: Removing proprioceptive inputs with relative end-effector actions tests spatial generalization of visuomotor policies.
AsTEDuo5hR.problem: Proprioceptive cues tied to constrained demonstration layouts can limit transfer to unseen spatial configurations.
AsTEDuo5hR.method: State-free Policies omit proprioceptive inputs while using visual observations and relative end-effector actions. The study varies state inputs, action representations, and task-relevant visual coverage.
AsTEDuo5hR.key_idea: Omit proprioceptive state inputs while predicting relative end-effector actions from sufficient task-relevant visual coverage.
AsTEDuo5hR.evidence: Real-world height and horizontal generalization experiments compare state-free policies with matched state-based policies.
AsTEDuo5hR.claimed_gains: Average success increases from 0% to 86% for height generalization and from 6% to 64% for horizontal generalization.

wvQLmIupWO.one_liner: Solved mathematical models supply both executable dynamics and scoring references for generated agentic reinforcement-learning environments.
wvQLmIupWO.problem: Environment-generation pipelines often construct dynamics before outcome rules, requiring evaluation to be aligned afterward.
wvQLmIupWO.method: The pipeline samples and solves a mathematical model before a corpus-grounded setter renders its decision process as stateful tools. Environment dynamics and trajectory-scoring references inherit the same solved model.
wvQLmIupWO.key_idea: Derive stateful tool dynamics and trajectory scores from one solved mathematical model before rendering an environment.
wvQLmIupWO.evidence: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B training covers three mechanism families, with evaluation on held-out instances, eight unseen families, and external function-calling, travel-planning, and e-commerce benchmarks.
wvQLmIupWO.claimed_gains: The pipeline generates 3,300 environments at a few cents each, and training raises mean agentic score from 0.204 to 0.815 in a five-family diagnostic.

ee0bbQDoIf.one_liner: Standardized isolated and forced-choice evaluations expose how benchmark framing changes measured demographic bias in language models.
ee0bbQDoIf.problem: Fragmented social-bias evaluations confound demographic bias with differences in task framing and contextual information.
ee0bbQDoIf.method: A unified framework standardizes heterogeneous benchmarks into isolated and comparative assessments while controlling chain-of-thought reasoning, neutral options, and other structural effects.
ee0bbQDoIf.key_idea: Compare isolated demographic assessments against forced choices under controlled reasoning, fallback options, and context.
ee0bbQDoIf.evidence: Evaluations across multiple model families find greater bias under forced comparison and stronger chain-of-thought effects in comparative settings.

cUPpMyQSMa.one_liner: COReformer retains promising incumbent structures, reduces routing problems to residual LinkGraphs, and re-solves them with SymNCO.
cUPpMyQSMa.problem: Global neural predictions struggle with complex constraints, while local construction handles constraints at the cost of sequential solving overhead.
cUPpMyQSMa.method: Reduce-then-Solve iteratively preserves promising structures from an incumbent solution and solves the residual problem. COReformer implements this with Perturbed Rectified Flow over perturbed-solution distributions to construct size-controlled LinkGraphs that SymNCO solves.
cUPpMyQSMa.key_idea: A global predictor preserves promising incumbent structures to form a smaller LinkGraph that a local constructor solves at each search iteration.
cUPpMyQSMa.evidence: Experiments evaluate COReformer on TSP, CVRP, and CVRPTW, while a learning-free Reduce-then-Solve implementation tests extension to MCut.

zAqCb9s2zj.one_liner: Cross-frame correspondence and object-presence states guide sequential 2D and 3D grounding predictions under streaming inputs.
zAqCb9s2zj.problem: Streaming visual grounding suffers from identity drift, inconsistent predictions across frames, and localization failures under partial occlusion.
zAqCb9s2zj.method: TempoGround associates instances across frames, predicts entry, continuation, or exit states, decodes 2D boxes, and lifts them to camera-frame 3D boxes. Streaming Grounding Reinforcement trains these predictions with grounding, identity, and consistency rewards.
zAqCb9s2zj.key_idea: Predict object correspondence and presence states before decoding 2D boxes and lifting them to 3D, with rewards enforcing grounding and temporal consistency.
zAqCb9s2zj.evidence: The abstract reports large-scale three-stage training and evaluation under causally streaming inputs; evaluation datasets and results are not stated in the supplied text.

1zRrWI9pJA.one_liner: UV relief maps encode avatar surface displacements and textures into latents that decode to texel-aligned 3D Gaussians.
1zRrWI9pJA.problem: Avatar-as-Image generation needs a compact latent representation that preserves human surface geometry and appearance.
1zRrWI9pJA.method: UVRelief bakes textured meshes into UV maps containing displacements relative to fitted SMPL-X surfaces and texture signals. A rendering-supervised VAE decodes UV latents into 3D Gaussian attributes, while a flow-matching prior supports image-conditioned avatar generation.
1zRrWI9pJA.key_idea: Encode geometry as per-texel displacements from SMPL-X surfaces and appearance as texture, then decode their UV latents into aligned Gaussian attributes.
1zRrWI9pJA.evidence: Reconstruction and generation experiments compare UVRelief with existing multi-view and latent avatar methods; datasets and numerical results are not stated.

UmrHhARv8z.one_liner: Two-level diffusion conditions dance generation on section-level musical structure and interval-level rhythm.
UmrHhARv8z.problem: Beat-focused dance generation often misses broader musical dynamics and fails to adapt choreography to transitions between musical sections.
UmrHhARv8z.method: HEDGE hierarchically segments music and motion into sections and intervals. Its two-level diffusion framework conditions dance sequences on global musical structure and local rhythmic cues.
UmrHhARv8z.key_idea: Hierarchical section and interval representations supply global structure and local rhythm to a two-level dance diffusion model.
UmrHhARv8z.evidence: The abstract reports experiments showing responsiveness to musical structure but does not name datasets, comparison methods, or numerical results.

yLVvdzj1BS.one_liner: A frozen clean-audio teacher supervises noisy-input audio language generation through token distillation and group-relative optimization.
yLVvdzj1BS.problem: Acoustic noise obscures task-relevant evidence and makes large audio language model responses unreliable.
yLVvdzj1BS.method: EchoDistill samples responses from a noisy-input student while a frozen copy of its backbone processes matching clean audio. Masked token distillation, task-gated consistency shaping, and teacher-referenced group-relative optimization align the student with clean-conditioned semantics.
yLVvdzj1BS.key_idea: Use matching clean audio as privileged teacher input to supervise noisy-input student responses through masked distillation and teacher-referenced group-relative optimization.
yLVvdzj1BS.evidence: Evaluations cover three LALM backbones and three audio domains at -10dB, acoustic-input replacement ablations, held-out additive noises, and external benchmarks.
yLVvdzj1BS.claimed_gains: EchoDistill improves average noisy-input accuracy by 1.63 percentage points over the strongest baseline, with Qwen2.5-Omni noisy-input accuracy rising from 59.33% to 62.94% and clean-audio accuracy from 76.56% to 77.56%.

ZURr9DUuu3.one_liner: Competing evidence agents and an arbitrator revise track judgments while reliable anchor masks guide bidirectional track refinement.
ZURr9DUuu3.problem: Training-free agentic referring video segmentation suffers from unreliable reasoning and imperfect object tracks.
ZURr9DUuu3.method: CER-RVS assigns two agents to collect supporting and counter-evidence for candidate tracks, with an independent arbitrator resolving conflicts and directing revisions. Anchor-Guided Track Refinement selects reliable, temporally consistent masks for bidirectional refinement and identity-consistent updates.
ZURr9DUuu3.key_idea: Contrast supporting and opposing track evidence through arbitration, then use reliable anchor masks to refine tracks bidirectionally.

rTMSsqRSH8.one_liner: Navigation-stage detection routes exploration cues or target-centered evidence to a shared UAV action policy.
rTMSsqRSH8.problem: UAV navigation methods use static input types despite different evidence needs before target discovery and during terminal control.
rTMSsqRSH8.method: The framework separates exploration from target-centered approach, regrounding, and reacquisition. Hint-conditioned target identification and lightweight target memory determine the stage and route its visual and textual evidence to a shared action policy.
rTMSsqRSH8.key_idea: Infer the navigation stage from current and remembered target evidence, then route stage-appropriate visual and textual inputs to a shared policy.
rTMSsqRSH8.evidence: Evaluation uses 3,005 TravelUAV test episodes spanning Seen, Unseen Object, and Unseen Map splits, with AerialVLA as a comparison.
rTMSsqRSH8.claimed_gains: Success rates reach 58.41%, 66.29%, and 40.71% on Seen, Unseen Object, and Unseen Map, exceeding AerialVLA by 10.45, 9.69, and 3.13 percentage points, respectively.

ZVm5YqO1RH.one_liner: Supervised adaptation teaches GUI agents to assess operational risk and stated authorization before choosing an action.
ZVm5YqO1RH.problem: GUI agents confuse visible, executable actions with authorization and stop clarifying underspecified requests when task-relevant screenshots are present.
ZVm5YqO1RH.method: The study varies screen context, harm-related wording, and stated non-consent in static single-turn interactions. AXIS-Core uses supervised adaptation to assess operational risk and stated authorization before making a decision.
ZVm5YqO1RH.key_idea: Assess operational risk and stated authorization explicitly before selecting a GUI action.
ZVm5YqO1RH.evidence: Experiments cover five models and two safety-prompted variants, a 2×2 wording study, and UI-Venus-1.5-8B comparisons with tuning variants and five prompted baselines.
ZVm5YqO1RH.claimed_gains: AXIS-Core reaches 98.5% held-out accuracy on UI-Venus-1.5-8B, taking zero unsafe actions on 134 danger records while completing all 18 required benign actions.

ZCbtbLdAP9.one_liner: Paired single-video and multi-video questions test whether egocentric observations retain identity and support reasoning across encounters.
ZCbtbLdAP9.problem: Aggregate cross-video accuracy conflates local perception errors with failures to preserve observation identity, match encounters, and compose evidence.
ZCbtbLdAP9.method: EgoGears uses repeated traversals of shared outdoor routes under different speeds and lighting conditions. Single-video questions test local evidence, while multi-video questions test observation binding and consistent route relationships.
ZCbtbLdAP9.key_idea: Compare local-video questions with cross-recording questions grounded in repeated traversals of the same environments.
ZCbtbLdAP9.evidence: EgoGears draws on 126 recordings across 39 routes and reports 29 single-video and 31 multi-video configurations across six model families.
ZCbtbLdAP9.claimed_gains: All 20 comparably evaluated configurations perform worse on multi-video questions, with a mean decrease of 22.5 percentage points.

fcnXw5Zfw2.one_liner: Decoding intermediate representations exposes denoising across network depth and supports compression into a single time-conditioned block.
fcnXw5Zfw2.problem: It is unclear how the denoising trajectory survives when diffusion generation compresses into a single forward pass.
fcnXw5Zfw2.method: The study decodes intermediate representations using each model's own output head to probe depthwise denoising. It uses this structure to compress a MeanFlow SiT-L/2 model into a single time-conditioned block.
fcnXw5Zfw2.key_idea: Treat denoising progression across network layers as a temporal structure that can be represented by a time-conditioned block.
fcnXw5Zfw2.evidence: Probes compare generative models and transport intervals, contrast drifting models without time-indexed transport training, and demonstrate compression of MeanFlow SiT-L/2.
fcnXw5Zfw2.claimed_gains: A MeanFlow SiT-L/2 model compresses by 16.6× in parameters into a single time-conditioned block.

XSkvOFfJ7I.one_liner: Isotropic Gaussian probes train sparse transcoders that decompose cross-attention output-value operators into interpretable writing directions.
XSkvOFfJ7I.problem: Attention maps show where text information goes but do not explain what each cross-attention head writes into visual features.
XSkvOFfJ7I.method: IsoProbe applies isotropic Gaussian inputs to fixed head-specific output-value operators and fits sparse transcoders to their outputs without text or image samples. Prompt analyses and interventions connect learned dictionary entries to concept-associated content.
XSkvOFfJ7I.key_idea: Fit a sparse writing dictionary to outputs of fixed cross-attention output-value operators excited by isotropic Gaussian inputs.
XSkvOFfJ7I.evidence: Prompt analyses identify concept-associated code subsets, while injections, patches, and ablations link entries to object, style, and attribute changes.

eGVhPvE3yq.one_liner: Executable interventions train recurrent goal, world, and plan states using shared-coupling recursive behavioral targets.
eGVhPvE3yq.problem: Agent memory objectives lack a criterion for which historical differences matter when goals, world conditions, or plans change.
eGVhPvE3yq.method: DYNACAST learns persistent registers from controlled futures generated by interventions in resettable environments. Canonical action classes and frozen argument-binding distributions make futures comparable, while shared transport couplings and a common maximizing control define global and component Bellman targets.
eGVhPvE3yq.key_idea: Use intervention-generated futures and shared transport couplings to derive recursively bootstrapped behavioral targets for goal, world, and plan registers.
eGVhPvE3yq.evidence: The analysis establishes exact-operator contraction and covered-value preservation, with experiments on eight benchmarks using Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B-IT, and Mistral-7B-Instruct.
eGVhPvE3yq.claimed_gains: Matched finite-horizon Bellman bootstrapping yields 1.6–3.1-point macro-averaged task-score gains over direct Monte Carlo metrics in both state architectures.

tgxQxDnRUk.one_liner: Question-conditioned downstream sensitivity and hardware costs determine which approximate video-attention blocks receive exact refinement.
tgxQxDnRUk.problem: Local attention approximation error does not reveal which corrections improve long-video answers within a compute budget.
tgxQxDnRUk.method: EWiM probes isolated corrections on sampled query rows and measures changes in a question-conditioned next-layer readout. A hardware-aware allocator selects full-block refinements using sensitivity scores and marginal costs, including probing overhead and shared computation.
tgxQxDnRUk.key_idea: Rank attention refinements by their effect on a question-conditioned downstream readout and allocate them using hardware-profiled marginal costs.
tgxQxDnRUk.evidence: Evaluation covers eight main model–benchmark pairs, controlled comparisons with local-error selection, additional backbones, and composition with token compression.
tgxQxDnRUk.claimed_gains: EWiM retains 99.2% of dense accuracy on average at a 1.46× geometric-mean speedup in time to first token, including visual encoding and acceleration overhead.

quQ7zCHe2E.one_liner: Bayesian memory updates advisor reliability from verified interactions to weight advice and choose consultation or autonomous reasoning.
quQ7zCHe2E.problem: Advisor capabilities vary across tasks, and misleading advice can make multi-agent consultation worse than reasoning alone.
quQ7zCHe2E.method: BaRe-Mem estimates advisor reliability from the central model's internal belief representations and updates estimates using historical interactions. These estimates weight external responses, govern consultation, and extend to worker allocation.
quQ7zCHe2E.key_idea: Maintain context-dependent Bayesian advisor-reliability estimates that control both advice influence and whether consultation occurs.
quQ7zCHe2E.evidence: Experiments span nine benchmarks and six central models, comparing misleading-advice robustness with debate and voting and testing worker allocation on MuSiQue.

bXrCVJ6zzg.one_liner: Transports learned vector-quantized codebook prototype priors to target latents via DiT rectified flow for non-autoregressive time-series forecasting.
bXrCVJ6zzg.problem: Diffusion time-series forecasters require many sampling steps, vector-quantized autoregressive models suffer from exposure bias, and existing latent flow-matching methods initialize transport from a generic Gaussian prior.
bXrCVJ6zzg.method: ProtoFlow maps multivariate time series into a discrete latent space using vector-quantized autoencoding and constructs a structured prior from the learned codebook prototypes. It then trains a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) rectified flow to transport samples non-autoregressively from this prototype prior to target latent states.
bXrCVJ6zzg.key_idea: Constructs a structured prior from learned VQ-VAE codebook prototypes and trains a DiT-based rectified flow for non-autoregressive latent multivariate time-series forecasting.

i8B2eGtvRL.one_liner: Isolates visual extraction across latent expert tokens and aggregates them via summary tokens using two-stage bottleneck-to-direct VLM training.
i8B2eGtvRL.problem: Existing latent visual reasoning methods let multiple latent tokens read identical visual evidence through shared value projections, producing redundant rather than complementary representations.
i8B2eGtvRL.method: Mixture of Latent Experts (MoLE) isolates what visual evidence each latent expert token observes and transforms during extraction, then aggregates their representations through dedicated latent summary experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces all visual evidence through this latent pathway before restoring direct visual access.
i8B2eGtvRL.key_idea: Restricts per-token visual observation and transformation pathways aggregated by latent summary tokens, trained first through a strict latent bottleneck before restoring direct visual access.
i8B2eGtvRL.evidence: Evaluated across eight visual reasoning benchmarks against data-matched supervised fine-tuning and latent reasoning baselines.
i8B2eGtvRL.claimed_gains: Across eight visual reasoning benchmarks, achieves an average score of 77.2, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 6.2.

ZgrGhERe3D.one_liner: Combines uncertainty-guided progressive aerial zoom search with depth-ring spatial signatures verified by an LVLM for wide-area cross-view localization.
ZgrGhERe3D.problem: Fine-grained ground-to-aerial localization typically assumes narrow geographic priors and fails over wide regions due to large scale disparities and visually ambiguous look-alike locations.
ZgrGhERe3D.method: RingMatch uses predictive uncertainty to identify plausible regions over wide aerial imagery and progressively zooms into candidate surroundings to collect fine-grained evidence. It then computes a depth-ring geometric representation of local spatial layout as a view-shared signature verified by a large vision-language model.
ZgrGhERe3D.key_idea: Uses predictive uncertainty to progressively zoom into candidate aerial regions and resolves look-alike ambiguity with an LVLM verifying view-shared depth-ring geometric signatures.
ZgrGhERe3D.evidence: Introduces the VIGOR-Pro wide-area benchmark constructed by composing VIGOR aerial tiles into contiguous regions.

B546IiiQzR.one_liner: Trains LLM agent context memory on unlabeled Wikipedia text via GRPO over multi-round masked reconstruction and intermediate recall.
B546IiiQzR.problem: Existing LLM memory-agent training relies on costly task-specific annotations that lack sufficient diversity to cover general long-horizon memory behaviors.
B546IiiQzR.method: MemTrain defines two coupled self-supervised proxy tasks over unlabeled Wikipedia corpora: recovering masked entities after multiple rounds of memory updates and reconstructing masked historical information from intermediate memory states. Both objectives are jointly optimized using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
B546IiiQzR.key_idea: Jointly optimizes multi-round end-to-end masked entity recovery and intermediate-state historical recall over unlabeled text corpora using Group Relative Policy Optimization.
B546IiiQzR.evidence: Trained on unlabeled Wikipedia corpora and evaluated on long-text QA and search-based QA benchmarks across multiple context lengths and language models.

Aiw7aS2yIx.one_liner: Couples latent sampling randomness across semantically similar multi-account queries while keeping within-account generation independent and distribution-preserving.
Aiw7aS2yIx.problem: Existing anti-distillation defenses either degrade output quality by perturbing generations or rely on behavioral detection that multi-account attackers can bypass.
Aiw7aS2yIx.method: Lossless Anti-Distillation Sampling (LADS) preserves independent sampling from the unmodified model distribution within each individual user account while coupling latent randomness across different accounts when queries are semantically similar.
Aiw7aS2yIx.key_idea: Preserve independent sampling within single user accounts while coupling latent randomness across accounts on semantically similar queries to correlate harvested datasets.
Aiw7aS2yIx.evidence: Supported by uniform convergence theory bounding the distiller's generalization gap relative to i.i.d. sampling and experiments on image generation and mathematical tasks (truncated in the abstract).

bgRSzfVsk9.one_liner: Batches exact differentiable second-order online updates on GPUs by running local interaction recurrences and dense matrix products over chunks.
bgRSzfVsk9.problem: Sequential matrix updates in second-order online learners are slow on GPUs, and response-dependent weights in logistic or robust losses prevent standard chunked batching and exact differentiation.
bgRSzfVsk9.method: FlashRLS reformulates recursive least squares, online Newton, recursive Laplace, and robust online learners into blocks that run local updates on a small observation-interaction matrix and batch dense computations into matrix products with exact backward gradients.
bgRSzfVsk9.key_idea: Execute response-dependent second-order online updates on small observation-interaction matrices within blocks while batching dense operations into exact differentiable matrix products.
bgRSzfVsk9.evidence: Proves exact forward and gradient equivalence to sequential execution and evaluates associative recall, outlier regression, Criteo, echo cancellation, and chaotic-system readouts.
bgRSzfVsk9.claimed_gains: Exact differentiation improves associative recall by 9.4 points and cuts outlier-regression MSE from 0.085 to 0.057, while FlashRLS achieves 38.8x, 42.3x, and 53.3x speedups on Criteo, echo cancellation, and chaotic-system readouts.

1yiuTo6CBO.one_liner: Combines a federated SCARF representation with support-aware local real-instance neighborhood completion and weighted Ridge surrogates for client explanations.
1yiuTo6CBO.problem: Sparse, imbalanced, or heterogeneous client data in federated learning leave local query neighborhoods with too little support for faithful local surrogate explanations.
1yiuTo6CBO.method: FLARE collaboratively trains a federated SCARF encoder to guide client-local source-target neighborhood construction over real instances, augmented by support-aware neighborhood completion and adaptive weighting for Ridge surrogate explanations.
1yiuTo6CBO.key_idea: Use a collaboratively trained SCARF encoder with support-aware neighborhood completion and adaptive weighting to fit local Ridge surrogate explanations without sharing raw data.
1yiuTo6CBO.evidence: Evaluated across five tabular datasets spanning seven classification tasks under source-target domain shifts, natural multi-client partitions, and varying client counts.

hhqMBPtskh.one_liner: Enforces recipient-specific federated LLM unlearning at model dispatch using source-specific adapter filters and proximal-anchored local fine-tuning.
hhqMBPtskh.problem: Standard federated unlearning produces a single global model that enforces forgetting for all participants rather than selectively revoking source-client data from designated target clients.
hhqMBPtskh.method: PULSAR builds portable adapter-style knowledge filters from unlearning operations and applies them during model dispatch to induce recipient-specific forgetting on target clients while leaving authorized clients' utility intact. Joint dual-objective optimization combines local fine-tuning with proximal anchoring to the filtered initialization to preserve forgetting during target adaptation.
hhqMBPtskh.key_idea: Apply portable unlearning adapter filters when dispatching models to target clients and anchor subsequent target-side fine-tuning to the filtered initialization.
hhqMBPtskh.evidence: Evaluated in single-round TOFU experiments and forgetting-for-all comparisons across multiple LLM backbones and federated unlearning settings against Retrain and Finetune references.

Y0WPLCc1l3.one_liner: Learned geometry-stabilized representations decouple turbulence restoration into stabilization and detail recovery.
Y0WPLCc1l3.problem: Atmospheric turbulence restoration models trained on synthetic data generalize poorly to real geometric distortions and spatially varying blur.
Y0WPLCc1l3.method: The method learns a geometry-stabilized intermediate representation from real turbulent videos while retaining residual blur, then restores details using physics-guided blurred/clean pairs. A training-free registration and refinement algorithm supports variable input-frame counts with fixed networks.
Y0WPLCc1l3.key_idea: Use temporal integration to learn a geometry-stabilized intermediate representation that separates geometric correction from blur restoration.
Y0WPLCc1l3.evidence: Evaluation across five real-world benchmarks measures perceptual quality, image sharpness, temporal stability, and downstream text recognition.

cVG2eV2lua.one_liner: Granger-style edge attribution distills compact explanatory communication subgraphs for multi-agent systems.
cVG2eV2lua.problem: Black-box topology optimization offers little insight into which communication edges are critical for multi-agent collaboration.
cVG2eV2lua.method: E2-Explainer masks communication channels and measures changes in task outcomes and final-response stability using a Granger-style objective. It constructs budgeted subgraphs from edge evidence and distills them into an amortized post-hoc explainer.
cVG2eV2lua.key_idea: Attribute communication edges by the task and response-stability effects of masking them, then amortize subgraph explanation.
cVG2eV2lua.evidence: Experiments on multiple reasoning and coding benchmarks evaluate whether the identified communication subgraphs preserve task performance.

p8xNqw3W5Y.one_liner: Text-conditioned diffusion transformer representations are aggregated across layers for image reward prediction.
p8xNqw3W5Y.problem: It is unclear whether representations learned for text-to-image generation can also support effective evaluation of generated images.
p8xNqw3W5Y.method: DiT-Reward repurposes pretrained diffusion transformers by aggregating text-conditioned image representations across layers with a lightweight learned head. It supports direct latent-space scoring when the policy and reward model share a latent space.
p8xNqw3W5Y.key_idea: Extract preference signals from complementary middle and late generative features of frozen diffusion backbones.
p8xNqw3W5Y.evidence: SD3.5-Large and Qwen-Image variants are evaluated on four preference benchmarks using the HPSv3 public data mixture, followed by Flow-GRPO optimization and human comparisons.
p8xNqw3W5Y.claimed_gains: The Qwen-Image variant reaches 79.1% accuracy on HPDv3, the SD3.5-Large reward policy wins 75.1% of 2,048 human comparisons with 21.6% losses and 3.3% ties, and direct latent scoring achieves a 1.65× speedup.

rPHQ1zDK2g.one_liner: Exact posterior supervision trains language models to track answer beliefs and source reliability.
rPHQ1zDK2g.problem: Language model agents must revise answer confidence and source trust as incomplete, noisy, or adversarial evidence arrives.
rPHQ1zDK2g.method: BayesClue provides a synthetic evidence-gathering environment with a known generative process and exact posterior probabilities over answers and source types. Exact Posterior Distillation trains models to predict these probabilities after each report.
rPHQ1zDK2g.key_idea: Distill exact Bayesian posteriors over answers and source types after every evidence report.
rPHQ1zDK2g.evidence: Experiments cover eight models from four families, a separate ten-model comparison with final-answer SFT, distribution shifts, longer horizons, and external evidence-judgment tasks.

qxESLbZN3q.one_liner: Structure-forcing diffusion restores low-frequency image structure before guiding pixel-space detail generation.
qxESLbZN3q.problem: Pixel-space super-resolution couples structural reconstruction and detail generation along one denoising trajectory, complicating joint optimization.
qxESLbZN3q.method: Sketch2Pix is a VAE-free pixel-space Diffusion Transformer that jointly predicts clean low-frequency structure and images through Dual-Time Joint Diffusion. Its Structure-Forcing Schedule reorders the two denoising trajectories so structure emerges before pixel refinement.
qxESLbZN3q.key_idea: Reorder structure and pixel denoising trajectories so recovered low-frequency structure guides subsequent pixel generation.
qxESLbZN3q.evidence: The stated support is the discovery that moderate structural restoration before image refinement improves restoration quality.

hbT0LNClOh.one_liner: Decomposes MLLM image Keys and Values into prior and residual components and amplifies deep-layer Key residuals without training.
hbT0LNClOh.problem: In MLLM text-to-image attention, deep-layer Values carry rich instance-aware content while Keys are dominated by an input-agnostic visual prior, causing a routing-content gap.
hbT0LNClOh.method: After decomposing Keys and Values into visual priors and instance-aware residuals, Image Key Steering amplifies the instance-aware residual component of deep-layer image Keys in a training-free manner.
hbT0LNClOh.key_idea: Amplifies the instance-aware residual component of deep-layer image Keys at inference to fix the routing-content asymmetry between Keys and Values.
hbT0LNClOh.evidence: Structural and cross-distribution analyses plus evaluations across four MLLMs and ten benchmarks.

mc2vpWIvQc.one_liner: Dynamically reparameterizes an equivalent parity-check matrix per received word using channel reliabilities to shrink Transformer decoder FFNs.
mc2vpWIvQc.problem: Feed-forward networks in Transformer-based error-correction decoders are a major parameter and compute bottleneck.
mc2vpWIvQc.method: FlexH is a parameter-free preprocessor that selects linearly independent columns prioritized by channel reliability and converts them into an identity block, preserving code constraints while allowing FFN expansion to shrink from 4 to 2.
mc2vpWIvQc.key_idea: Pivots parity-check matrices per received word onto unreliable positions via reliability-ordered Gaussian elimination to reduce Transformer FFN width.
mc2vpWIvQc.evidence: Experiments across three Transformer decoders on BCH, Polar, and punctured Reed-Muller codes, plus Chase-II and ML comparisons.
mc2vpWIvQc.claimed_gains: Reduces BER and BLER by roughly two orders of magnitude on average at 6 dB while decreasing parameters and FLOPs by about one third.

crzTlKYeox.one_liner: Amortizes LLM-guided hyperparameter optimization by inducing a reusable search policy and candidate queue over a state-adaptive horizon.
crzTlKYeox.problem: LLM-guided hyperparameter optimization methods invoke the LLM after every single trial over a growing history, inflating token cost and diluting signals.
crzTlKYeox.method: TUNE-R2 induces a reusable search policy from a bounded state and refines it into a queue of candidate configurations reused over a state-adaptive horizon before refreshing with new feedback.
crzTlKYeox.key_idea: Decouples LLM reasoning from per-trial evaluations by generating a queued search policy reused across an adaptive horizon.
crzTlKYeox.evidence: Experiments on OpenML, FCNet, NASBench-201, LLM fine-tuning, and kernel-SVM HPO.
crzTlKYeox.claimed_gains: Achieves the best overall regret, AOC, mean rank, and win rate among evaluated LLM-guided HPO methods while requiring 68%–93% fewer Tokens@Best.

JDLC0PsSIp.one_liner: Accelerates World Action Models via MARS by pruning attention, adapting diffusion steps to motion granularity, and speculatively reusing visual states.
JDLC0PsSIp.problem: World Action Models incur high inference latency from heavy visual encoding and iterative diffusion, limiting high-frequency closed-loop robot control.
JDLC0PsSIp.method: The authors propose MARS, a training-free framework that selectively prunes low-impact Transformer attention, adapts diffusion denoising speed to motion granularity, and speculatively reuses predicted future visual representations across consecutive policy queries with online verification.
JDLC0PsSIp.key_idea: Jointly pruning low-impact attention, adapting diffusion steps by motion granularity, and speculatively reusing verified visual predictions accelerates WAM inference without retraining.
JDLC0PsSIp.evidence: Experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboCasa benchmarks.
JDLC0PsSIp.claimed_gains: Achieves up to 4.00x and 3.94x speedups on tested benchmarks (with additional numbers truncated in abstract).

Zv4DiV0L7e.one_liner: Routes MLLM recognition strategies by fusing class-conditioned skill priors with visually similar profiling-image correctness records.
Zv4DiV0L7e.problem: MLLM recognition strategies have different execution costs and complementary strengths, requiring budget-aware selection before running a strategy.
Zv4DiV0L7e.method: Visual Evidence Fusion Routing (VEFR) estimates per-skill competence by combining class-conditioned skill statistics weighted by a soft visual class distribution with correctness records from visually similar profiling images via a validation-selected weight, decoupling competence estimation from deployment budget control.
Zv4DiV0L7e.key_idea: Fuses soft-class skill statistics and nearest-neighbor profiling correctness records to estimate strategy competence and route MLLM recognition under budgets.
Zv4DiV0L7e.evidence: Evaluations across eight fine-grained image recognition benchmarks comparing against fixed skills and routing baselines.

BllRd9MJT6.one_liner: Combines a recurrent anisotropic Gaussian state path with a time-indexed observation query-correction path for sparse flow reconstruction.
BllRd9MJT6.problem: Latent-state sparse flow reconstructors compress observations into one state, coupling temporal state updating with query readout across all coordinates.
BllRd9MJT6.method: GAUSSASSIM maintains a recurrent anisotropic Gaussian field state and routes observations through two paths: a state path that assimilates observations for decoding and propagation, and a query path that uses time-indexed observation tokens to correct each coordinate readout without modifying the state.
BllRd9MJT6.key_idea: Decouples observation assimilation into a recurrent anisotropic Gaussian state path and a non-mutating time-indexed query-correction readout path.
BllRd9MJT6.evidence: Evaluated on ACDM Inc and periodic FlowBench benchmarks across four settings using ten-seed factorial comparisons with 95% bootstrap intervals.
BllRd9MJT6.claimed_gains: Outperforms compared learned baselines in mean reconstruction error on ACDM Inc and periodic FlowBench, with all eight conditional dual-path gains having 95% bootstrap intervals above zero.

SpaUF4wO1r.one_liner: Pretrains an autoregressive Transformer on continuous calcium trace patches and adapts frozen weights via neuron, session, and task modules.
SpaUF4wO1r.problem: Existing neural population models for calcium imaging are designed for single datasets or tasks, limiting reuse across laboratories and species.
SpaUF4wO1r.method: CAPT tokenizes continuous calcium traces into patches and trains autoregressively with a mean squared error objective on large-scale mouse recordings. During transfer, the backbone stays frozen while neuron/session embeddings and task-specific heads are adapted.
SpaUF4wO1r.key_idea: Tokenizes continuous calcium traces into patches for autoregressive MSE pretraining, then freezes the backbone while adapting lightweight embeddings and heads.
SpaUF4wO1r.evidence: Pretrained on mouse calcium imaging data and evaluated on independent mouse, larval zebrafish, and C. elegans datasets for neural forecasting and behavior decoding.

agO3ZV0Dij.one_liner: Trains VLMs via GRPO on counterfactual tasks simulated by a physics engine from model-proposed world programs.
agO3ZV0Dij.problem: VLMs struggle with causal physical reasoning because observational videos lack grounded counterfactual trajectories under physical interventions.
agO3ZV0Dij.method: PhysEvolve has a shared VLM propose executable world programs, uses a deterministic physics engine to simulate matched baseline and body-elided counterfactual tasks, and updates the policy and curriculum via GRPO using exact verifier feedback.
agO3ZV0Dij.key_idea: Pairs VLM-proposed executable world programs with deterministic physics simulation of body-elided counterfactuals to generate GRPO training tasks.
agO3ZV0Dij.evidence: Evaluations starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on PhysBench, CausalPhys, and ContPhy without human intervention data.

v6vyYCoiBU.one_liner: Conditions driving prediction and planning on continuous behavioral coordinates and a prospect-theory nonlinear value model.
v6vyYCoiBU.problem: Autonomous driving pipelines optimize forecasting in geometric motion space while planning over interaction utility, causing geometrically similar predictions to yield different decisions.
v6vyYCoiBU.method: HSP infers continuous behavioral objective coordinates (safety, comfort, efficiency, social accommodation) to condition trajectory prediction and refinement, paired with a Prospect Value Model mapping interaction utility nonlinearly to decision value.
v6vyYCoiBU.key_idea: Links trajectory prediction and ego planning through inferred behavioral objective coordinates and a context-dependent nonlinear Prospect Value Model.
v6vyYCoiBU.evidence: Experiments across five prediction and planning benchmarks in diverse traffic settings.

VG9b5y6ujg.one_liner: Derives the exact deviation of SE(3) group interpolation from metric geodesics and a pre-training criterion for exact optimality.
VG9b5y6ujg.problem: SE(3) flow-matching models substitute closed-form conditional paths for expensive Riemannian geodesics without knowing the path error or when substitutes are already exact.
VG9b5y6ujg.method: The authors derive a closed-form second-order expansion for the deviation of SE(3) group interpolation from the true geodesic of the loss-induced metric. They then prove a criterion showing a factorized path solves the geodesic equation of a block metric exactly when the endpoint rotation axis is an eigenvector of the rotational block.
VG9b5y6ujg.key_idea: Expresses SE(3) group-interpolation geodesic deviation via the quadratic generator Lambda(u) and characterizes exact factorized-path optimality via rotation-axis eigenvector alignment.
VG9b5y6ujg.evidence: Theoretical proofs of the closed-form deviation expansion and the eigenvector optimality criterion (including Schur's lemma for body-frame-invariant losses).

3UcWOy5QMd.one_liner: Replaces spatial audio masks with speaker-identity conditioning for multi-person, multi-shot conversational video generation.
3UcWOy5QMd.problem: Existing multi-person talking-video models hard-route audio via spatial masks, failing under dynamic motion, off-screen speech, listener reactions, and shot cuts.
3UcWOy5QMd.method: M^2Talk decouples speaker identity from visual location using Speaker-Aware Audio Modulation (SAM), which encodes a Speaker Activity Timeline into time-aligned Speaker-Aware Embeddings without per-person spatial masks. Temporal Context Propagation maintains coherence across chunks, while Multi-Reference Visual Conditioning supplies shot references and an ID board for multi-shot transitions.
3UcWOy5QMd.key_idea: Modulates acoustic features with time-aligned Speaker-Aware Embeddings derived from a Speaker Activity Timeline, removing per-person spatial masks for multi-shot dialogue generation.
3UcWOy5QMd.evidence: Trained and evaluated on natural conversational videos with complex turn-taking, off-screen speech, and multi-shot transitions.

MtySiIyk6R.one_liner: Screens tool-response units against static field contracts, trajectory context, and source provenance to block state-corruption attacks.
MtySiIyk6R.problem: Tool-using agents lack provenance and informational authority checks on tool responses, enabling state-corruption attacks that mislead downstream guardrails.
MtySiIyk6R.method: PIPES screens tool-response units using static field contracts for structured schemas and trajectory-conditioned screening with trusted provenance metadata for open-ended content. It flags units violating semantic priors or provenance hierarchy for removal, warning, blocking, or escalation.
MtySiIyk6R.key_idea: Enforces schema contracts, trajectory-conditioned semantic priors, and source provenance hierarchies on tool-response units before agent perception.
MtySiIyk6R.evidence: Evaluated with atomic removal against adaptive PAIR-style attacks on Gemma 4 31B IT, GPT-5.6 Luna, and Claude Sonnet 5 across three VitaBench and three AgentDyn splits.
MtySiIyk6R.claimed_gains: Reduces average attack success from 83.3% to 6.5% for Gemma, from 27.4% to 4.6% for Luna, and from 11.5% to 4.4% for Sonnet without degrading average benign utility.

AwU646BQPF.one_liner: Replaces lossy LLM memory rewriting with incremental topic segmentation and multi-signal retrieval over raw conversations.
AwU646BQPF.problem: LLM-based memory construction rewrites raw interactions into structured units that become lossy, unstable, and expensive in long-horizon conversations.
AwU646BQPF.method: Threader preserves raw interactions as primary memory, organizes them into topic-coherent segments via lightweight incremental segmentation, and retrieves them using multi-view representations combining segment-level access with localized evidence matching.
AwU646BQPF.key_idea: Preserves raw interactions intact, segments them incrementally by topic, and performs multi-signal segment-plus-local retrieval instead of LLM memory rewriting.
AwU646BQPF.evidence: Evaluated in conversational agent experiments measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, and memory construction overhead.

o37XoGYYqA.one_liner: Uses a persistent, deduplicated research-state harness to keep autonomous LLM agents mining non-redundant alpha factors.
o37XoGYYqA.problem: Autonomous LLM alpha-mining agents tend to repeat known factors and produce candidates whose performance decays rapidly out of sample.
o37XoGYYqA.method: Ultralpha runs an LLM agent inside a protected closed-loop harness with metered feedback, action logging, and a persistent research state that deduplicates outputs and retains verified evidence.
o37XoGYYqA.key_idea: Maintains a persistent, deduplicated research state with metered feedback inside a closed-loop harness for long-horizon factor mining.
o37XoGYYqA.evidence: Evaluated on the A-share CSI300 universe across three base models and three test blocks.
o37XoGYYqA.claimed_gains: Delivers 32 to 46 deduplicated factors staying positive on test windows (95.7% to 97.0% retention), with Top-10 average 24h development IC of 0.0536 to 0.0576.

74utSEqFvr.one_liner: Identifies high-energy residual channels as a coherence substrate and trains bounded channel gains to adapt complementary channels.
74utSEqFvr.problem: The functional role of representational anisotropy in LLMs and how it interacts with SFT versus RL post-training remain unclear.
74utSEqFvr.method: The authors isolate ~5% outlier residual channels via a label-free rule, showing SFT reshapes them while RL preserves them and adapts complementary channels. They propose SphereGate, which learns one bounded gain per residual channel on a frozen backbone so activation-weighted gradients constrain high-energy channels.
74utSEqFvr.key_idea: Learns one bounded gain per residual channel on a frozen backbone, using activation-weighted gradients to protect high-energy coherence channels while adapting others.
74utSEqFvr.evidence: Evaluated via channel-ablation perplexity checks and MATH-500 fine-tuning on Qwen2.5 (0.5B-7B) and Llama-3-8B against parameter-efficient baselines.
74utSEqFvr.claimed_gains: Removing ~5% outlier channels raises perplexity from 10 to >10^6 (vs. 35 for random); SphereGate with 0.1M parameters outperforms PEFT baselines by 2.0-7.3 points on MATH-500.

HL675ONPJm.one_liner: Schedules training-free diffusion caching under exact compute budgets by estimating downstream error propagation risk.
HL675ONPJm.problem: Local step-to-step caching signals in diffusion models do not accurately reflect final output distortion because similar local errors propagate differently across denoising steps.
HL675ONPJm.method: PRICE is a training-free caching policy that estimates final output error from local discrepancy, solver step size, and downstream propagation. At each step, it compares this estimated risk against offline reference risks for remaining steps and adapts the threshold to the remaining reuse quota.
HL675ONPJm.key_idea: Estimates downstream propagation risk from local discrepancy and solver step size, comparing against offline reference risks under an exact reuse quota.
HL675ONPJm.evidence: Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, and Wan2.1 compare PRICE against representative diffusion caching baselines.
HL675ONPJm.claimed_gains: Achieves 5.24x acceleration on FLUX.1-dev, 6.87x on Qwen-Image, and 3.49x on Wan2.1.

7XxJRXv8bt.one_liner: Reshapes long-context attention with t-distributed directional matching to prevent proximal background from overshadowing distant evidence.
7XxJRXv8bt.problem: Long-context LLMs suffer from the Proximity Trap, where abundant task-irrelevant proximal background outcompetes distant relevant evidence in attention.
7XxJRXv8bt.method: LYRA introduces a t-distributed directional matching mechanism that reshapes the context retrieval attention distribution to concentrate attention mass on task-relevant evidence while preserving relative positional encoding. The authors also introduce ProxBench to measure distant evidence use under varying proximal background interference.
7XxJRXv8bt.key_idea: Replaces standard attention matching with t-distributed directional matching to concentrate attention mass on distant relevant tokens while preserving relative positions.
7XxJRXv8bt.evidence: Experiments on LongBench-v2, RULER, LongBench, and the newly introduced ProxBench.

rtgNIphX4H.one_liner: Solves graph few-shot class-incremental learning replay-free using Potts MRF topological priors and drift-aware analytic distillation.
rtgNIphX4H.problem: Graph few-shot class-incremental learning suffers from novel-class overfitting due to scarce labels and representation drift caused by cross-session edges altering historical node neighborhoods.
rtgNIphX4H.method: MAGIC combines a frozen graph backbone with closed-form analytic continual learning. It learns a homophilous/heterophilous topological prior injected via Potts Markov random field inference to refine novel supervision, and uses drift-aware analytic distillation to transfer old predictions to updated historical node representations.
rtgNIphX4H.key_idea: Combines a frozen graph backbone with Potts MRF topological prior inference for novel classes and closed-form drift-aware analytic distillation for historical nodes.
rtgNIphX4H.evidence: Experiments across five datasets and eight baselines in graph few-shot class-incremental learning.

9ZQYV67iXu.one_liner: Treats evolving video captions as reasoning state to adaptively acquire visual, temporal, or external grounding evidence.
9ZQYV67iXu.problem: Dense video captioning models using fixed perceptual contexts struggle to achieve comprehensive fine-grained coverage while maintaining factual grounding and global coherence in long captions.
9ZQYV67iXu.method: OACap is an agentic video captioner that treats the evolving caption itself as the reasoning state. It detects missing, unsupported, or inconsistent claims in the draft caption and adaptively fetches additional visual, temporal, or external evidence to verify and refine it.
9ZQYV67iXu.key_idea: Uses the evolving caption as reasoning state to trigger adaptive acquisition of visual, temporal, or external evidence for unsupported or missing details.

HJruS8qqH8.one_liner: Answer-readiness changes switch on-policy distillation between reverse and forward KL according to student progress.
HJruS8qqH8.problem: Uniform on-policy distillation can reward local teacher alignment while compact agents repeatedly act without advancing toward an answer.
HJruS8qqH8.method: Δ-OPD measures step-wise changes in student answer readiness on student-generated trajectories. It applies reverse KL to progress-driving interactions, forward KL to low-progress steps, and skips saturated interactions on verified-success trajectories.
HJruS8qqH8.key_idea: Condition the distillation divergence on realized changes in answer readiness rather than applying one uniform objective to every state.
HJruS8qqH8.evidence: Evaluation on OmniGAIA uses a Qwen3.5-4B student and compares against standard OPD without additional rollouts or inference overhead.
HJruS8qqH8.claimed_gains: The supplied abstract states a starting accuracy of 40.8% under standard OPD on OmniGAIA but truncates the Δ-OPD result.

lECATRfbhM.one_liner: Support-conditioned spectral graphs and gated recurrence adapt frozen tactile encoders using few labeled target contacts.
lECATRfbhM.problem: Tactile foundation models degrade on unfamiliar sensors, and existing cross-sensor methods often need calibration data, paired observations, or iterative training.
lECATRfbhM.method: BIDETA jointly labels an unlabeled query batch using a frozen tactile encoder and a few labeled target contacts. Rapid support memory, support-conditioned spectral graphs, and reliability-gated recurrence repair feature neighborhoods and propagate reliable cross-query evidence without gradients.
lECATRfbhM.key_idea: Repair target-sensor feature neighborhoods with support-conditioned graphs and recurrently share reliability-gated evidence across queries.
lECATRfbhM.evidence: Experiments on SITR, TacVerse Shape, and TacQuad vary labeled target data, pretrained backbones, and tactile tasks, including a frozen-source Sparsh comparison.
lECATRfbhM.claimed_gains: With only 10% labeled target data on SITR, BIDETA raises mean Sparsh accuracy from 6.86% to 87.09%, exceeding the strongest implemented prior comparison by 47.22 percentage points.

9mTpnIbSLq.one_liner: Prompt grouping cues change whether LLMs retrieve absolute, group, or within-group positions.
9mTpnIbSLq.problem: Existing LLM evaluations ask what occupies a position rather than whether prompts control access to multiple positional descriptions of an item.
9mTpnIbSLq.method: The study probes controlled English and Chinese sequences of familiar words across five LLMs. It manipulates familiarity statements and visible group boundaries, then measures absolute, group, and within-group position reports under varied group lengths and destroyed word structure.
9mTpnIbSLq.key_idea: Structural prompt cues reorganize retrieval among separable absolute-rank, group-position, and local-rank descriptions.
9mTpnIbSLq.evidence: Controlled English and Chinese word-sequence experiments across five LLMs test group visibility, familiarity cues, variable group lengths, rank correlations, and absolute-position errors.

1yaTth8ZRz.one_liner: Incorporates MoE activation ratio as a multiplicative power-law factor into learning-rate and batch-size scaling laws.
1yaTth8ZRz.problem: Standard hyperparameter scaling laws based on total or activated parameters fail to transfer optimal learning rates and batch sizes across ultra-sparse MoE sparsity levels.
1yaTth8ZRz.method: From 1,800 pretraining runs spanning six activated-parameter scales up to 6B non-embedding parameters, the authors derive unified laws where optimal batch size scales as a power law in tokens D, optimal learning rate scales with compute C, and activation ratio A enters both as a multiplicative power-law factor.
1yaTth8ZRz.key_idea: Models MoE activation ratio as a multiplicative power-law factor on token-scaled batch size and compute-scaled learning rate.
1yaTth8ZRz.evidence: Fitted on 1,800 pretraining runs (~20T tokens, 200,000 H800 GPU-hours) up to 6B parameters and validated on a held-out 12B ultra-sparse MoE with 1/64 expert activation.

qsadzAHB2Q.one_liner: Aligns coordinate frames, arm-configuration action mappings, Cartesian states, and viewpoints for cross-embodiment robot transfer.
qsadzAHB2Q.problem: Even with a shared end-effector format, embodiment-specific mismatches across frames, kinematics, states, and camera viewpoints degrade cross-embodiment robot policy transfer.
qsadzAHB2Q.method: Keeping the policy architecture unchanged, the authors conduct a data-centric alignment study explicitly aligning four factors—frame coordinates, action mapping across arm configurations, Cartesian states, and observation viewpoints—and evaluate transfer on source-only tasks tested on a target robot.
qsadzAHB2Q.key_idea: Explicitly aligns coordinate frames, action mappings, Cartesian states, and camera viewpoints across robot embodiments without altering the policy.
qsadzAHB2Q.evidence: Evaluated on real-world cross-embodiment robot manipulation skill transfer with component and shared-task analyses.
qsadzAHB2Q.claimed_gains: In real-world skill transfer, data alignment alone achieves 90.5% success compared with 34.8% for naive data mixing.

5xqtpXdWpJ.one_liner: Adaptively retrieves approximate continuations from an LLM's own reasoning trajectory into a shared speculative-decoding tree.
5xqtpXdWpJ.problem: Long chain-of-thought reasoning incurs high sequential decoding latency while repeatedly generating patterns that small draft models alone do not fully exploit.
5xqtpXdWpJ.method: Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR) retrieves approximately matched continuations from the current reasoning trajectory, uses recent verification outcomes to gate retrieval activation and candidate width, and merges retrieved drafts with model-generated drafts in a shared verification tree preserving exact target distributions.
5xqtpXdWpJ.key_idea: Gates approximate trajectory-local continuation retrieval by recent verification outcomes and merges it with draft-model trees for exact speculative verification.
5xqtpXdWpJ.evidence: Evaluated across code debugging, mathematics, and open-ended writing tasks comparing token acceptance and end-to-end throughput.

F923M3aoP7.one_liner: Trains a vision-language agent via multi-reward reinforcement fine-tuning to select or fuse frozen monocular depth experts per image.
F923M3aoP7.problem: Single monocular depth estimators encode fixed camera assumptions and fail to generalize across perspective, fisheye, and panoramic camera geometries.
F923M3aoP7.method: DepthAgent treats existing depth models as frozen tools, analyzes scene and camera cues over multi-turn tool calls, and selects or fuses expert predictions per input. A multi-reward reinforcement fine-tuning scheme optimizes tool execution validity, camera/scene analysis, expert-selection quality, and inference efficiency.
F923M3aoP7.key_idea: A vision-language agent trained with multi-reward reinforcement fine-tuning invokes frozen depth models across turns and selects or fuses their outputs based on input camera and scene cues.
F923M3aoP7.evidence: Evaluated across perspective, fisheye, and panoramic depth estimation benchmarks.

c9AtpLTAOS.one_liner: Alternates textual-inversion recovery discovery with trajectory-aware erase-retain defense to mitigate optimizer-history conflicts in diffusion unlearning.
c9AtpLTAOS.problem: In text-to-image diffusion unlearning, shared optimizer momentum states and fixed memory turn compatible single-step erase and retain gradients into conflicting trajectories over training.
c9AtpLTAOS.method: RRCE alternates a recovery phase that uses textual inversion to find representations still able to regenerate the target concept with a defense phase that suppresses those representations while accounting for optimizer-history conflicts.
c9AtpLTAOS.key_idea: Alternating textual-inversion recovery discovery with trajectory-aware erase-retain updates prevents accumulated optimizer moment states from creating cross-step gradient antagonism.
c9AtpLTAOS.evidence: Evaluated across unsafe-content, object, and artistic-style concept erasure tasks in text-to-image diffusion models.

9xO8N2Gto8.one_liner: Decomposes agentic spatial reasoning by reconciling multi-view depth and masks into a unified metric 3D scene.
9xO8N2Gto8.problem: Spatial agents struggle because independent reconstruction and segmentation tools produce inconsistent predictions and fragmented 3D object identities.
9xO8N2Gto8.method: DeSpatial separates spatial understanding into reasoning and a shared 3D perception tool that builds a unified, metric, gravity-aligned 3D scene. The tool combines single-frame joint segmentation-depth co-refinement to remove projection artifacts with cross-view instance fusion that merges voxel-overlapping and disjoint multi-view fragments without merging same-frame instances.
9xO8N2Gto8.key_idea: Reconcile per-frame segmentation-depth co-refinement with constrained cross-view instance fusion into a shared, metric, gravity-aligned 3D scene tool.
9xO8N2Gto8.evidence: Includes an oracle experiment replacing tool-predicted perception with ground-truth 3D bounding boxes across five object-centric VSI-Bench tasks.

Zra9QuUaTi.one_liner: Formulates single and composite periodicity algebraically and benchmarks Transformer OOD generalization on the Coper dataset.
Zra9QuUaTi.problem: Transformers lag behind humans in out-of-distribution generalization, including basic periodic pattern extraction and composition.
Zra9QuUaTi.method: The authors formulate a group-theoretic and abstract-algebra interpretation of single and composite periodicity to analyze Transformer limitations. They build Coper, a controllable generative dataset for composite periodicity with Hollow and Extrapolation OOD settings.
Zra9QuUaTi.key_idea: Analyze single and composite periodicity via abstract algebra and test Transformer OOD generalization using Hollow and Extrapolation splits on Coper.
Zra9QuUaTi.evidence: Provides group-theoretic analysis and empirical experiments on the Coper composite-periodicity dataset.

rM1XQuFzb8.one_liner: Decomposes closed-loop test-time training degradation causally and gates updates via Settlement on independent real text.
rM1XQuFzb8.problem: Retaining test-time training weight updates from a model's own generated text destabilizes long-horizon adaptation and degrades prediction of real text.
rM1XQuFzb8.method: The authors run three matched causal comparisons—Fixed Generation, Recorded Replay, and single-update branching—to separate attention-context loss from weight-stored closed-loop feedback. They propose Settlement, which evaluates the complete candidate updated state on independent real text before committing weight updates.
rM1XQuFzb8.key_idea: Isolate closed-loop self-generation feedback via matched interventions and gate candidate test-time weight states on independent real text before commitment.
rM1XQuFzb8.evidence: Evaluated over 128K-token streams on TTT-E2E models at 125M, 760M, and 3B scales and Adam-updated Qwen3-4B.
rM1XQuFzb8.claimed_gains: Fixed Generation removes 97.5% of measured damage, and Settlement reduces the endpoint gap to at most .07 nats at 125M and 760M scales.

NkRzAfYrku.one_liner: Self-distills verified spatial coding-agent traces into a tool-free MLLM using repetition-masked unlikelihood regularization.
NkRzAfYrku.problem: Spatial coding agents rely on external tools and incur high inference overhead, motivating standalone tool-free spatial reasoning in MLLMs.
NkRzAfYrku.method: SpatialOPSD performs on-policy self-distillation by treating summarized verified spatial coding-agent execution traces as privileged information that elicits internal spatial CoT. To prevent privileged-information leakage during distillation, it introduces Repetition-Aware Distillation combining repetition masking with unlikelihood regularization.
NkRzAfYrku.key_idea: Use verified coding-agent traces as privileged teacher context for on-policy self-distillation with repetition masking and unlikelihood regularization.
NkRzAfYrku.evidence: Evaluated against SFT and GRPO baselines across multiple spatial and out-of-distribution benchmarks.

1CHuuGbGkf.one_liner: Diagnoses industrial time-series forecasting bias across pathological regimes via the Regime-wise Relative Bias Vector.
1CHuuGbGkf.problem: Time-series forecasters that rank well on aggregate benchmarks exhibit severe systematic bias in industrial deployments due to loss-configuration misspecification.
1CHuuGbGkf.method: The authors characterize how normalization, pooling, and loss hyperparameters shift the effective estimand in zero-inflated, skewed, and high-variance regimes. They introduce a pathology taxonomy, the metric-agnostic Regime-wise Relative Bias Vector (RBV) diagnostic with oracle dispersion attribution, and RetailShiftBench.
1CHuuGbGkf.key_idea: Audit systematic forecasting mismatch per pathological data regime using RBV and attribute bias to normalization, pooling, and loss-configuration operators against an oracle dispersion reference.
1CHuuGbGkf.evidence: Uses controlled attribution analysis comparing observed regime-wise bias against a loss-implied oracle dispersion reference and calibration on RetailShiftBench.

qDodr0QKgk.one_liner: Transfers frozen white-box behavioral probes across LLMs using all-layer global anchored relative representations.
qDodr0QKgk.problem: Standard activation probes depend on model-specific native coordinates and layer choices, preventing reuse across independently trained or updated LLMs without labeled target data.
qDodr0QKgk.method: The authors represent each input via angular distances to a shared anchor set and introduce a global anchored construction that aggregates across all transformer layers to eliminate layer selection. A frozen probe trained on one model can then be directly applied to another model.
qDodr0QKgk.key_idea: Represent examples by angular distances to shared anchors summarized across all transformer layers so frozen probes transfer across models without retraining.
qDodr0QKgk.evidence: Evaluated on cross-model probe transfer across trivia datasets, safety monitoring, and mathematical reasoning, as well as scale, prompt, and model-update shifts.
qDodr0QKgk.claimed_gains: Transferred global anchored probes preserve at least 85% of same-model probe AUROC over chance on average.

OBuvSszJzL.one_liner: Accelerates implicit neural representation training by probabilistically sampling coordinates via closed-form target-neighborhood sensitivity.
OBuvSszJzL.problem: Training implicit neural representations over all observed coordinates is computationally slow.
OBuvSszJzL.method: STaNS treats each observed coordinate as a target-neighborhood representative and defines TaN sensitivity as the worst first-order growth of local prediction-target mismatch under infinitesimal coordinate offsets. During training, it dynamically updates coordinate-wise scores from closed-form TaN sensitivity to sample informative coordinates probabilistically.
OBuvSszJzL.key_idea: Compute closed-form first-order target-neighborhood sensitivity per coordinate to dynamically drive probabilistic subset sampling during INR training.
OBuvSszJzL.evidence: Validated across audio, image, shape, and neural radiance field (NeRF) reconstruction tasks.
OBuvSszJzL.claimed_gains: Reduces time-to-quality by up to 23.41% over existing samplers and delivers up to 3.74x acceleration.

LdEA4ALxYV.one_liner: Rectifies contaminated time-series labels via perturbation deviation trajectories and extrapolates unseen anomaly prototypes.
LdEA4ALxYV.problem: Open-set time-series anomaly detectors overfit seen anomalies when unlabeled anomalies contaminate normal data and fail to cover unseen anomaly types.
LdEA4ALxYV.method: TURPLE tracks perturbation-induced deviation trajectories from a pretrained deviation-aware detector with a seen head to detect and relabel latent anomalies in normal training data. Using the rectified labels, it builds normal and anomaly prototypes and applies prototype-repulsive extrapolation to generate unseen anomaly prototypes for training an unseen head.
LdEA4ALxYV.key_idea: Track perturbation-induced deviation trajectories to rectify contaminated normal labels, then extrapolate unseen anomaly prototypes via prototype repulsion.

Vutkw062tM.one_liner: Selects LLM configurations efficiently using cost-aware Bayesian bandit Gittins indices and LCB anytime recommendations.
Vutkw062tM.problem: Exhaustively evaluating every candidate LLM configuration across all benchmark items to find a top performer is expensive.
Vutkw062tM.method: GittinsEval models configuration selection as a cost-aware Bayesian bandit problem and allocates evaluation budget via Gittins-index policies after offline precomputation. It pairs allocation with a separate LCB-style anytime recommendation rule over fully and partially evaluated candidates and a cost-quality stopping rule.
Vutkw062tM.key_idea: Allocate benchmark evaluations using precomputed cost-aware Gittins indices while recommending candidates with an uncertainty-aware LCB rule.
Vutkw062tM.evidence: Evaluated against Bayesian optimization and cost-unaware frequentist baselines across tasks varying in candidate count and benchmark size.
Vutkw062tM.claimed_gains: Often attains near-zero simple regret using 1%–2% of exhaustive-evaluation cost, with its stopping rule typically triggering at 1%–10% cost.

kKRzRavzAM.one_liner: Measures conditional visual grounding across multimodal generation by restoring image regions while holding generated text fixed.
kKRzRavzAM.problem: It is unclear whether multimodal model answers remain grounded in relevant image regions as explanations unfold or when models revisit images.
kKRzRavzAM.method: RegionTrace fixes the target answer and generated prefix at each generation stage and measures how restoring specific image regions changes the answer score. This tracks attribute-error sources, regional support decay during explanations, and effects of explicit visual revisits.
kKRzRavzAM.key_idea: Hold generated text and target answer fixed at each stage and score answer-probability changes when restoring individual image regions.
kKRzRavzAM.evidence: Experiments across three vision-language models, four benchmarks, and 7,206 explanation traces spanning six model-task settings.
kKRzRavzAM.claimed_gains: In color-misbinding errors, the color-bearing distractor outweighs the queried region in 68.0–97.9% of cases, and a complete-image probe matches the eventual answer in 86–92% of traces before explanation begins.

64xEFyYdcb.one_liner: Replaces all-fail RLVR rollout groups with peer-model trajectories using compatibility weighting and importance clipping.
64xEFyYdcb.problem: Finite rollout budgets in RLVR methods like GRPO yield all-fail prompt groups that provide zero reward-based policy-gradient signal.
64xEFyYdcb.method: GRAFT (Gated Replacement of Answer-Failed groups with peer Trajectories) replaces a model's all-fail groups with informative successful and unsuccessful trajectories and advantages from a heterogeneous peer model. It controls cross-model off-policy mismatch through sequence-level compatibility weighting and token-level importance-ratio clipping.
64xEFyYdcb.key_idea: Substitute all-fail rollout groups with peer-model trajectories and peer-computed advantages regulated by sequence compatibility weights and token importance clipping.
64xEFyYdcb.evidence: Evaluated against rollout-matched GRPO across three heterogeneous model pairs and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, including offline stored-trajectory settings.
64xEFyYdcb.claimed_gains: Gains 2.1 points on average and up to 4.5 points in model-level average performance over GRPO; stored peer trajectories gain 1.8 points on average without simultaneous co-training.

KsN92HODx9.one_liner: Wraps world action models in a VLM task-graph manager, executable skill compiler, and event-triggered progress verifier.
KsN92HODx9.problem: World Action Models rely on finite-horizon prediction and lack global planning, cross-stage state tracking, outcome verification, and failure recovery.
KsN92HODx9.method: HarnessWAM pairs a VLM-based Task Manager that maintains an evidence-grounded scene belief and task graph with capability-conditioned executable-space projection into WAM-supported skill sequences. During execution, a lightweight progress estimator triggers Task Manager deliberation to advance, gather evidence, replan, or perform local recovery preserving scene knowledge.
KsN92HODx9.key_idea: Compile a VLM task graph into WAM-executable skills and couple a lightweight progress estimator with event-triggered deliberation and local recovery.
KsN92HODx9.evidence: Evaluated on full-task and subtask success rates in RoboMemArena.

BsXDM8Z5qi.one_liner: Converts LLM memory pipelines into executable evolution graphs for iterative root-cause attribution and prompt repair.
BsXDM8Z5qi.problem: LLM memory systems for long-horizon reasoning fail systematically and are difficult to debug at the operation level.
