BsXDM8Z5qi.method: MemTrace represents memory pipelines as executable memory evolution graphs and iteratively traces operation subgraphs to attribute root-cause failures such as information loss and retrieval misalignment. It feeds these attribution signals into closed-loop prompt optimization and introduces MemTraceBench from Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS.
BsXDM8Z5qi.key_idea: Transform memory pipelines into executable evolution graphs, iteratively attribute failure subgraphs, and use attribution signals for closed-loop prompt optimization.
BsXDM8Z5qi.evidence: Constructs and evaluates on MemTraceBench spanning Long-Context, RAG, Mem0, and EverMemOS pipelines.
BsXDM8Z5qi.claimed_gains: Closed-loop attribution-guided prompt optimization boosts end-task performance by up to 7.62 percentage points.

NDLxJ6yqt1.one_liner: Measures production-serving energy consumption alongside benchmark scores across 86 open-weight LLMs and six hardware platforms.
NDLxJ6yqt1.problem: Standard LLM benchmarks report capability scores without measuring the energy required to deliver that capability under production serving.
NDLxJ6yqt1.method: The authors directly measure energy consumption and benchmark accuracy for 86 open-weight checkpoints across seven benchmarks and six hardware platforms (from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server), analyzing score-energy Pareto frontiers, reasoning mode, token-count proxies, FP8 quantization, and hardware scaling.
NDLxJ6yqt1.key_idea: Directly profiles production-serving energy against benchmark capability across models, quantization, thinking modes, and hardware to map score-energy Pareto frontiers.
NDLxJ6yqt1.evidence: Measurements across 86 open-weight model checkpoints, seven benchmarks, and six hardware platforms ranging from a consumer GPU to an eight-GPU server.
NDLxJ6yqt1.claimed_gains: Non-frontier configurations use a median of 2.6-4.8x (up to 27x) more energy for equal or lower scores; enabling thinking increases energy by about 3.7x on average; token count misorders 18-24% of model pairs; FP8 reduces energy by roughly a quarter with little score change.

hrYycfhjgH.one_liner: Materializes historical foundation-model intermediate embeddings as structured input sequences for compact serving recommenders.
hrYycfhjgH.problem: Scalar knowledge distillation from large foundation models to compact serving recommenders suffers from a diminishing transfer ratio because a single scalar cannot convey rich intermediate representations.
hrYycfhjgH.method: LoopFM opens a high-bandwidth transfer channel by structuring historical intermediate embeddings from a foundation model as input features (such as user history sequences) for downstream vertical models without real-time FM serving or architectural coupling, accompanied by a gain-decomposition and transfer-ratio analysis.
hrYycfhjgH.key_idea: Feeds materialized historical intermediate embeddings from a foundation model as structured sequence input features to compact serving models.
hrYycfhjgH.evidence: Supported by theoretical transfer-ratio analysis, experiments on three public benchmarks including TaobaoAd, and industrial-scale deployments with billions of examples and trillion-parameter FMs.
hrYycfhjgH.claimed_gains: Delivers 6%+ relative AUC improvement on TaobaoAd, roughly doubles the knowledge transfer ratio on top of KD in industrial systems, and yields +0.5%, +1.03%, and +1.22% conversion gains across launches.

TarySPwqXa.one_liner: Introduces a 40,130-image group-disjoint marine mollusc benchmark jointly evaluating classification, retrieval, captioning, and condition sensitivity.
TarySPwqXa.problem: Fine-grained visual recognition of marine molluscs lacks a provenance-aware, group-disjoint benchmark that jointly tests classification, representation retrieval, taxonomic errors, and imaging condition sensitivity.
TarySPwqXa.method: ShellfishNet provides 40,130 images across 100 marine mollusc classes organized into 30,879 acquisition or observation groups, evaluating models on classification, image-to-image retrieval, taxonomic error structure, captioning, and generic plus marine-inspired synthetic transformations.
TarySPwqXa.key_idea: Evaluates fine-grained mollusc recognition across group-disjoint splits combining classification, retrieval, taxonomic error analysis, captioning, and synthetic marine perturbations.
TarySPwqXa.evidence: Benchmarks representative CNN, transformer, hybrid/efficient, self-supervised, vision-language, and open captioning models on ShellfishNet.

Emkpmtki9m.one_liner: Probes in-context RL task estimates outside the training convex hull and proves affine prompt statistics enable extrapolation.
Emkpmtki9m.problem: Held-out evaluation of in-context RL agents typically tests interpolation inside the training task hull and conflates wrong task inference with failed policy execution.
Emkpmtki9m.method: The authors evaluate prompted decision transformers and classical encoders beyond the convex hull of training-task parameters by reading out internal task estimates while varying only the prompt. They prove that averages of training tasks cannot leave the hull whereas an affine function of a prompt statistic can, and test supplying ground-truth task codes out of hull.
Emkpmtki9m.key_idea: Reads internal task estimates outside the training-task convex hull and separates inference extrapolation from execution failure via affine prompt-statistic coding.
Emkpmtki9m.evidence: Supported by theoretical proof and experiments on prompted decision transformers (up to ~60x larger and across task-count scales), expert-conditioned transformers, and three classical encoders.

88x46KwEyF.one_liner: Trains an agentic visual reasoning MLLM with Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward and Hint-Guided Capability Expansion.
88x46KwEyF.problem: Existing agentic visual reasoning MLLMs exhibit poor mode adaptiveness, invoking tools unnecessarily and introducing errors on easy examples that offset gains on hard examples.
88x46KwEyF.method: The authors quantify Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect in agentic visual reasoning and propose Beacon, an MLLM trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Its RL stage centers on a Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward and a Hint-Guided Capability Expansion mechanism.
88x46KwEyF.key_idea: Combines a Necessity-Aware Adaptive Reward with Hint-Guided Capability Expansion during RL to calibrate tool invocation and tool benefit.
88x46KwEyF.evidence: Backed by empirical analysis quantifying Mode Adaptiveness and Tool Effect on existing agentic visual reasoning models (Beacon evaluation truncated in abstract).

i8NUWRtIaA.one_liner: Splices bounded proposal-model options into failed agent rollouts and weights them via current-policy continuation returns for RL.
i8NUWRtIaA.problem: Group-based RL with verifiable rewards frequently produces all-fail groups on long-horizon agent tasks, leaving zero reward gradient, while full off-policy teacher trajectories are costly.
i8NUWRtIaA.method: SPLICE handles all-fail groups online by having a proposal model pick a splice point in a failed current-policy trajectory and generate bounded options from that state. It estimates each option's value via repeated current-policy continuations, converts positive estimates into a return-weighted local target, and fits the current policy on those options.
i8NUWRtIaA.key_idea: Generates bounded options at a splice point in failed rollouts and turns positive current-policy continuation values into return-weighted local training targets.
i8NUWRtIaA.evidence: Evaluated across two policy families on SWE-bench Verified (Software Engineering) and BrowseComp-Plus (Deep Research) against GRPO and full-trajectory guidance baselines.
i8NUWRtIaA.claimed_gains: Improves over GRPO by 2.80–9.80 percentage points across all four settings and raises GRPO's graduation rate on initially failed SWE tasks by 10.86 percentage points.

Zy77eOv5AU.one_liner: Allocates LoRA ranks dynamically under a fixed budget using Centered Kernel Alignment dissimilarity between LoRA and pretrained branches.
Zy77eOv5AU.problem: Prior dynamic LoRA rank allocation methods score modules using self-importance or inter-module signals while ignoring how each LoRA branch relates to its associated pretrained weights.
Zy77eOv5AU.method: RSLoRA measures representational similarity between each LoRA branch and its corresponding pretrained branch via Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA). Under a fixed rank budget, it assigns higher rank capacity to modules with lower CKA similarity so they can model structures not captured by pretrained weights.
Zy77eOv5AU.key_idea: Assigns larger LoRA ranks to modules whose branch representations show lower Centered Kernel Alignment similarity with their pretrained branch.

o0lMKg1IfB.one_liner: Organizes completed reasoning rollouts into a semantic prefix trie to estimate branch-level advantages from terminal outcomes.
o0lMKg1IfB.problem: Individual high-entropy tokens in RLVR do not reveal which semantic reasoning path a model selected, limiting fine-grained credit assignment without step-level supervision.
o0lMKg1IfB.method: SemCredit groups multiple completed rollouts for the same problem into a semantic prefix trie to identify shared semantic prefixes and diverging reasoning branches. It aggregates terminal outcomes at trie nodes to estimate local advantages, combining trajectory-level rewards with semantic branch structure.
o0lMKg1IfB.key_idea: Constructs a semantic prefix trie over completed rollouts and aggregates terminal rewards at branch nodes to compute local credit-assignment advantages.
o0lMKg1IfB.evidence: Evaluated across four Qwen models of different scales on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

7bK1XFE6bA.one_liner: Tokenizes local object surface elements and compresses them using task compatibility, body proximity, and area priors for humanoid manipulation.
7bK1XFE6bA.problem: Bounding boxes discard contact-relevant local surface details for humanoid manipulation, while raw point clouds leave surface structure implicit and hinder cross-shape policy transfer.
7bK1XFE6bA.method: SIGMA combines Structured Surface Attributes (SSA), which encode fixed-size local surface elements with position, normal, and area, with Interaction-Conditioned Geometry Compression (ICGC), which aggregates elements by task compatibility, humanoid body-surface proximity, and area priors into an adaptive geometry token for a unified multi-task controller.
7bK1XFE6bA.key_idea: Aggregates local surface elements (position, normal, area) into an interaction-conditioned geometry token weighted by task compatibility, body proximity, and area priors.
7bK1XFE6bA.evidence: Evaluated via frozen-policy transfer without target-object adaptation on objects with identical global extents, unseen local perturbations, and diverse furniture geometries.
7bK1XFE6bA.claimed_gains: Achieves 58.33% average full-task success at 50k iterations (rest of comparison truncated in abstract).

uU59gqQTqL.one_liner: Computes per-task Average Gradient Outer Products to attenuate high-interference negative repulsion updates in replay-free CLIP continual learning.
uU59gqQTqL.problem: Even under task-local cross-entropy without old-class negative gradients, shared image encoder updates in replay-free CLIP continual learning push old image features away from their text features.
uU59gqQTqL.method: AGRA constructs a sample-normalized Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP) for each previous task to measure directional interference risk of current-task negative updates. It preserves low-risk negative signals while selectively attenuating high-risk negative repulsion updates that overlap old-task-sensitive directions.
uU59gqQTqL.key_idea: Uses per-task sample-normalized Average Gradient Outer Products to score and selectively attenuate current-task negative repulsion updates along old-task-sensitive directions.
uU59gqQTqL.evidence: Supported by analysis of cross-modal drift and experiments on replay-free CLIP continual learning (specific datasets truncated in abstract).

fc4f45XBhL.one_liner: Uses query-conditioned role labels, frozen correspondences, joint five-type repairs, and Shapley allocation to attribute RMOT HOTA gaps.
fc4f45XBhL.problem: Aggregate metrics like HOTA in referring multi-object tracking do not reveal how individual error types occur, interact, or contribute to the jointly recoverable performance gap.
fc4f45XBhL.method: RMOT-Compass combines the language query with full-scene annotations to label targets and distractors, freezes diagnostic correspondences across repairs, and performs coordinated joint repairs across five error types (missing targets, distractors, background/duplicates, association, localization). Standard Shapley allocation averages marginal HOTA gains over all repair orders so credited gains sum exactly to the recoverable gap.
fc4f45XBhL.key_idea: Applies frozen query-conditioned correspondences, five coordinated error repairs, and Shapley value allocation to decompose recoverable HOTA gaps.
fc4f45XBhL.evidence: Evaluated across five RMOT methods on the Refer-KITTI dataset.

lQuqVt3b0c.one_liner: Fine-tunes tabular foundation models across jointly reparameterized input-output task views and evaluates loss in original coordinates.
lQuqVt3b0c.problem: Standard fine-tuning of tabular foundation models optimizes a single arbitrary coordinate representation of features, category codes, and labels, causing confidence saturation and loss concentration.
lQuqVt3b0c.method: OrbitTune fine-tunes tabular foundation models over an input-output task-orbit objective that consistently reparameterizes query features, context features, context labels, and query targets, then decodes predictions back to original output coordinates for supervision. The authors also establish fixed-task semantic preservation and Bayes equivariance under a task-orbit symmetric prior.
lQuqVt3b0c.key_idea: Jointly reparameterizes tabular inputs and outputs across equivalent task views while evaluating decoded predictions in original target coordinates.
lQuqVt3b0c.evidence: Supported by Bayes equivariance theory, controlled structural causal model ablations, and benchmarks on TabZilla and TabArena with LimiX-16M and TabPFN-2.5.

Z49toBRaO9.one_liner: Generates short dramas from one sentence via multi-agent story debate, 3D-grounded first frames, and multi-stage reviewer loops.
Z49toBRaO9.problem: One-shot LLM scripts and loosely coupled pipelines fail to maintain short-drama narrative pacing, cross-clip spatial consistency, and automated production quality control.
Z49toBRaO9.method: One Sentence, One Drama is a hierarchical multi-agent system with three modules: debate-based story generation for pacing, 3D-grounded first-frame generation for shared spatial layouts across clips, and multi-stage reviewer loops revising script, visual, and video stages, plus scene-level BGM matching and transition planning.
Z49toBRaO9.key_idea: Combines multi-agent debate scripting, 3D-grounded first-frame spatial anchoring, and iterative multi-stage reviewer loops for short-drama synthesis.

KsLLrLhHAN.one_liner: Derives CFG stabilization bands and a one-coefficient contraction-matched DDIM update that prevents discriminative coordinate reversal.
KsLLrLhHAN.problem: Standard DDIM updates were derived for unguided flows, so coarse steps under classifier-free guidance can reverse discriminative coordinates and amplify residuals.
KsLLrLhHAN.method: Analyzing an ordered commuting Gaussian model, the authors characterize a band of guidance coefficients that prevents reversal and encompasses the sign cap and deterministic CFG++. Terminal matching fixes the remaining factor to yield Fitted CFG, a one-coefficient update with no extra denoiser cost that bounds accumulated log-relative contraction error.
KsLLrLhHAN.key_idea: Replaces standard DDIM guidance weighting with a contraction-matched coefficient chosen via terminal matching inside a derived stabilization band.
KsLLrLhHAN.evidence: Supported by Gaussian-model theory, two nine-cell grids and a 50k CIFAR-10 comparison, and 30k SDXL samples with a finite-scale extension.
KsLLrLhHAN.claimed_gains: Lowers 50k CIFAR-10 FID from 27.87 to 20.88 and improves FID, KID, and saturation on 30k SDXL samples at some cost in text alignment.

zahaPl9lJm.one_liner: Controls coding-agent token costs across sequential repository tasks by injecting micro-skills, pruning unused tools, and breaking failure loops.
zahaPl9lJm.problem: Coding agents evaluated over realistic sequences of repository maintenance tasks incur recurring environment-dependent token costs that isolated-task optimizations miss.
zahaPl9lJm.method: TokenEconomizer is an external black-box controller operating across task sequences that learns which operational micro-skills to inject, which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and when to intervene in unproductive failure loops.
zahaPl9lJm.key_idea: Reduces sequential coding-agent token usage via an external controller that injects micro-skills, prunes irrelevant tools, and halts failure loops.
zahaPl9lJm.evidence: Evaluated across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI with frontier models on multi-task repositories plus sequential web development and security auditing.
zahaPl9lJm.claimed_gains: Reduces average token cost by 18.4–30.9% on coding repositories with comparable task success and by 6.4–21.2% on web development and security auditing.

ASJVzOKN0t.one_liner: Models each decentralized MARL agent's local task as a Contextual MDP with latent variables capturing other agents' joint actions.
ASJVzOKN0t.problem: In fully decentralized cooperative MARL without access to teammates' actions, existing methods fail to jointly resolve non-stationarity in value updates and relative overgeneralization.
ASJVzOKN0t.method: Dynamics-Aware Context (DAC) formalizes each agent's local perception as a Contextual MDP and infers latent context variables modeling step-wise dynamics distributions. Theory shows each context represents an equivalence class of teammates' joint actions, enabling a context-conditioned value function to handle both failure modes.
ASJVzOKN0t.key_idea: Infers latent step-wise dynamics contexts representing equivalence classes of teammates' joint actions to condition decentralized per-agent value functions.
ASJVzOKN0t.evidence: Supported by theoretical equivalence-class analysis and empirical evaluation across cooperative MARL tasks (specific benchmarks truncated in abstract).

alH8ukm0BQ.one_liner: Folds agent memory sequentially via entity-grounded temporal clustering and verification-revised compact text encoding.
alH8ukm0BQ.problem: Long-term agent memory stores suffer from coupled retrieval overhead from growing record counts and prefill/attention overhead from long consolidated retrieval units.
alH8ukm0BQ.method: MemFolder sequentially reduces record count and context length using two shared-group components: RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, selects complementary anchors, and merges records via semantic/entity affinity and temporal chaining; ContextFolder encodes grouped records into compact text and revises encodings using verification feedback when key facts cannot be recovered.
alH8ukm0BQ.key_idea: Consolidates records via entity-grounded anchor selection and temporal chaining, then compresses groups into verification-revised compact text.
alH8ukm0BQ.evidence: Evaluated on three text memory benchmarks (LoCoMo, PersonaMem, LongMemEval) and two multimodal benchmarks (M3-Bench-web, M3-Bench-robot).

hLhp1l867c.one_liner: Grounds each hierarchical latent reasoning step in level-wise collaborative preferences and calibrates final Semantic-ID item rankings.
hLhp1l867c.problem: In generative recommendation over Semantic IDs, action supervision leaves collaborative preference underdetermined in intermediate latent states and autoregressive path scoring loses collaborative fidelity at item ranking.
hLhp1l867c.method: CoLaGR derives level-wise collaborative preferences from item-level behavioral signals, grounds each intermediate latent reasoning state with its corresponding level-wise preference, and applies collaborative leaf calibration using a constructed collaborative memory to refine final item rankings.
hLhp1l867c.key_idea: Aligns every hierarchical latent reasoning state to level-wise behavioral preferences and calibrates final item scores with a collaborative memory.
hLhp1l867c.evidence: Evaluated empirically against generative recommendation baselines (specific datasets and numbers truncated in abstract).

i4pbwDJnGa.one_liner: Trains a generative code verifier from execution and repair histories to output rationales, repair-relevant regions, and verdicts before testing.
i4pbwDJnGa.problem: RLVR for coding agents lacks scalable intermediate rewards because short tests tie candidates, full tests add tail latency, partial edits are untestable, and large LLM judges are costly.
i4pbwDJnGa.method: CodeVerifier is a generative verifier that evaluates complete programs, ongoing edits, and repository patches prior to final testing by outputting a rationale, repair-relevant code regions, and a verdict. A two-stage pipeline projects execution outcomes and successful repair histories into structured targets and optimizes verdicts and regions with separate field-wise signals.
i4pbwDJnGa.key_idea: Projects execution outcomes and repair diffs into structured targets to train a generative verifier with separate field-wise losses for verdicts and repair regions.
i4pbwDJnGa.evidence: Evaluated across competitive programming, repository code judging, and LiveCodeBench residual errors with a 9B model against size-matched baselines.
i4pbwDJnGa.claimed_gains: Outperforms size-matched code judging baselines across competitive programming and repository code by 3.2 points on average.

SiOknxHhxQ.one_liner: Scores autoregressive video rollout chunks independently with a chunk teacher before applying video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence.
SiOknxHhxQ.problem: Joint video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) on autoregressive rollouts can encourage a chunk to match artifacts in its surrounding history to preserve temporal consistency.
SiOknxHhxQ.method: Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD) keeps the generated history for autoregressive prediction but first scores each rollout chunk independently against a chunk teacher so visual-quality corrections are uncompromised by imperfect temporal context, then applies video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence.
SiOknxHhxQ.key_idea: Decouples visual quality from history artifacts by distilling each autoregressive rollout chunk independently against a chunk teacher before video-level DMD.
SiOknxHhxQ.evidence: Evaluated on long-horizon autoregressive video generation beyond the training horizon against video-level DMD baselines.

1NGOUEVGXM.one_liner: Inserts low-rank adapters to filter misaligned auxiliary text before fusing it into frozen time-series forecasting backbones.
1NGOUEVGXM.problem: Naive addition or concatenation of text in multimodal time-series forecasting often underperforms unimodal models by injecting irrelevant auxiliary signals.
1NGOUEVGXM.method: The authors compare constrained fusion strategies and introduce Controlled Fusion Adapter (CFA), a plug-in module that leaves the time-series backbone unchanged and uses low-rank adapters to filter out irrelevant textual features before fusing aligned signals into temporal representations.
1NGOUEVGXM.key_idea: Uses plug-in low-rank adapters to filter irrelevant textual information prior to fusing text into frozen time-series representations.
1NGOUEVGXM.evidence: Evaluated across over 20,000 experiments comparing 11 methods.
1NGOUEVGXM.claimed_gains: Ranks first among 11 compared methods across over 20K experiments while adding 0.61% parameters.

lWTPmywv5U.one_liner: Retrieves control-derived expression offsets via chromatin/locus similarity and models residual perturbation responses with conditional transport flow.
lWTPmywv5U.problem: Transcriptome-only perturbation predictors miss chromatin context and struggle with baseline differences between independently sampled control and perturbed cell populations.
lWTPmywv5U.method: ChromaPert combines molecular and DNA-informed locus priors with paired control RNA-ATAC features. Its Chromatin-Guided Response Router (CGRR) retrieves control-derived expression offsets by perturbation/locus or control-ATAC similarity to remove baseline differences, and conditional transport flow learns the remaining response.
lWTPmywv5U.key_idea: Routes control-derived expression offsets via locus or control-ATAC similarity and predicts residual perturbation shifts using conditional transport flow.
lWTPmywv5U.evidence: Evaluated across three unseen-target and held-out-state settings on K562 CAT-ATAC and Perturb-Multiome datasets.
lWTPmywv5U.claimed_gains: Achieves point-estimate correlation gains of 23.2% across all genes and 46.2% on top-20 genes (truncated) when transferring known perturbations to held-out states.
